context.en-US: Acid ceramidase (ACase, aCDase) is encoded by ASAH1. It is a lysosomal hydrolase that cleaves ceramide into sphingosine and a free fatty acid.
context.zh-TW: 酸性神經醯胺酶（ACase、aCDase）由 ASAH1 編碼。它是一種溶酶體水解酶，可將神經醯胺裂解為鞘氨醇與游離脂肪酸。

context.en-US: ACase catalyzes the primary reaction: Ceramide + H2O → Sphingosine + Free fatty acid. It is a cysteine amidase with activity blocked by thiol-reactive agents targeting Cys143.
context.zh-TW: ACase 催化主要反應：Ceramide + H2O → Sphingosine + Free fatty acid。它是一種半胱氨酸醯胺酶，其活性可被針對 Cys143 的硫醇反應性試劑阻斷。

context.en-US: ACase is overexpressed 5- to 20-fold in replicatively senescent WI-38 fibroblasts compared to proliferative controls, creating a pro-ferroptotic membrane lipid profile.
context.zh-TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase/ASAH1) 在複製衰老的人類 WI-38  fibroblasts 中，與增生細胞相比，表達量明顯上調，Western blot 驗證表達量高出 5-20 倍。與鐵蛋白死亡 (ferroptosis) 調節因子 ACSL4 一起，ACase 在衰老中被上調表達的脂質代謝酶之一。ACase 下調顯著降低了衰老細胞中的其水平（儘管未完全，與衰老中 ACase 的增加穩定性一致），並且衰老表型本身——p21 表現、SA-β-gal 活性和 IL-6/IL-8 的分泌——在下調後仍然保持完整。

context.en-US: ACase overexpression raises sphingosine/S1P levels, which is classically anti-apoptotic and helps senescent cells resist apoptosis via SCAP pathways.
context.zh-TW: ACase 過度表現提高 sphingosine/S1P 水平，此在經典上為抗凋亡，並透過 SCAP 路徑幫助衰老細胞抵抗凋亡。

context.en-US: Adrenochrome semiquinone radical generates ROS through redox cycling. The autoxidation/redox cycling pathway produces superoxide, amplifying oxidative stress.
context.zh-TW: Adrenochrome 的氧化還原循環在生理條件下產生活性氧物種並耗竭麩胱甘肽等細胞抗氧化劑，這是其心臟毒性的基礎。其 indoline-dione（o-quinone）核心的反覆還原與再氧化會產生超氧陰離子與下游氧化劑，損害細胞組分。由於游離、未共軛的 adrenochrome 極不穩定，此促氧化活性通常透過共軛（如 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine）而減緩。若該共軛物發生顯著的全身性水解，局部釋出的游離 adrenochrome 可能無意間促進而非緩解氧化壓力。

context.en-US: Literature adjudication (Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923; Bindoli et al. 1990): Complex I reduces adrenochrome to its semiquinone, which auto-oxidizes to superoxide — a redox cycle that amplifies ROS. Adrenochrome is therefore an electron acceptor at Complex I ('redox_cycles_at', conf 0.9).
context.zh-TW: 文獻裁決（Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923；Bindoli et al. 1990）：Complex I 把 adrenochrome 還原成半醌，半醌自氧化成超氧化物——一個放大 ROS 的氧化還原循環。因此 adrenochrome 是 Complex I 的電子受體（「redox_cycles_at」，conf 0.9）。

context.en-US: AKT phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Ser196 (human specific), suppressing caspase activity in prostate and colon cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: AKT 在 Ser196（人類專一）磷酸化 Caspase-9，在攝護腺與大腸癌細胞中抑制 caspase 活性。

context.en-US: AKT phosphorylates XIAP at Ser87, preventing ubiquitination and degradation, promoting tumor survival in ovarian cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: AKT 在 Ser87 磷酸化 XIAP，防止泛素化與降解，在卵巢癌細胞中促進腫瘤存活。

context.en-US: Aminoguanidine is the tightest-coupled exogenous protocol agent to the adrenochrome trigger: direct chemical edge 'reacts_with' (conf 0.9, PPR #4 seeded at Adrenochrome) originating from the US4501923A adrenochrome-preparation patent document in the vault.
context.zh-TW: Aminoguanidine 是與 adrenochrome 觸發器耦合最緊密的外源協定劑：直接化學邊「reacts_with」（conf 0.9，以 Adrenochrome 為種子時 PPR #4），源自庫中的 US4501923A adrenochrome 製備專利文件。

context.en-US: The mitohormetic trigger activates key nutrient-sensing and stress-response pathways including AMPK, PGC-1alpha, SIRT1, and NRF2. AMPK then drives mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy, leaving a resilient metabolic engine; this is why mild, pulsed stress enhances longevity and metabolic efficiency.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體促效應觸發因子活化包括 AMPK、PGC-1alpha、SIRT1 與 NRF2 在內的關鍵營養感測與壓力反應路徑。AMPK 接著驅動粒線體生成與自噬，留下具韌性的代謝引擎；這就是為何溫和、脈衝式壓力增強長壽與代謝效率。

context.en-US: AMPK directly interacts with and activates sirtuins (SIRT1/SIRT3). Both are nutrient-sensing longevity pathways that converge on autophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 直接交互作用並活化 sirtuin（SIRT1/SIRT3）。兩者皆為營養感測的長壽路徑，匯聚於自噬與粒線體生成。

context.en-US: AMPK is the only first-order neighbor shared by all three defense programs (Mitohormesis, Autophagy, Sirtuins) in the quartet study; fasting/energy deficit activates AMPK → TFEB → lysosomal biogenesis → autophagy, the metabolic switch underlying intermittent-fasting hormesis.
context.zh-TW: 在四點研究中，AMPK 是三個防禦程式（Mitohormesis、Autophagy、Sirtuins）共享的唯一一階鄰點；禁食／能量赤字活化 AMPK → TFEB → 溶酶體新生 → 自噬，這是間歇性禁食荷爾蒙背後的代謝開關。

context.en-US: AMT-130 is a one-time AAV5-microRNA gene therapy delivered by MRI-guided convection-enhanced infusion into the striatum to silence mutant huntingtin (HTT); its pivotal Phase I/II result showed 75% slowing of cUHDRS decline at 36 months (p=0.003) — the first disease-slowing HD therapy (uniQure, Sep 2025).
context.zh-TW: AMT-130 是單次 AAV5-microRNA 基因治療，經 MRI 引導對流增強灌注注入紋狀體以沉默突變 huntingtin（HTT）；其關鍵 Phase I/II 結果在 36 個月時顯示 cUHDRS 衰退速度減緩 75%（p=0.003）——第一個減緩 HD 病程的療法（uniQure, Sep 2025）。

context.en-US: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
context.zh-TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

context.en-US: AP-1 transactivates CXCL5 (a SASP chemokine), which feeds inflammaging. Caloric restriction suppresses inflammaging and activates autophagy via mTOR/AMPK.
context.zh-TW: AP-1 轉活化 CXCL5（一種 SASP 趨化因子），促成發炎性老化（inflammaging）。熱量限制可抑制發炎性老化，並透過 mTOR/AMPK 活化自噬。

context.en-US: AP-1 and NF-κB are co-regulators of inflammatory SASP genes. They share transcriptional targets including IL-6, IL-8, and TNFα.
context.zh-TW: AP-1 與 NF-κB 是發炎型 SASP 基因的共調節因子。它們共享包括 IL-6、IL-8 與 TNFα 在內的轉錄標的。

context.en-US: AP-1 acts as a pioneer factor opening closed chromatin at SASP super-enhancers, co-bound with BRD4 and C/EBPα. It drives SASP enhancer activity in senescent cells.
context.zh-TW: AP-1 作為先鋒因子，在 SASP 超級增強子處打開緻密染色質，並與 BRD4 和 C/EBPα 共同結合。它驅動衰老細胞中的 SASP 增強子活性。

context.en-US: ARN14794 has IC50 ~100 nM against acid ceramidase and was specifically used in the Soriano-Castell 2026 ferroptosis study to reduce membrane PL-PUFA content.
context.zh-TW: ARN14794 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 約為 100 nM，並在 Soriano-Castell 2026 年的鐵蛋白死亡研究中被專門用於降低膜磷脂中 PL-PUFA 的含量。

context.en-US: Ascorbic acid reduces adrenochrome (conf 0.75) and inhibits adrenochrome formation (conf 0.9) by scavenging the oxidizing species that drive epinephrine oxidation — the redox-counterpart edge placing ascorbate on the trigger side of the graph's Fiedler seam.
context.zh-TW: 抗壞血酸還原 adrenochrome（conf 0.75）並藉清除驅動腎上腺素氧化的氧化物種抑制 adrenochrome 形成（conf 0.9）——此氧化還原對應邊把抗壞血酸置於圖 Fiedler 接縫的觸發器側。

context.en-US: Auranofin, a gold(I)-based anti-rheumatic drug, irreversibly inhibits thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD) via selenocysteine adduction, collapsing the thioredoxin system's NADPH-driven regeneration of Trx and driving lethal ROS accumulation, apoptosis plus ferroptosis — the pharmacological underside of the hormetic window.
context.zh-TW: Auranofin 是金(I)類抗風濕藥，透過硒代半胱氨酸加合物不可逆地抑制硫氧還原蛋白還原酶（TXNRD），使 NADPH 驅動的 Trx 再生崩潰，造成致死性 ROS 累積、細胞凋亡及鐵依賴性細胞死亡——即荷爾蒙窗口的藥理學背面。

context.en-US: In established tumors, autophagy acts as a survival mechanism allowing cancer cells to survive nutrient-poor and hypoxic conditions. This is the majority view supported by multiple clinical trials using HCQ. Qualification: established-tumor context only; autophagy suppresses initiation and can drive autophagic cell death under prolonged stress.
context.zh-TW: 在既成的腫瘤中，自噬作為一種存活機制，使癌細胞能在營養貧乏與缺氧條件下存活。這是以多項使用 HCQ 的臨床試驗為支持的普遍觀點。 限定：僅既成腫瘤脈絡；自噬抑制起始，並在長期壓力下可驅動自噬性細胞死亡。

context.en-US: Benign tumors are dual-natured: OIS-type arrested lesions (nevi) are longevity-positive cancer barriers, whereas growth-signal-driven benign growths such as TSC1/TSC2-loss mTORC1 hamartomas are themselves disease (Tuberous Sclerosis, angiomyolipoma, epilepsy). Arrested growth is good; ongoing growth is bad.
context.zh-TW: 良性腫瘤具有雙重本質：OIS 型停滯病灶（痣）是長壽正向的癌症屏障，而由生長訊號驅動的良性生長（如 TSC1/TSC2 缺失 mTORC1 錯構瘤）本身即是疾病（結節性硬化症、血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇）。停滯的生長是好的；持續的生長是壞的。

context.en-US: Berberine activates AMPK to manage blood glucose and prevent excessive glycation during high-calorie bulk phases, mimicking caloric restriction. As an AMPK activator it supports the nutrient-sensing axis that drives autophagy and metabolic health.
context.zh-TW: Berberine 活化 AMPK 以管理血糖並在高熱量整體期間防止過度糖化，模擬熱量限制。作為 AMPK 活化劑，它支持驅動自噬與代謝健康的營養感測軸。

context.en-US: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
context.zh-TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

context.en-US: Bleomycin induces premature senescence via DNA breaks, activating p53-p21 and p16 pathways with SASP secretion.
context.zh-TW: Bleomycin 透過 DNA 斷裂誘發早衰，活化 p53-p21 與 p16 路徑並伴隨 SASP 分泌。

context.en-US: Oncogenic BRAF (V600E), RAS, or MYC drive a hyperproliferative burst that causes DNA replication stress and a DNA damage response, permanently arresting the cell via p53/p21 and p16/Rb. OIS is therefore induced by oncogenic signaling yet confronts it with a tumor-suppressive barrier in benign lesions.
context.zh-TW: 致癌性 BRAF（V600E）、RAS 或 MYC 驅動高增生爆發，造成 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷反應，經由 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 永久性停滯細胞。OIS 因此由致癌訊號誘發，卻在良性病灶中以腫瘤抑制屏障對抗之。

context.en-US: BRD4 co-binds H3K27ac at SASP super-enhancers alongside AP-1, facilitating the senescence-associated secretory phenotype program.
context.zh-TW: BRD4 與 AP-1 一起，在 SASP 超級增強子處共結合 H3K27ac，促進衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）程序。

context.en-US: Butein, a chalcone, is among the first-reported SIRT1 polyphenolic STACs (with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, myricetin), activating SIRT1 via K-type allosteric lowering of Km. It attenuates sepsis-induced brain injury through SIRT1 signaling.
context.zh-TW: Butein 是一種查耳酮，是最早被報導的 SIRT1 多酚類 STACs 之一（與白藜蘆醇、piceatannol、quercetin、myricetin 並列），透過 K 型別構降低 Km 來活化 SIRT1。它透過 SIRT1 訊號減緩敗血症誘發的腦損傷。

context.en-US: c-ABL phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Tyr153, promoting caspase activation and DNA damage-induced apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: c-ABL 在 Tyr153 磷酸化 Caspase-9，促進 caspase 活化與 DNA 損傷誘發的凋亡。

context.en-US: CR induces autophagy via energy deficit — increased AMP/ATP ratio activates AMPK, which phosphorylates and activates ULK1 while inhibiting mTORC1.
context.zh-TW: CR 透過能量虧損誘導自噬——AMP/ATP 比值上升活化 AMPK，後者磷酸化並活化 ULK1，同時抑制 mTORC1。

context.en-US: Longevity interventions including caloric restriction require autophagy — life-extension by CR is abolished when autophagy is blocked in model organisms.
context.zh-TW: 包括熱量限制在內的長壽介入需要自噬——在模式生物中，若自噬被阻斷，則 CR 所帶來的壽命延長即被取消。

context.en-US: Caloric restriction is a canonical mitohormetic stressor: a transient energy deficit activates AMPK, PGC-1alpha, SIRT1, and NRF2, driving mitochondrial biogenesis, mitophagy, and endogenous antioxidant defenses. Glucose restriction and CR are among the best-established triggers of the hormetic longevity response.
context.zh-TW: 熱量限制是典型粒線體促效應壓力源：短暫的能量虧損活化 AMPK、PGC-1alpha、SIRT1 與 NRF2，驅動粒線體生成、mitophagy 與內生抗氧化防禦。葡萄糖限制與 CR 是最確立的促效應長壽反應觸發因子之一。

context.en-US: Ivermectin preferentially targets and inhibits cancer stem cells, suppressing Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 expression through the PAK1-STAT3 axis. This kills CSCs therapeutically in breast cancer but simultaneously lowers the reprogramming factors needed for Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 優先標靶並抑制癌幹細胞，透過 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 表現。這在乳癌中治療性地殺死 CSC，但同時降低 Yamanaka 因子回春所需的重編程因子。

context.en-US: Carbazochrome is an intermediate for adrenochrome synthesis ('is_an_intermediate_for', conf 0.9); it is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone, produced by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to render it relatively chemically inactive.
context.zh-TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 合成的中間體（「is_an_intermediate_for」，conf 0.9）；它是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（monosemicarbazone），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成，使其相對化學惰性。

context.en-US: Carbazochrome is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone ('is_derivative_of', conf 0.95), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to make a relatively chemically inactive derivative — resolving the Round-2 amplifier-conflict ticket as an evidence-based null for carbazochrome redox-cycling at Complex I.
context.zh-TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（「is_derivative_of」，conf 0.95），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成的一種相對化學惰性衍生物——把第二輪放大器衝突票裁定為 carbazochrome 在 Complex I 氧化還原循環的以證據為基礎的空結果。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin stimulates DRP1 GTPase activity for fission AND is required for OPA1-mediated fusion — it has dual pro-fusion and pro-fission roles depending on context. A conserved WRG motif in the DRP1 variable domain intercalates into the bilayer and binds cardiolipin specifically, driving a disorder-to-order transition that relieves autoinhibition and stabilizes assembled DRP1. Because cardiolipin is externalized to the outer membrane only under stress, the interaction gates stress-induced hyperfragmentation while leaving housekeeping fission largely intact.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 刺激 DRP1 的 GTPase 活性以進行使分裂，同時也是 OPA1 介導融合所必需的——依情境不同，它具有促融合與促分裂的雙重角色。 DRP1 可變區中的保守 WRG 模序會插入雙層並專一結合 cardiolipin，促使無序到有序的轉換而解除自動抑制，並穩定已組裝的 DRP1。由於 cardiolipin 僅在壓力下才被外翻到外膜，此交互作用便把壓力誘發的過度碎裂設閘，而家務性分裂大致不受影響。

context.en-US: Carmofur has IC50 29 nM against acid ceramidase, is clinically approved in Japan, crosses the BBB, and is a repurposing candidate for senolytic therapy.
context.zh-TW: Carmofur 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 為 29 nM，已在日本獲臨床核准，可穿過血腦屏障（BBB），是去衰老（senolytic）治療的再利用候選藥物。

context.en-US: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin inflammasomes recruit pro-Caspase-1 via ASC for proximity-induced dimerization and activation — the scaffolded platform that determines pyroptotic versus inflammatory outcomes; Caspase-1 then cleaves pro-IL-1beta and IL-18 to their active cytokines.
context.zh-TW: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin 發炎體經 ASC 招募 pro-Caspase-1，進行鄰近誘導二聚化與活化——這是決定細胞焦亡或發炎結果的平台支架；Caspase-1 隨後把 pro-IL-1beta 與 IL-18 切割成熟為活性細胞激素。

context.en-US: Caspase-1 is a core SASP amplifier: NLRP3 → Caspase-1 → IL-1beta → NF-kappaB → IL-6/IL-8 signaling increases with age and drives inflammaging and immunosenescence (Youm et al. 2013, PMID 23562091) — the graph currently connects it only transitively via Inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-1 是核心 SASP 放大器：NLRP3 → Caspase-1 → IL-1beta → NF-kappaB → IL-6/IL-8 訊號隨年齡增加並驅動發炎性老化與免疫衰老（Youm et al. 2013, PMID 23562091）——圖目前僅透過 Inflammaging 間接連到它。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is a bona fide tumor suppressor: knockout mice develop centrosome excess, aneuploidy and carcinogen-hypersensitive tumorigenesis; it also cleaves Beclin-1, coupling tumor suppression, autophagy suppression and apoptosis upstream of p53 (PMID 19339967).
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 是名副其實的腫瘤抑制子：剔除小鼠出現中心體過量、非整倍體與致癌物高敏感腫瘤生成；它也切割 Beclin-1，在 p53 上游耦合腫瘤抑制、自噬抑制與細胞凋亡（PMID 19339967）。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 is activated early in oncogene-induced senescence and exerts non-apoptotic, senescence-reinforcing functions (Tang et al. 2012, PMID 22863278) — it is the only caspase with non-trivial PPR flow into Senescence/SASP/Autophagy, connecting the death machinery to the aging program.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 在致癌基因誘導衰老早期被活化，並施展非凋亡、強化衰老的功能（Tang et al. 2012, PMID 22863278）——它是唯一對 Senescence/SASP/Autophagy 有顯著 PPR 流量的 caspase，把死亡機械與老化程式連結。

context.en-US: Executioner Caspase-3 participates in SIRT1 cleavage at DEPDVP(704–709) under severe DNA damage; the simultaneous TRIM28 poly-ubiquitination couples cleavage to degradation — a conserved 'dismantle the repair machinery' program shared with PARP, ATM and DNA-PKcs.
context.zh-TW: 執行者 Caspase-3 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下參與 SIRT1 於 DEPDVP(704–709) 的切割；同時 TRIM28 多泛素化把切割與降解耦合——這是與 PARP、ATM、DNA-PKcs 共享的「拆解修復機械」保守程式。

context.en-US: Caspase-8 is the necroptosis gatekeeper: it cleaves and inactivates RIPK1/RIPK3, keeping the MLKL-driven necroptosis pathway in check; when Caspase-8 is inhibited or absent, the same death-receptor signals switch to necroptosis — a balance the combined graph recovered as PPR flow into Necroptosis (#25 for Caspase-8).
context.zh-TW: Caspase-8 是壞死性凋亡（necroptosis）的守門員：它切割並滅活 RIPK1/RIPK3，抑制 MLKL 驅動的壞死性凋亡路徑；當 Caspase-8 被抑制或缺失時，同一死亡受體訊號切換到壞死性凋亡——combined 圖以流向 Necroptosis 的 PPR（Caspase-8 #25）重現此平衡。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 (with Caspase-3) cleaves SIRT1 during apoptosis at the C-terminal site DEPDVP(704–709), relocalizing it from nucleus to cytoplasm and flipping it into a pro-apoptotic, deacetylase-independent form (Ohsawa & Miura, FEBS Lett 2006; Int J Biol Sci 2022, PMID 35541916).
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9（與 Caspase-3）在細胞凋亡期間於 C 端位點 DEPDVP(704–709) 切割 SIRT1，使其從細胞核移至細胞質，並轉為促凋亡、不依賴去乙醯化酶的形式（Ohsawa & Miura, FEBS Lett 2006；Int J Biol Sci 2022, PMID 35541916）。

context.en-US: CD38 is the primary enzymatic consumer of NAD+ in mammalian tissues during aging. Chronic inflammaging causes CD38 upregulation on neutrophils and macrophages, starving sirtuins. CD38 is an NADase whose activity rises with age and drives age-related NAD+ decline, with the loss expressed through reduced SIRT3 activity rather than by directly inhibiting the enzyme. Because the effect is on substrate availability, CD38 inhibitors such as 78c or apigenin raise NAD+ and thereby SIRT3 flux without ever binding SIRT3 itself.
context.zh-TW: CD38 是哺乳動物組織在老化過程中主要的 NAD+ 酵素消耗者。慢性發炎性老化造成嗜中性球與巨噬細胞上 CD38 上調，使 sirtuin 飢餓。 CD38 是一種 NADase，其活性隨年齡上升並推動年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降，而這個影響是透過 SIRT3 活性降低來表現，而非直接抑制該酵素。由於作用點在受質可利用性，CD38 抑制劑如 78c 或 apigenin 可提高 NAD+，進而提高 SIRT3 的通量，全程都不需與 SIRT3 結合。

context.en-US: CDK1/CYCLIN B1 phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308, suppressing caspase activity and suppressing mitotic cell death.
context.zh-TW: CDK1/CYCLIN B1 在 Ser308 磷酸化 Caspase-2，抑制 caspase 活性並抑制有絲分裂細胞死亡。

context.en-US: CDK5 phosphorylates NOXA at Ser13, causing inactivation in metabolically regulated T-cell leukemia cells.
context.zh-TW: CDK5 在 Ser13 磷酸化 NOXA，在代謝調節的 T 細胞白血病細胞中造成不活化。

context.en-US: Celastrol activates TFEB via inhibiting mTORC1, reducing insoluble phosphorylated Tau aggregates and improving memory deficiency in Alzheimer's disease models.
context.zh-TW: Celastrol 透過抑制 mTORC1 活化 TFEB，減少不溶性磷酸化 Tau 聚集體，並改善阿茲海默症模型中的記憶缺陷。

context.en-US: Cytosolic mitochondrial DNA and cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (from senescence or TDP-43-driven mitochondrial rupture) engage cGAS-STING to drive type-I interferon signaling — the innate-immune axis that, in the wiki graph, organizes the entire tau/TDP-43/C9orf72/FTD disease community.
context.zh-TW: 胞質粒線體 DNA 與胞質染色質片段（來自衰老或 TDP-43 驅動的粒線體破裂）會啟動 cGAS-STING 以驅動第一型干擾素訊息——在 wiki 圖中，此先天免疫軸組織整個 tau/TDP-43/C9orf72/FTD 疾病群落。

context.en-US: Cisplatin induces premature senescence via DNA intrastrand cross-links. Mechanism involves p53-p21 pathway activation and ROS-dependent signaling.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 透過 DNA 鏈內交聯誘發早衰。其機制涉及 p53-p21 路徑活化與 ROS 依賴的訊號傳遞。

context.en-US: Graph node-analysis (networkx/scipy, 15 Aug 2026): COMT sits 1 hop from both Dopamine and Epinephrine with the highest Adamic-Adar latent pull (0.51–0.72) and #3 personalized-PageRank rank for both — the direct enzymatic gateway/hub of catecholamine handling, versus MAO which is peripheral. Graph node-analysis (combined sirtuin/catecholamine drill): COMT is the actual enzymatic gateway to Dopamine (1-hop adjacency, #3 PageRank seed at Dopamine, highest Adamic-Adar), while the sirtuins' dopamine relevance is an aging/neurodegeneration-context phenomenon.
context.zh-TW: 圖譜節點分析（networkx/scipy，2026-08-15）：COMT 距 Dopamine 與 Epinephrine 皆 1 跳，具最高的 Adamic-Adar 潛在連結拉力（0.51–0.72）與兩者皆 #3 的個人化 PageRank 排名——是兒茶酚胺處理的直接酵素樞紐/閘門，相對於周邊的 MAO。 圖譜節點分析（sirtuin/兒茶酚胺合併演練）：COMT 是通往 Dopamine 的真正酵素閘門（1 跳相鄰、Dopamine 種子 #3 PageRank、最高 Adamic-Adar），而 sirtuins 的多巴胺相關性是老化/神經退化脈絡現象。

context.en-US: COMT is the primary clearance route for epinephrine (~60-70% via O-methylation). Competition with the oxidative cyclization pathway determines adrenochrome formation.
context.zh-TW: Catechol-O-methyltransferase（COMT）是兒茶酚胺代謝中的主要酶，它甲基化 epinephrine 的其中一個兒茶酚羥基，使用 S-adenosylmethionine 作為甲基供體將其轉化為 metanephrine。COMT 介導的甲基化是終止 adrenaline 訊號並為其排泄做準備的兩大主要途徑之一，與 MAO 介導的氧化脫胺並行。由於 COMT 迅速清除 adrenaline，epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome 在正常條件下仍是次要的旁路。抑制 COMT 會升高兒茶酚胺濃度，並可使更大比例的 epinephrine 轉向氧化轉化為 adrenochrome。

context.en-US: Graph node-analysis: COMT links directly to Epinephrine (1 hop) and carries the strongest latent link pull (Adamic-Adar 0.721) of any source–target pair, placing it as the systemic catecholamine-metabolism hub in the wiki graph.
context.zh-TW: 圖譜節點分析：COMT 直接連結 Epinephrine（1 跳）並帶有所有來源–標的對中最強的潛在連結拉力（Adamic-Adar 0.721），在 wiki 圖譜中居於系統性兒茶酚胺代謝樞紐。

context.en-US: Daratumumab is a clinically approved IgG1 antibody for multiple myeloma that binds and neutralizes CD38. Potential repurposing at low doses for NAD+ preservation. [HYPOTHESIS: repurposing proposal]
context.zh-TW: Daratumumab 是一種臨床核准的 IgG1 抗體，用於多發性骨髓瘤，可結合並中和 CD38。在低劑量下具有用於 NAD+ 保存的再利用潛力。[HYPOTHESIS: 再利用提案]

context.en-US: DJ-1 is a glutathione-independent glyoxalase that stereospecifically detoxifies methylglyoxal into L-lactate, bypassing the glutathione requirement of the canonical glyoxalase system.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 是一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶，立體專一性地將甲基乙二醛解毒為 L-lactate，繞過典型乙二醛酶系統對麩胱甘肽的需求。

context.en-US: DJ-1 stabilizes Nrf2 by blocking KEAP1, driving GLO1/GLO2 transcription for enhanced dicarbonyl clearance and HO-1/NQO1 for antioxidant defense.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 透過阻斷 KEAP1 穩定 Nrf2，驅動 GLO1/GLO2 轉錄以增強二羰基清除，以及 HO-1/NQO1 以進行抗氧化防禦。

context.en-US: Doxorubicin induces premature senescence across multiple cell lines via DNA intercalation and topoisomerase II poisoning. Effects can be p53-dependent or independent.
context.zh-TW: Doxorubicin 透過 DNA 嵌入與 topoisomerase II 毒化，在多種細胞株中誘發早衰。其效應可為 p53 依賴或非依賴。

context.en-US: ERK phosphorylates BIM at Ser55/Ser65/Ser100, causing inactivation under the control of cytokine IL3.
context.zh-TW: ERK 在 Ser55/Ser65/Ser100 磷酸化 BIM，在細胞激素 IL3 的控制下造成不活化。

context.en-US: ERK1/2 phosphorylates BAX at Thr167, causing inactivation via interaction with Pin1.
context.zh-TW: ERK1/2 在 Thr167 磷酸化 BAX，經由與 Pin1 的交互作用造成不活化。

context.en-US: EX-527 (Selisistat) is the most advanced isoform-selective SIRT1 inhibitor, taken to Phase I/II in Huntington's disease and explored for oncology chemo-sensitization. It is one of the few sirtuin-directed agents to have reached human trials, contrasting with the purely preclinical SIRT2/3/4/5/6/7 chemistry.
context.zh-TW: EX-527（Selisistat）是最先進的異構型選擇性 SIRT1 抑制劑，在亨廷頓氏症中進入第一期／二期，並探討用於腫瘤學化療增敏。它是少數進入人體試驗的 sirtuin 導向藥劑之一，與純粹臨床前的 SIRT2/3/4/5/6/7 化學品形成對比。

context.en-US: Exercise generates acute ROS bursts that drive mitochondrial biogenesis, antioxidant upregulation, and metabolic adaptation via NRF2 and PGC-1alpha. Post-workout high-dose synthetic antioxidants (vitamin C/E) blunt this necessary ROS signal, so letting endogenous adaptation occur is the therapeutic goal.
context.zh-TW: 運動產生急性 ROS 爆發，透過 NRF2 與 PGC-1alpha 驅動粒線體生成、抗氧化上調與代謝適應。運動後高劑量合成抗氧化劑（維生素 C/E）減弱此必要的 ROS 訊號，因此讓內生適應發生是治療目標。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole reduces surface expression of GLUT1, the primary glucose transporter overexpressed in cancer cells, directly impairing glucose uptake and starving tumors.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 降低 GLUT1 的表面表現——GLUT1 是在癌細胞中過度表現的主要葡萄糖轉運蛋白——直接損害葡萄糖攝取並使腫瘤挨餓。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole down-regulates/inhibits HK2, collapsing glycolytic flux and de-repressing apoptosis at the mitochondrial level by detaching HK2 from VDAC.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 下調／抑制 HK2，瓦解糖解通量，並經由將 HK2 從 VDAC 脫離，在粒線體層級去抑制凋亡。

context.en-US: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) = 0.421 — shared Tubulin, Microtubule, Benzimidazole, Glycolysis, Apoptosis — marking the benzimidazoles as a bonded twin-pair whose mechanism claims should be presumed portable until dissociated; Ivermectin is mechanistically distinct (Jaccard 0.178, shared sets mostly indications).
context.zh-TW: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) ＝ 0.421——共享 Tubulin、Microtubule、Benzimidazole、Glycolysis、Apoptosis——把苯並咪唑類標記為鍵合雙胞胎對，機制主張應推定可互通直到被區分；Ivermectin 機制上截然不同（Jaccard 0.178，共享集合多為適應症）。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole binds the colchicine site of β-tubulin, preventing polymerization into microtubules. This causes mitotic spindle disruption, G2/M arrest, and mitotic catastrophe.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 結合 β-tubulin 的 colchicine 位點，阻止聚合為微管。這造成有絲分裂紡錘體破壞、G2/M 停滯與有絲分裂災難。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole down-regulates MDM2 and MdmX, preventing p53 degradation and allowing stabilized p53 to transactivate pro-apoptotic targets (Bax, PUMA, Noxa).
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 下調 MDM2 與 MdmX，防止 p53 降解，使穩定的 p53 能轉活化促凋亡標的（Bax、PUMA、Noxa）。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole downregulates MDM2/MdmX, stabilizing p53, which arrests or apoptoses transduced (reprogramming-competent) cells — p53 is the dominant upstream roadblock to iPSC induction. This is a more direct opposition to rejuvenation than ivermectin's downstream Oct4/Sox2 suppression.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 下調 MDM2/MdmX，穩定 p53，後者使被轉導（具重編程能力）的細胞停滯或凋亡——p53 是 iPSC 誘發的主要上游障礙。這比 ivermectin 下游 Oct4/Sox2 抑制更直接的對抗回春。

context.en-US: Apoptosis and ferroptosis execute through machinery that barely overlaps (caspase cascade + Bcl-2/MOMP vs iron-catalyzed lipid peroxidation + GPX4/FSP1 shields), so resistance to one does not confer resistance to the other — the central therapeutic argument for combining apoptosis- and ferroptosis-targeted strategies.
context.zh-TW: 細胞凋亡與鐵死亡透過幾乎不重疊的機械執行（caspase 級聯＋Bcl-2/MOMP vs 鐵催化脂質過氧化＋GPX4/FSP1 護盾），因此對其一抗性不會轉移為另一的抗性——這是結合凋亡靶向與鐵死亡靶向策略的核心治療論證。

context.en-US: Ferroptosis — iron-catalyzed lipid-peroxidation cell death — is a shared-neighbor wildcard linked to all four major neurodegenerative diseases (AD, PD, HD, ALS) in the wiki graph, driven by the brain's high O2 flux, PUFA-rich membranes and modest antioxidant reserve.
context.zh-TW: 鐵死亡——鐵催化的脂質過氧化細胞死亡——是 wiki 圖中與四大神經退化疾病（AD、PD、HD、ALS）全部相關的共享鄰點萬用牌，由腦的高氧通量、富含 PUFA 的膜與有限的抗氧化儲備所驅動。

context.en-US: Fisetin binds the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins, sensitizing senescent cells to apoptosis. Bcl-2:fisetin binding energy = -22.2 to -35.1 kcal/mol.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 結合抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族蛋白的疏水溝，使衰老細胞對凋亡敏感。Bcl-2:fisetin 結合能為 -22.2 至 -35.1 kcal/mol。

context.en-US: Fisetin is a mixed-type COMT inhibitor with IC50 2.6-5.8 µM. It is also a COMT substrate — itself O-methylated to geraldol — making inhibition concentration-dependent and genotype-sensitive. COMT O-methylates fisetin to geraldol (Poor 2016), consuming SAMe to SAH. This reverse-direction edge complements the established fisetin-inhibits-COMT triple.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 是一種混合型 COMT 抑制劑，IC50 為 2.6–5.8 µM。它也是 COMT 受質——本身被 O-甲基化為 geraldol——使得抑制呈濃度依賴且對基因型敏感。 COMT 將 fisetin O-甲基化為 geraldol（Poor 2016），消耗 SAMe 生成 SAH。此反向邊補充已確立的 fisetin 抑制 COMT triple。

context.en-US: Fisetin is metabolized by COMT to geraldol (3'-O-methylfisetin). This metabolic activation is concentration-dependent and consumes SAMe, generating SAH.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 被 COMT 代謝為 geraldol（3'-O-methylfisetin）。此代謝活化呈濃度依賴，並消耗 SAMe，生成 SAH。

context.en-US: Fisetin reduces circulating SASP factors including CXCL12, partially rescuing age-related endothelial dysfunction. [HYPOTHESIS: limited in vivo data] Upgraded on CXCL12 endothelial-rescue data (PMID 40894771) and Yousefzadeh lifespan/healthspan evidence; suppression is partial and dose-dependent.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 降低循環中的 SASP 因子，包括 CXCL12，部分挽救年齡相關的內皮功能障礙。[HYPOTHESIS: 有限的體內數據] 依 CXCL12 內皮挽救數據（PMID 40894771）與 Yousefzadeh 壽命/健康壽命證據升級；抑制為部分且劑量依賴。

context.en-US: Fisetin, a flavonol, activates SIRT1 via the K-type allosteric mechanism and is also a well-characterized senolytic in the wiki; it increases yeast replicative lifespan by ~33% in the source literature. Its SIRT1 activation is part of the natural-polyphenol STAC cluster.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 是一種黄酮醇，透過 K 型別構機制活化 SIRT1，同時也是 wiki 中特徵明確的 senolytic；在來源文獻中可將酵母複製壽命延長約 33%。其 SIRT1 活化屬於天然多酚類 STAC 群集。

context.en-US: The FSP1-CoQ10-NAD(P)H pathway is a stand-alone parallel system cooperating with GPX4/glutathione to suppress phospholipid peroxidation: losing either axis alone is tolerated, combined inhibition is strongly synergistic (iFSP1 + GPX4 inhibitors trigger ferroptosis, active in hepatocellular carcinoma models).
context.zh-TW: FSP1-CoQ10-NAD(P)H 路徑是與 GPX4/glutathione 合作抑制磷脂過氧化的獨立平行系統：單獨失去任一軸可以容忍，合併抑制有強烈協同作用（iFSP1＋GPX4 抑制劑可啟動鐵死亡，於肝細胞癌模型中有效）。

context.en-US: N-terminal myristoylation recruits FSP1 to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane, the site where lipid peroxidation initiates and propagates — placing the ubiquinol radical trap exactly where the Fenton chain needs to be terminated.
context.zh-TW: N 端十四碳醯化把 FSP1 招募至細胞膜內葉——脂質過氧化起始與傳播的位置——使 ubiquinol 自由基陷阱恰好放置在需終止 Fenton 鏈之處。

context.en-US: FSP1 (AIFM2) is an NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase: it reduces ubiquinone (oxidized CoQ10) to ubiquinol, a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant, at the plasma membrane. This is the GPX4-independent brake on phospholipid peroxidation discovered by Doll et al. (Nature 2019) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 2019).
context.zh-TW: FSP1（AIFM2）是 NAD(P)H:ubiquinone 氧化還原酶：它在細胞膜將 ubiquinone（氧化態 CoQ10）還原成 ubiquinol——一種親脂性自由基捕捉抗氧化劑。這是 Doll et al.（Nature 2019）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 2019）發現的磷脂過氧化非依賴 GPX4 煞車。

context.en-US: FSP1 is a warfarin-resistant vitamin K reductase: it reduces vitamin K to its hydroquinone (VKH2), sustaining a non-canonical vitamin K redox cycle that also supplies a reduced radical-trapping antioxidant — explaining its ability to overcome warfarin poisoning (Mishima et al., Nature 2022).
context.zh-TW: FSP1 是抗 warfarin 的維生素 K 還原酶：它把 vitamin K 還原成氫醌（VKH2），維持供應還原態自由基捕捉抗氧化劑的非典型維生素 K 氧化還原循環——解釋其克服 warfarin 中毒的能力（Mishima et al., Nature 2022）。

context.en-US: Under oxidative stress, peroxiredoxin-mediated oxidation inactivates Thioredoxin-1; the glutaredoxin system reactivates it (Du et al., J Biol Chem 2013). This reversible repair loop delimits, in both directions, how much MnSOD-derived peroxide the thioredoxin arm can tolerate.
context.zh-TW: 在氧化壓力下，過氧化還原酶介導的氧化會使 Thioredoxin-1 失去活性；glutaredoxin 系統將其再活化（Du et al., J Biol Chem 2013）。此可逆修復迴路從兩個方向界定硫氧還原蛋白臂能耐受多少 MnSOD 衍生的過氧化物。

context.en-US: GlyNAC buffers adrenochrome (conf 0.8, primary-grounded): DT-diaphorase maintains adrenochrome in its reduced leuco-form (PMID 2113029) while aminochromes deplete glutathione (PMID 2665188) — placing the GlyNAC/glutathione arm as the redox-buffer counterweight to the adrenochrome trigger.
context.zh-TW: GlyNAC 緩衝 adrenochrome（conf 0.8，一級文獻定錨）：DT-diaphorase 使 adrenochrome 維持於還原態 leuco-形式（PMID 2113029），而 aminochromes 會耗竭 glutathione（PMID 2665188）——使 GlyNAC/glutathione 臂成為 adrenochrome 觸發器的氧化還原緩衝砝碼。

context.en-US: GlyNAC (glycine + N-acetylcysteine) increases glutathione and reduces oxidative stress (round-3 remediation, degree-10 node including 'increases → Glutathione' and 'activates → NRF2'), pulling the redox-buffer arm of the protocol into the glutathione synthesis subgraph.
context.zh-TW: GlyNAC（甘氨酸＋N-乙醯半胱氨酸）提高 glutathione 並降低氧化壓力（第三輪修復，degree-10 節點，含「increases → Glutathione」與「activates → NRF2」），把協定的氧化還原緩衝臂拉入 glutathione 生合成子圖。

context.en-US: Graph-structural finding: GPX4's clique sits at k-core 2 with no direct route into the graph's dense k-core-6 backbone except through Senescent Cells — the ferroptosis redox arm is a peripheral satellite of the senescence core, so ferroptosis effectors rank far lower under PPR seeded at Aging than seeded at Senescent Cells.
context.zh-TW: 圖結構發現：GPX4 的團塊位於 k-core 2，除經 Senescent Cells 外沒有直接路由進入圖的稠密 k-core-6 骨幹——鐵死亡氧化還原臂是衰老核心的外圍衛星，因此在以 Aging 為種子的 PPR 下鐵死亡效應物排名遠低於以 Senescent Cells 為種子。

context.en-US: GPX4 is the canonical GSH-dependent brake on ferroptosis, reducing phospholipid hydroperoxides to harmless alcohols; its inhibition (RSL3, GSH depletion) unleashes iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and ferroptotic cell death. The parallel FSP1-CoQ10 axis provides a GPX4-independent second brake. GPX4 is the ferroptosis brake, uniquely reducing membrane phospholipid, cholesterol and cardiolipin hydroperoxides, and it depends on the catalytic selenium of glutathione-peroxidase-family chemistry. Loss of selenium availability therefore weakens GPX4 and shifts cells toward lipid-peroxidation-driven Ferroptosis, which links the Keshan disease cardiac phenotype to the same selenoprotein axis.
context.zh-TW: GPX4 是鐵死亡上典型的 GSH 依賴煞車，將磷脂氫過氧化物還原為無害醇類；抑制它（RSL3、GSH 耗竭）會釋放鐵依賴的脂質過氧化與鐵死亡。平行的 FSP1-CoQ10 軸提供不依賴 GPX4 的第二煞車。 GPX4 是 Ferroptosis 的煞車，專一性地還原膜磷脂、膽固醇與心磷脂的過氧化物，且其作用依賴 glutathione peroxidase 家族的 selenium 化學。因此 selenium 可利用量不足會削弱 GPX4，把細胞推向以脂質過氧化為主的 Ferroptosis，這也把 Keshan disease 的心臟表型連結到同一條 selenoprotein 軸上。

context.en-US: GPX4 uses glutathione (reduced GSH) to convert phospholipid hydroperoxides to harmless alcohols — the canonical ferroptosis brake. System Xc- (SLC7A11) imports cystine for GSH synthesis, so cystine starvation or RSL3-style GPX4 inhibition collapses this shield and unleashes ferroptosis. The GPX4 repair tier stalls whenever glutathione supply fails, because two glutathione equivalents are consumed per hydroperoxide reduced. Erastin blocks system xc- and collapses cystine uptake so that glutathione synthesis halts and GPX4's substrate vanishes, while RSL3 bypasses glutathione entirely by covalently modifying the selenocysteine. Glutathione depletion converts an aldehyde clearance pathway into a liability.
context.zh-TW: GPX4 使用 glutathione（還原態 GSH）把磷脂氫過氧化物轉成無害醇類——這是鐵死亡的典型煞車。System Xc-（SLC7A11）輸入胱氨酸以合成 GSH，因此胱氨酸飢餓或 RSL3 式 GPX4 抑制會使此護盾崩潰並釋放鐵死亡。 只要 glutathione 供應中斷，GPX4 修復層就會停滯，因為每還原一個過氧化物就消耗兩個 glutathione 當量。Erastin 阻斷 system xc- 讓胱胺酸攝入崩潰，glutathione 合成因而停止、GPX4 的基質消失；而 RSL3 則繞過 glutathione，直接共價修飾 selenocysteine。Glutathione 耗竭會把原本的醛清除路徑轉為危害來源。

context.en-US: GSK3, JNK, and p38 MAPK phosphorylate BAX at Thr167, causing activation in hepatoma cells.
context.zh-TW: GSK3、JNK 與 p38 MAPK 在 Thr167 磷酸化 BAX，在肝細胞癌細胞中造成活化。

context.en-US: Mutant huntingtin (mHTT) uncouples fission from degradation while disrupting autophagic flux. Broad-spectrum autophagy activators like rapamycin may be insufficient if downstream transport remains blocked.
context.zh-TW: 突變 huntingtin（mHTT）使分裂與降解脫鉤，同時破壞自噬流。若下游運輸仍受阻，則 rapamycin 等廣譜自噬活化劑可能不足。

context.en-US: HCQ blocks cytoprotective autophagy in cancer cells and is combined with chemotherapy in clinical trials. Results have been modest and inconsistent across cancer types.
context.zh-TW: HCQ 阻斷癌細胞中的細胞保護性自噬，並在臨床試驗中與化療合併使用。其結果在不同癌種間溫和且不一致。

context.en-US: The hyperfunction theory of aging holds that aging is the quasi-programmed continuation of developmental growth signaling; mTOR is the engine of aging and Rapamycin extends lifespan by suppressing mTOR. This frames the key distinction that arrested growth (OIS) is protective while ongoing, unopposed growth signaling is pathogenic.
context.zh-TW: 老化的功能亢進理論主張，老化是發育生長訊號的準程式化延續；mTOR 是老化的引擎，而 Rapamycin 透過抑制 mTOR 延長壽命。這框定了關鍵區分：停滯的生長（OIS）具保護性，而持續、無對抗的生長訊號具致病性。

context.en-US: IL-6 is a defining component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that drives inflammaging and feed-forward tissue dysfunction (recorded as 'is_a_component_of' 0.96 and 'is_upregulated_in' 0.95 on the parallel pair IL-6 → SASP).
context.zh-TW: IL-6 是衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的定義性組分——衰老細胞促發炎分泌體，驅動發炎性老化與前饋式組織失能（平行對 IL-6 → SASP 上記為「is_a_component_of」0.96 與「is_upregulated_in」0.95）。

context.en-US: Fasting-driven energy deficit activates AMPK, which in turn activates TFEB → lysosomal biogenesis → autophagy and mitochondrial quality control — the hormetic engine linking fasting, mitohormesis and caloric restriction to longevity (2026 Frontiers in Nutrition framing of intermittent fasting as a hormetic signal).
context.zh-TW: 禁食造成的能量赤字活化 AMPK，AMPK 再活化 TFEB → 溶酶體新生 → 自噬與粒線體品質控管——這是連結禁食、mitohormesis 與熱量限制到延壽的荷爾蒙引擎（2026 Frontiers in Nutrition 將間歇性禁食框架為荷爾蒙訊號）。

context.en-US: Intermittent fasting (16:8 or 20:4) is the primary shred-phase tool to drive autophagy, with fasted training maximizing the AMPK signal. Refined sugars and alcohol shut the autophagic process down, so timing and macronutrient strategy are essential to the cleanup benefit. The energy deficit of fasting is the caloric-stress hormetic signal, and the glucose-to-BHB switch is the readout that marks it. AMPK with mTORC1 inhibition, SIRT1 and TFEB then drive autophagy and mitophagy as the effectors, with BDNF-linked neurogenesis and lysosomal biogenesis downstream.
context.zh-TW: 間歇性斷食誘導自噬，作為對其所施加的週期性營養和能量虧損的早期細胞適應。在體外，斷食模擬條件活化自噬機制並同時下調胞外核苷酸酶CD73，改變細胞外腺苷代謝。此誘導主要透過AMPK活化和mTORC1抑制介導，因為在斷食窗口期間營養和胰島素訊號下降。這種自噬的參與被認為是歸因於IF方案的許多細胞保護和抗老化效應的基礎。 禁食造成的能量赤字是熱量壓力上的 hormetic 訊號，而葡萄糖到 BHB 的轉換則是標記它的讀值。接著 AMPK 搭配 mTORC1 抑制、SIRT1 與 TFEB 驅動自噬與粒線體自噬作為效應者，下游則連結 BDNF 相關的神經新生與溶小體生物發生。

context.en-US: Controlled, intermittent mild hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1alpha, the 'hormetic amplifier': in C. elegans mild hypoxia → transient mitochondrial ROS → HIF-1 → positive ROS feedback → AMPK negative feedback → net ROS homeostasis with lifespan extension and enhanced immunity (Li et al., 2024); in mammals it drives erythropoietin, antioxidant and BDNF programs.
context.zh-TW: 受控的間歇性輕度缺氧穩定 HIF-1alpha，即「荷爾蒙放大器」：在 C. elegans 中輕度缺氧 → 短暫粒線體 ROS → HIF-1 → 正回饋 ROS → AMPK 負回饋 → 淨 ROS 恆定並延壽與增強免疫力（Li et al., 2024）；在哺乳類中驅動紅血球生成素、抗氧化與 BDNF 程式。

context.en-US: Effective-resistance and PPR analyses place Ivermectin closest to the Cancer hub (R_eff 0.066, z −1.81; PPR at Cancer ranks Ivermectin #2); its synergy with Cisplatin (and Docetaxel, Paclitaxel) is recorded in the resistance-reversal out-star, though all drug claims carry low confidence (0.65–0.8) versus 0.95+ ontology edges.
context.zh-TW: 有效電阻與 PPR 分析把 Ivermectin 置於最接近 Cancer 樞紐（R_eff 0.066, z −1.81；Cancer 種子 PPR 把 Ivermectin 排 #2）；與 Cisplatin（及 Docetaxel、Paclitaxel）的協同記錄在抗藥性反轉出向之星，但所有藥物主張只帶低信度（0.65–0.8），而本體邊為 0.95 以上。

context.en-US: Ivermectin carries the typed edge 'inhibits → Glioblastoma' (conf 0.8) together with lower-confidence inhibitory edges to Cholangiocarcinoma (0.7) and Renal Cell Carcinoma (0.7); all are multiplicity-1 claims on enormous Adamic–Adar headroom (Ivermectin→Cancer 9.68) — precise intervention statements and curation blind spots at once.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 帶「inhibits → Glioblastoma」類型邊（conf 0.8），另有對 Cholangiocarcinoma（0.7）與 Renal Cell Carcinoma（0.7）的低信度抑制邊；這些都是巨大 Adamic–Adar 空間（Ivermectin→Cancer 9.68）上的 multiplicity-1 主張——既是精準介入陳述也是策展盲點。

context.en-US: PAK1 facilitates NF-kB nuclear activation; ivermectin's PAK1 degradation therefore dampens NF-kB signaling. Because NF-kB is the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, this overlaps with the senomorphic strategy — targeting SASP production without killing senescent cells.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 促進 NF-kB 核活化；ivermectin 的 PAK1 降解因此減弱 NF-kB 訊號。由於 NF-kB 是 SASP 的主控轉錄調節因子，這與 senomorphic 策略——標靶 SASP 產生而不殺死衰老細胞——重疊。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits expression of Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 in cancer stem cells via the PAK1-STAT3 axis. Because Oct4 and Sox2 are core Yamanaka factors, this lowers reprogramming capacity and opposes partial reprogramming, while being therapeutically desirable against CSCs.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 經由 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制癌幹細胞中 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 的表現。由於 Oct4 與 Sox2 是核心 Yamanaka 因子，這降低重編程能力並對抗部分重編程，同時在治療上對抗 CSC 是理想的。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is a potent P-glycoprotein inhibitor, reversing multidrug resistance by blocking drug efflux. Also inhibits MRP1/2/3.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是一種強效的 P-glycoprotein 抑制劑，透過阻斷藥物外排逆轉多重抗藥性。亦抑制 MRP1/2/3。

context.en-US: Ivermectin promotes proteasomal degradation of PAK1 via the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway without affecting PAK1 mRNA levels. This is its primary host kinase target for anticancer effects.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 透過泛素—蛋白酶體途徑促進 PAK1 的蛋白酶體降解，且不影響 PAK1 mRNA 水平。這是其抗癌作用的主要宿主激酶標的。

context.en-US: By suppressing Oct4 and Sox2 via PAK1-STAT3, ivermectin reduces reprogramming capacity and opposes partial reprogramming. Its separate mTOR inhibition/autophagy induction sits in the same longevity space as rapamycin, but the OSKM-suppressive action is counterproductive for epigenetic rejuvenation.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 透過抑制 Oct4 與 Sox2（經由 PAK1-STAT3）降低重編程能力並對抗部分重編程。其分開的 mTOR 抑制／自噬誘發位於與 rapamycin 相同的長壽空間，但 OSKM 抑制性作用對表觀遺傳回春適得其反。

context.en-US: Through PAK1-STAT3, ivermectin downregulates Sox2 (with Oct4 and Nanog), suppressing the transcription factors rejuvenation requires turned on. This is mechanistically opposing to Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation, though exogenous OSKM delivery may partially bypass the suppression.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 經由 PAK1-STAT3 下調 Sox2（與 Oct4 和 Nanog 一起），抑制回春所需的轉錄因子開啟。這在機制上對抗 Yamanaka 因子回春，儘管外源 OSKM 遞送可能部分繞過此抑制。

context.en-US: Ivermectin promotes proteasomal degradation of PAK1, which in turn suppresses STAT3. This damps IL-6 transcription, Th17 inflammaging in aging CD4+ T cells, and the OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 stemness loop — entering the same inflammaging/SASP axis that metformin targets, but via PAK1 rather than AMPK.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 促進 PAK1 的蛋白酶體降解，後者進而抑制 STAT3。這減弱 IL-6 轉錄、老化 CD4+ T 細胞中的 Th17 發炎性老化，以及 OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 幹性迴路——進入 metformin 標靶的相同發炎性老化／SASP 軸，但經由 PAK1 而非 AMPK。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits the PAK1/Akt/mTOR axis, allowing calcineurin to dephosphorylate TFEB (Ser142/211) and drive its nuclear translocation to the CLEAR network, inducing lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic flux. This is the same axis rapamycin, metformin, spermidine, and CR use for healthspan, independent of Yamanaka factors.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 PAK1/Akt/mTOR 軸，使 calcineurin 能去磷酸化 TFEB（Ser142/211）並驅動其核轉位至 CLEAR 網絡，誘發溶酶體生成與自噬流。這與 rapamycin、metformin、spermidine 與 CR 用於健康壽命的同一軸，獨立於 Yamanaka 因子。

context.en-US: Node-analysis of the repurposing cluster lists Ivermectin's out-star broadcasting into signaling suppression — Akt, mTOR, Wnt, YAP1, STAT3, NF-kappaB, PAK1 — alongside cell-death induction, resistance reversal and stemness suppression; YAP1 is among the Hippo-pathway targets (conf 0.7).
context.zh-TW: 重新定位簇的節點分析把 Ivermectin 的出向之星列為廣播到訊號抑制——Akt、mTOR、Wnt、YAP1、STAT3、NF-kappaB、PAK1——同時包含細胞死亡誘發、抗藥性反轉與幹性抑制；YAP1 是 Hippo 路徑標靶之一（conf 0.7）。

context.en-US: JNK and p38 MAPK phosphorylate BIM at Ser65, activating it for pro-apoptotic function.
context.zh-TW: JNK 與 p38 MAPK 在 Ser65 磷酸化 BIM，活化其促凋亡功能。

context.en-US: In K-RAS mutated cancers, hyperactive ERK1/2 phosphorylates and inactivates PTPN5, locking BAK in its inactive phosphorylated state and providing resistance to apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 在 K-RAS 突變的癌症中，過度活化的 ERK1/2 磷酸化並使 PTPN5 失活，將 BAK 鎖定於其不活化的磷酸化狀態，從而產生對凋亡的抗性。

context.en-US: Kaempferol, a flavonol (3,5,7,4'-tetrahydroxyflavone) and sister compound to quercetin/apigenin, directly activates SIRT1 as a natural polyphenol STAC via K-type allosteric Km lowering, and is frequently co-studied for anti-aging and cancer-risk reduction.
context.zh-TW: Kaempferol 是一種黄酮醇（3,5,7,4'-四羥基黄酮），是 quercetin/apigenin 的姊妹化合物，作為天然多酚類 STAC 透過 K 型別構降低 Km 直接活化 SIRT1，常與抗老化和降低癌症風險的研究並提。

context.en-US: The Lands cycle exchanges fatty acids into the sn-2 position of membrane phospholipids. ACase-liberated fatty acids enter this cycle, enriching PUFA-containing species.
context.zh-TW: Lands cycle 將脂肪酸交換至膜磷脂的 sn-2 位置。ACase 釋放的脂肪酸進入此循環，富集含 PUFA 的種類。

context.en-US: Lecanemab (Leqembi) is an FDA-approved anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease with confirmed amyloid; it clears parenchymal Aβ protofibrils and slows cognitive decline by roughly 25–35% while carrying ARIA (edema/microhemorrhage) risk.
context.zh-TW: Lecanemab（Leqembi）是獲 FDA 核准的抗類澱粉單株抗體，用於經確證類澱粉的早期症狀性阿茲海默症；它清除實質 Aβ 原纖維並減緩認知衰退約 25–35%，但帶有 ARIA（水腫／微出血）風險。

context.en-US: LRRK2 directly phosphorylates DRP1 to drive excess mitochondrial fission; since impaired mitophagy (PINK1/Parkin) is a PD mechanism, LRRK2-driven fission couples mitochondrial dynamics to Parkinson's pathology.
context.zh-TW: LRRK2 直接磷酸化 DRP1 以驅動過度的粒線體分裂；由於受損的 mitophagy（PINK1/Parkin）是帕金森氏症機制，LRRK2 驅動的分裂把粒線體動態學與帕金森氏症病理耦合。

context.en-US: Graph node-analysis: MAO (degree 2, k-core 2) reaches Dopamine only through Epinephrine (no direct edge), with ~3–4× larger commute distance and near-null resistance z (Dopamine z = −0.70) — a peripheral metabolic spoke versus COMT's hub status.
context.zh-TW: 圖譜節點分析：MAO（degree 2、k-core 2）僅能透過 Epinephrine 到達 Dopamine（無直接邊），通勤距離約大 3–4 倍且阻力 z 近於零（Dopamine z = −0.70）——相對於 COMT 的樞紐地位，它是周邊的代謝輻條。

context.en-US: Graph node-analysis (and catecholamine biochemistry): MAO has a direct edge to Epinephrine and is the only substantive graph footprint (with Hydrogen Peroxide) linking MAO to the catecholamine lineage; its pull to Dopamine is only indirect via Epinephrine.
context.zh-TW: 圖譜節點分析（及兒茶酚胺生化）：MAO 與 Epinephrine 有直接邊，且是 MAO 連結兒茶酚胺譜系的唯一實質圖譜足跡（與 Hydrogen Peroxide 並列）；其對 Dopamine 的拉力僅經由 Epinephrine 間接產生。

context.en-US: Methylene blue carries the edge 'suppresses → Glycolysis' (conf 0.88) as part of its redox wiring; this metabolic-suppression edge, alongside bypassing Complex I/III and shunting electrons to cytochrome c, frames MB as an ETC-bypass electron shuttle that also rewires cancer metabolism.
context.zh-TW: Methylene blue 帶「suppresses → Glycolysis」邊（conf 0.88）作為其氧化還原佈線的一部分；此代謝抑制邊與繞過 Complex I/III、把電子分流至 cytochrome c 共同把 MB 框架為也重接癌症代謝的 ETC 繞行電子穿梭體。

context.en-US: Methylene blue induces oxidative stress (conf 0.88) and causes hemolysis (conf 0.94) at higher doses, coupling to the adrenochrome module through shared redox/injury bridges (Complex I, Oxidative Stress, Hemolysis) rather than direct chemistry.
context.zh-TW: Methylene blue 在高劑量誘發氧化壓力（conf 0.88）並造成溶血（conf 0.94），透過共享氧化還原／損傷橋樑（Complex I、Oxidative Stress、Hemolysis）而非直接化學作用耦合到 adrenochrome 模組。

context.en-US: Ubiquinone (CoQ10) is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway: MVA supplies the isoprenoid backbone of ubiquinone (the FSP1 substrate) while also supporting selenocysteine-tRNA for GPX4 — so mevalonate flux feeds both ferroptosis brakes through two separable nodes.
context.zh-TW: Ubiquinone（CoQ10）是 mevalonate 路徑的非固醇產物：MVA 供應 ubiquinone（FSP1 受質）的異戊二烯骨架，同時支持 GPX4 的硒代半胱氨酸-tRNA——因此 mevalonate 流量經由兩個可分離節點同時供養兩個鐵死亡煞車。

context.en-US: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
context.zh-TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

context.en-US: Chronic antioxidant supplementation can inhibit the hormetic response and thereby block the cytoprotective adaptations mitohormesis induces. This may explain disappointing antioxidant clinical trials (SELECT, HOPE, Bjelakovic meta-analysis) where large meta-analyses generally failed to show benefit and sometimes suggested increased mortality.
context.zh-TW: 長期抗氧化補充可抑制促效應反應，從而阻斷粒線體促效應通常誘導的細胞保護適應。這可能解釋了抗氧化臨床試驗令人失望的結果，大型薈萃分析通常未能顯示益處，在某些情況下甚至顯示死亡率增加。支持性證據來自人體研究，顯示抗氧化補充劑抑制運動的有益效果，而運動本身被視為輕度壓力源。抗氧化劑可能阻止觸發適應性反應所需的粒線體 ROS 升高。

context.en-US: Mitohormesis is recorded as protecting against ferroptosis (typed edge 'protects_against', conf 0.82, sources triples+wiki): adaptive mitochondrial stress conditioning upregulates the redox defenses — NRF2 targets, glutathione, peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin capacity — that buffer the iron-driven lipid peroxidation ferroptosis requires.
context.zh-TW: Mitohormesis 被記錄為保護對抗鐵死亡（類型邊「protects_against」，conf 0.82，來源 triples+wiki）：適應性粒線體壓力調適上調氧化還原防禦——NRF2 標靶、glutathione、過氧化還原酶／硫氧還原蛋白容量——以緩衝鐵驅動的脂質過氧化（鐵死亡所需）。

context.en-US: Mitohormesis requires a transient, acute ROS pulse as the signal to trigger adaptive cytoprotective responses (catalase upregulation, chaperone expression, UPRmt, mitochondrial biogenesis). Mitochondrial ROS are active signaling molecules rather than mere damage agents; quenching the pulse blocks the entire adaptive program.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體促效應需要短暫、急性的 ROS 脈衝作為觸發適應性細胞保護反應（catalase 上調、伴侶表現、UPRmt、粒線體生成）的訊號。粒線體 ROS 是活躍的訊號分子而非單純的損傷因子；熄滅此脈衝會阻斷整個適應程序。

context.en-US: Mitophagy is a subtype of selective autophagy targeting only damaged/dysfunctional mitochondria. It converges on the same terminal step (autophagosome → lysosome) but differs in selectivity and initiation.
context.zh-TW: Mitophagy 是選擇性自噬的一個亞型，僅靶向受損／功能異常的粒線體。它匯聚於相同的終端步驟（自噬體 → 溶酶體），但在選擇性與起始機制上有所不同。

context.en-US: Mitophagy inhibits ferroptosis (typed edge conf 0.88): selective autophagic clearance of damaged mitochondria removes the organellar source of ROS and redox-active iron, complementing the GPX4/FSP1 brakes. The polarity census records ferroptosis with both pro- and anti-edges, mitochondrial quality control falling on the anti side.
context.zh-TW: Mitophagy 抑制鐵死亡（類型邊 conf 0.88）：選擇性自噬清除受損粒線體可移除 ROS 與具氧化還原活性鐵的胞器來源，補足 GPX4/FSP1 煞車。極性普查記錄鐵死亡同時有促與抗邊，粒線體品質控管落於抗側。

context.en-US: MnSOD (SOD2) dismutates mitochondrial superoxide into hydrogen peroxide (O2- → H2O2), positioning SOD2 as a 'source of H2O2' (He et al., Trends Biochem Sci 2016) rather than merely a superoxide sink. The H2O2 it generates is then the substrate of the peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin water-evolving arm.
context.zh-TW: MnSOD（SOD2）將粒線體超氧化物歧化為過氧化氫（O2- → H2O2），使 SOD2 被定位為「H2O2 的來源」（He et al., Trends Biochem Sci 2016），而非單純的超氧化物清除者。其所產生的 H2O2 隨後成為過氧化還原酶／硫氧還原蛋白產水臂的受質。

context.en-US: In Pérez et al. (Aging Cell 2009), systemic overexpression of MnSOD (with CuZnSOD, catalase, glutathione peroxidase) did not extend mouse lifespan. MnSOD's contribution is essentially catalytic — it must sit inside the hormetic window (the K68 'Goldilocks' acetylation dial), and its overexpression buffers ROS without unlocking new signal.
context.zh-TW: 在 Pérez et al.（Aging Cell 2009）中，全身性 MnSOD（與 CuZnSOD、catalase、glutathione peroxidase）過度表現並未延長小鼠壽命。MnSOD 的貢獻本質上是催化性的——必須落在荷爾蒙窗口內（K68「金髮姑娘」乙醯化旋鈕），過度表現只是線性緩衝 ROS，不會開啟新訊號。

context.en-US: MnSOD and the thioredoxin system are not redundant free-radical sponges but the two chemically coupled halves of one compartmentalized peroxide-relay (SOD2 → H2O2 → Prx3/Trx2 → H2O). The coupling is metabolic (shared H2O2/Prx stream) and regulatory (shared FOXO/Nrf2/sirtuin programs), not a direct protein interaction.
context.zh-TW: MnSOD 與硫氧還原蛋白系統並非多餘的自由基海綿，而是單一區域化過氧化物傳遞鏈（SOD2 → H2O2 → Prx3/Trx2 → H2O）的兩個化學耦合半部。耦合是代謝性（共享 H2O2/Prx 流）與調控性（共享 FOXO/Nrf2/sirtuin 程式）的，而非直接蛋白質交互作用。

context.en-US: During a bulk (anabolism) phase, high nutrient availability activates mTORC1, promoting protein synthesis and growth but naturally suppressing autophagy. The shred scenario instead leverages nutrient scarcity to inhibit mTOR and maximize autophagic housecleaning and fat oxidation.
context.zh-TW: 在整體（合成代謝）期間，高營養可用性活化 mTORC1，促進蛋白質合成與生長但自然抑制自噬。削減（shred）情境則利用營養匱乏抑制 mTOR 並最大化自噬清理與脂肪氧化。

context.en-US: In triple-negative breast cancer the MUC1-C/xCT(SLC7A11)/CD44v complex sustains glutathione and suppresses ferroptosis; inhibiting MUC1-C kills TNBC cells or reduces self-renewal — one documented route by which tumors defend the lipid-peroxidation shield.
context.zh-TW: 在三陰性乳癌中 MUC1-C/xCT(SLC7A11)/CD44v 複合物維持 glutathione 並抑制鐵死亡；抑制 MUC1-C 可殺死 TNBC 細胞或降低自我更新——這是腫瘤防禦脂質過氧化護盾的紀錄在案路徑。

context.en-US: In C. elegans, glucose restriction normally raises mitochondrial respiration and ROS, inducing catalase and extending lifespan; NAC pre-treatment completely abolished both the ROS rise and the longevity benefit. NAC is the strongest direct evidence that scavenging the ROS signal blocks mitohormesis.
context.zh-TW: 在 C. elegans 中，葡萄糖限制通常升高粒線體呼吸與 ROS，誘發 catalase 並延長壽命；NAC 預處理完全廢除 ROS 升高與長壽益處。NAC 是最強的直接證據，顯示清除 ROS 訊號會阻斷粒線體促效應。

context.en-US: Beyond ROS scavenging, NAC is a selective inhibitor of the peroxidase activity of PRDX6 (IC50 ~15.5 uM), a distinct antioxidant-enzyme interaction. This dual action underscores why NAC, used as a timed redox buffer in hormetic protocols, can also blunt adaptive signaling when taken chronically.
context.zh-TW: 除 ROS 清除外，NAC 是 PRDX6 過氧化物酶活性的選擇性抑制劑（IC50 ~15.5 uM），一種不同的抗氧化酵素交互作用。此雙重作用說明為何在促效應方案中使用作為定時 redox 緩衝的 NAC，長期服用時亦能減弱適應性訊號。

context.en-US: Graph arm B: Neuromelanin sequesters catecholamine oxidation products including adrenochrome/aminochromes ('Neuromelanin --sequesters--> Adrenochrome', conf 0.8) — the protective accumulation that becomes a pathogenic threshold once its burden exceeds the late-life ceiling.
context.zh-TW: 圖臂 B：Neuromelanin 隔離兒茶酚胺氧化產物，包括 adrenochrome/aminochromes（「Neuromelanin --sequesters--> Adrenochrome」，conf 0.8）——一旦負載超過晚年天花板，此保護性累積就成為致病閾值。

context.en-US: Neuromelanin binds and chelates redox-active iron in the substantia nigra, buffering toxic metal deposition; this protective capacity inverts once the intracellular neuromelanin burden crosses the pathogenic threshold, when iron-redox cycling and proteostasis collapse converge to drive Parkinson's disease.
context.zh-TW: Neuromelanin 在黑質中結合並螯合具氧化還原活性的鐵，緩衝毒性金屬沉積；一旦胞內 neuromelanin 負載超過致病閾值，鐵氧化還原循環與蛋白質恆定崩潰匯合驅動帕金森氏症，此保護能力即反轉。

context.en-US: Neuromelanin is a characteristic marker of Parkinson's disease: PD selectively kills the most neuromelanin-laden dopaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra pars compacta; the pathogenic-threshold model posits neuromelanin is protective until its burden crosses a late-life ceiling. Neuromelanin-sensitive MRI is an emerging PD biomarker.
context.zh-TW: Neuromelanin 是帕金森氏症的特徵性標記：PD 選擇性殺死黑質緻密部中負載最多 neuromelanin 的多巴胺神經元；致病閾值模型主張 neuromelanin 在負載跨過晚年天花板前具有保護作用。Neuromelanin 敏感 MRI 是新興 PD 生物標記。

context.en-US: Activated neutrophils oxidize local epinephrine to adrenochrome via ROS and myeloperoxidase, accounting for >80% of adrenaline oxidation in neutrophil-rich environments. [HYPOTHESIS: quantitative claim]
context.zh-TW: Neutrophils are polymorphonuclear leukocytes whose respiratory burst generates large amounts of reactive oxygen species, including superoxide and hydroxyl radicals。Both stimulated neutrophils and cell-free granulocyte homogenates oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome through a radical chain process, and medium released from activated cells can oxidize adrenaline extracellularly。This oxidation can account for more than 80% of adrenaline breakdown in certain inflammatory conditions, far outpacing the normal enzymatic routes such as catechol-O-methyltransferase and monoamine oxidase。Superoxide dismutase and catalase inhibit the reaction, confirming its dependence on reactive oxygen species。This mechanism provides a cellular basis for adrenochrome formation wherever neutrophils accumulate。

context.en-US: NMN's only stored triple before remediation was 'restores → Intestinal Stem Cell' (conf 0.9), leaving it a degree-1 stub outside the giant component; the round-3 remediation unified NMN into the canonical Nicotinamide Mononucleotide node (degree 31) to join the NAD+ fuel-line subgraph.
context.zh-TW: 修復前 NMN 唯一儲存的 triple 是「restores → Intestinal Stem Cell」（conf 0.9），使其成為巨型組件外的 degree-1 殘株；第三輪修復把 NMN 統一進典型 Nicotinamide Mononucleotide 節點（degree 31）以加入 NAD+ 燃料線子圖。

context.en-US: Round-2 fuel-line trace: Nicotinamide Riboside carries the typed edge 'reduces → Neuroinflammation' (conf 0.9); NR reaches the adrenochrome trigger via 8 co-shortest paths (bridges SIRT1, SIRT3, TNFalpha, IL-6, Neuroinflammation, Amyloid Beta, Hematopoietic Stem Cell), PPR #86 — though 7 of 8 paths terminated on a contested NF-kappaB edge.
context.zh-TW: 第二輪燃料線追蹤：Nicotinamide Riboside 帶類型邊「reduces → Neuroinflammation」（conf 0.9）；NR 經 8 條同等最短路（橋樑 SIRT1、SIRT3、TNFalpha、IL-6、Neuroinflammation、Amyloid Beta、Hematopoietic Stem Cell）到達 adrenochrome 觸發器，PPR #86——但 8 條中有 7 條終止於有爭議的 NF-kappaB 邊。

context.en-US: NR (nicotinamide riboside) is an NAD+ precursor that restores SIRT activity. NAD+ repletion via NR restores sirtuin function depleted by adrenochrome redox cycling.
context.zh-TW: NR（nicotinamide riboside）是一種 NAD+ 前驅物，可恢復 SIRT 活性。透過 NR 補充 NAD+ 能恢復被 adrenochrome 氧化還原循環耗竭的 sirtuin 功能。

context.en-US: Nrf2 drives SIRT6 transcription via ARE in its promoter. SIRT6 co-activates Nrf2, creating a feed-forward amplification loop for antioxidant defense.
context.zh-TW: Nrf2 透過其啟動子中的 ARE 驅動 SIRT6 轉錄。SIRT6 共活化 Nrf2，形成抗氧化防禦的前饋放大迴路。

context.en-US: Sulfiredoxin is Nrf2-induced, creating a feed-forward loop: low-grade oxidative stress activates NRF2, which raises Srx expression, which rescues hyperoxidized Prx — the execution arm that translates mild stress into greater buffering capacity (hormetic memory).
context.zh-TW: Sulfiredoxin 受 Nrf2 誘導，形成前饋迴路：低度氧化壓力活化 NRF2，使其提高 Srx 表現，Srx 再救回過度氧化的 Prx——這是把溫和壓力轉譯為更強緩衝能力（荷爾蒙記憶）的執行臂。

context.en-US: OIS derepresses the CDKN2A locus to upregulate p16INK4A, reinforcing the p16/Rb cell-cycle arrest that locks the benign lesion in a permanent frozen, tumor-suppressive state. This p16-mediated arrest is the mechanistic backbone of the protective benign nevus.
context.zh-TW: OIS 去抑制 CDKN2A 基因座以上調 p16INK4A，強化將良性病灶鎖定於永久性凍結、腫瘤抑制狀態的 p16/Rb 細胞週期停滯。此 p16 介導的停滯是保護性良性痣的機制骨幹。

context.en-US: Oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) is the permanent cell-cycle arrest triggered in cells carrying BRAF/RAS/MYC mutations. The benign melanocytic nevus (mole) is the in-vivo embodiment of OIS and prevents melanoma; bypass of OIS via p53/PTEN loss or TERT activation is required for malignancy. Capped, arrested growth is therefore tumor-suppressive.
context.zh-TW: 致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS）是在帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 突變的細胞中觸發的永久性細胞週期停滯。良性黑色素細胞痣（痣）是 OIS 的體內體現，並防止黑色素瘤；經由 p53/PTEN 缺失或 TERT 活化繞過 OIS 是惡性化所必需的。受封頂、停滯的生長因此是腫瘤抑制性的。

context.en-US: OIS cells in benign/premalignant lesions are vulnerable to Navitoclax-class senolytics. Eliminating them may paradoxically promote tumor growth by removing a cell-autonomous cancer barrier — the senolytic paradox — so retaining certain benign tumors is functionally protective against cancer.
context.zh-TW: 良性／癌前病灶中的 OIS 細胞易受 Navitoclax 類去衰老藥物攻擊。清除它們可能矛盾地透過移除細胞自主的癌症屏障而促進腫瘤生長——即去衰老悖論——因此保留某些良性腫瘤在功能上對抗癌症具保護性。

context.en-US: OPA1 is the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase with 8 splice variants processed by OMA1 (stress) and YME1L (constitutive). Cardiolipin is required for OPA1-mediated fusion.
context.zh-TW: OPA1 是內粒線體膜融合 GTPase，具有 8 個剪接變異體，由 OMA1（壓力下）與 YME1L（組成性）加工。Cardiolipin 是 OPA1 介導融合所必需的。

context.en-US: In ferroptosis the p53 polarity flips relative to apoptosis: p53 actively promotes ferroptotic death by repressing SLC7A11 (cystine import) and transactivating SAT1 → ALOX15, sensitizing cells to iron-dependent lipid peroxidation — the same tumor suppressor that brakes apoptosis now drives ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: 在鐵死亡中 p53 極性相對細胞凋亡反轉：p53 藉抑制 SLC7A11（胱氨酸輸入）與轉活化 SAT1 → ALOX15 積極促進鐵死亡，使細胞對鐵依賴脂質過氧化敏感——這個在細胞凋亡中踩剎車的腫瘤抑制子在鐵死亡中反而驅動細胞死亡。

context.en-US: p53 is the most significant biological barrier to efficient iPSC induction: damage activates p53, which initiates apoptosis or senescence in transduced cells, sharply reducing reprogramming yield. Fenbendazole's p53 stabilization therefore directly undermines epigenetic rejuvenation strategies requiring reprogramming.
context.zh-TW: p53 是高效 iPSC 誘發最重要的生物屏障：損傷活化 p53，後者啟動轉導細胞中的凋亡或衰老，大幅降低重編程產量。Fenbendazole 的 p53 穩定因此直接破壞需要重編程的表觀遺傳回春策略。

context.en-US: SQSTM1/p62-mediated selective autophagy directly degrades p16 and p21 (independent of UPS), reversing the senescent phenotype in canine MMVD valve cells. Qualification: evidence from Tang 2025 canine MMVD valve interstitial cells; tissue-specific, not yet generic mammalian.
context.zh-TW: SQSTM1/p62 介導的選擇性自噬直接降解 p16 與 p21（不依賴 UPS），逆轉犬隻 MMVD 瓣膜細胞中的衰老表型。 限定：證據來自 Tang 2025 犬 MMVD 瓣膜間質細胞；組織特異，尚未通用於哺乳類。

context.en-US: PAK2 directly binds and phosphorylates Caspase-7 at Ser30, Thr173, and Ser239, neutralizing its effector function and promoting survival in breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: PAK2 直接結合並在 Ser30、Thr173 與 Ser239 磷酸化 Caspase-7，中和其效應器功能並在乳癌中促進存活。

context.en-US: PARK7 mutations (L166P, M26I) cause early-onset autosomal recessive Parkinson's disease. DJ-1-deficient neurons show fragmented mitochondria, Complex I impairment, and accelerated α-synuclein aggregation.
context.zh-TW: PARK7 突變（L166P、M26I）造成早發性體染色體隱性遺傳帕金森氏症。DJ-1 缺失的神經元呈現粒線體碎片化、Complex I 功能受損與 α-synuclein 聚集加速。

context.en-US: Peroxiredoxin 3 (Prx3) is the principal mitochondrial matrix H2O2 and peroxynitrite scavenger; MnSOD-derived peroxide is reduced by Prx3 to water. Hyperoxidation of Prx3 (the 'floodgate') turns low-level H2O2 into a hormetic signal that Sulfiredoxin repair resets.
context.zh-TW: 過氧化還原酶 3（Prx3）是粒線體基質最主要的 H2O2 與過氧亞硝酸鹽清除者；MnSOD 衍生的過氧化物由 Prx3 還原成水。Prx3 的過氧化（「閘門」機制）使低濃度 H2O2 成為荷爾蒙訊號，並由 Sulfiredoxin 修復重設。

context.en-US: PGC-1α drives MnSOD expression, which then feeds sirtuins. This is the SIRT3-mediated activation axis forming the enzymatic defense against adrenochrome-generated ROS. PGC-1alpha drives MnSOD expression as the mitochondrial biogenesis arm of antioxidant defense. ASCII spelling matches the existing PGC-1alpha triples to avoid a node split.
context.zh-TW: PGC-1α 驅動 MnSOD 的表現，進而供養 sirtuin。這是 SIRT3 介導的活化軸，構成對抗 adrenochrome 所產生活性氧物種的酵素防禦。 PGC-1alpha 驅動 MnSOD 表現，作為抗氧化防禦的粒線體生成臂。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有 PGC-1alpha triple 以免節點分裂。

context.en-US: PGC-1alpha-driven TFEB activation rescues Huntington's disease proteotoxicity: TFEB is the master transcription factor for autophagic/lysosomal biogenesis, and PGC-1alpha (downregulated by mutant huntingtin) is the metabolic co-activator that sustains it — restoring both is the HD therapeutic bet.
context.zh-TW: PGC-1alpha 驅動的 TFEB 活化能救回亨廷頓舞蹈症的蛋白毒性：TFEB 是自噬／溶酶體新生的主轉錄因子，而 PGC-1alpha（受突變 huntingtin 下調）是維持它的代謝共活化子——恢復兩者是 HD 的治療下注。

context.en-US: Pin1 binding to phosphorylated BAX (Thr167) catalyzes a conformational change that locks Bax in an inactive state, preventing mitochondrial translocation and MOMP.
context.zh-TW: Pin1 與磷酸化的 BAX（Thr167）結合，催化構形變化，將 Bax 鎖定於不活化狀態，阻止粒線體轉位與 MOMP。

context.en-US: PINK1 promotes fission via DRP1 S616 phosphorylation but also supports fusion (stabilizing OPA1, modulating MFN2). Its effects are species/cell-type dependent. [HYPOTHESIS: context-dependent paradox]
context.zh-TW: PINK1 透過 DRP1 S616 磷酸化促進分裂，但也支持融合（穩定 OPA1、調節 MFN2）。其效應依物種／細胞類型而異。[HYPOTHESIS: 情境依賴的矛盾]

context.en-US: PINK1 stabilization on depolarized mitochondria triggers a positive-feedback threshold for Parkin recruitment, initiating mitophagy. Sub-threshold stress does not engage the pathway.
context.zh-TW: PINK1 在去極化粒線體上的穩定化，觸發 Parkin 招募的正回饋閾值，起始 mitophagy。未達閾值的壓力則不會啟動該途徑。

context.en-US: PLK3 phosphorylates BCL-XL at Ser49, causing cell cycle G2 arrest in lymphoma cells.
context.zh-TW: PLK3 在 Ser49 磷酸化 BCL-XL，在淋巴瘤細胞中造成細胞週期 G2 停滯。

context.en-US: PPARalpha transcriptionally activates FSP1; PPARalpha agonists (fenofibrate, bezafibrate) raise FSP1 and ferroptosis resistance, while the MDM2/MDMX complex suppresses FSP1 by inhibiting PPARalpha — making FSP1 expression a regulated determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity.
context.zh-TW: PPARalpha 在轉錄層活化 FSP1；PPARalpha 促效劑（fenofibrate、bezafibrate）提高 FSP1 與鐵死亡抗性，而 MDM2/MDMX 複合物藉抑制 PPARalpha 抑制 FSP1——使 FSP1 表現成為鐵死亡敏感性的受調控決定因子。

context.en-US: PTPN5 (STEP), along with PTPN2 and PTPN23, dephosphorylates BAK at Tyr108, licensing it for mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization and apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: PTPN5（STEP）與 PTPN2、PTPN23 一起，在 Tyr108 去磷酸化 BAK，使其獲得粒線體外膜通透化與凋亡的許可。

context.en-US: Beyond direct K-type SIRT1 activation, quercetin (with apigenin) inhibits CD38, an NAD+ hydrolase, thereby boosting cellular NAD+ availability — a NAD+-boosting mechanism distinct from allostery. This dual role means quercetin sits in both the direct-STAC and the NAD+-modulator camps.
context.zh-TW: 除了直接 K 型活化 SIRT1，quercetin（與 apigenin）還抑制 CD38（一種 NAD+ 水解酶），從而提升細胞 NAD+ 可及性——這是不同於別構的 NAD+ 提升機制。此雙重角色使 quercetin 同時處於直接 STAC 與 NAD+ 調節劑兩個陣營。

context.en-US: High-catechol flavonoids such as quercetin, fisetin, and luteolin can inhibit COMT, leading to catecholamine accumulation and worrier-type symptoms during a bulk phase. Slow-COMT individuals are especially advised to avoid these during high catecholamine turnover to prevent adrenochrome pathway fueling.
context.zh-TW: 高兒茶酚類黃酮如 quercetin、fisetin 與 luteolin 可抑制 COMT，導致兒茶酚胺累積與整體期間的憂慮者型（worrier-type）症狀。慢 COMT 個體特別建議在高兒茶酚胺周轉期間避免這些，以防止 adrenochrome 路徑燃料供應。

context.en-US: Quercetin is a flavonol that directly activates SIRT1 via the K-type allosteric mechanism (lowering Km for NAD+ and substrate), placing it among the natural polyphenol STACs alongside resveratrol, piceatannol, butein, fisetin and kaempferol. It also independently boosts SIRT1 by inhibiting CD38 and raising NAD+, giving it a dual (direct STAC + NAD+-modulator) role.
context.zh-TW: Quercetin 是一種黄酮醇，透過 K 型別構機制（降低 NAD+ 與受質的 Km）直接活化 SIRT1，與白藜蘆醇、piceatannol、butein、fisetin、kaempferol 同屬天然多酚類 STACs。它也能透過抑制 CD38、提升 NAD+ 來獨立增強 SIRT1，因此兼具雙重角色（直接 STAC + NAD+ 調節劑）。

context.en-US: In the triples graph's parallel-relation inventory, Rapamycin → Lifespan carries both 'extends' (0.96) and 'extends_lifespan_in' (0.96) edges encoding the rapamycin longevity literature (mTOR inhibition); the pair-level union keeps a single relation for the default combined dataset.
context.zh-TW: 在 triples 圖的平行關係清單中，Rapamycin → Lifespan 同時帶有「extends」（0.96）與「extends_lifespan_in」（0.96）兩條邊，編碼 rapamycin 延壽文獻（mTOR 抑制）；成對聯集在預設 combined 資料集中保留單一關係。

context.en-US: mTOR-dependent autophagy induction by rapamycin attenuates senescence, lowers CDKN2A/p16 and CDKN1A/p21, and reduces SASP in canine MMVD valve interstitial cells.
context.zh-TW: Rapamycin 透過 mTOR 依賴的自噬誘導減緩衰老，降低 CDKN2A/p16 與 CDKN1A/p21，並在犬隻 MMVD 瓣膜間質細胞中減少 SASP。

context.en-US: Resveratrol acts as a competitive inhibitor of cAMP phosphodiesterases (PDE4), leading to cAMP accumulation, Epac1 activation, Ca2+ release, and AMPK activation.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 作為 cAMP 磷酸二酯酶（PDE4）的競爭性抑制劑，導致 cAMP 累積、Epac1 活化、Ca2+ 釋放與 AMPK 活化。

context.en-US: Resveratrol is a SIRT1-activating compound (STAC) evaluated clinically with mixed results and now largely a research/nutraceutical. As a SIRT1 activator it improves insulin sensitivity and opposes several age-related diseases, though in bulk-phase physiology it protects the epigenome without inhibiting COMT.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 是一種 SIRT1 活化化合物（STAC），臨床評估結果好壞參半，現在主要為研究／營養保健品。作為 SIRT1 活化劑，它改善胰島素敏感性並對抗多種年齡相關疾病，儘管在整體相（bulk-phase）生理學中它保護表觀基因組而不抑制 COMT。

context.en-US: Graph arm A: reactive oxygen species drive epinephrine oxidation into adrenochrome ('ROS --generates--> Adrenochrome', conf 0.9) — the chemical bridge through which Mitohormesis (requiring ROS) couples to the catecholamine-oxidation damage module.
context.zh-TW: 圖臂 A：活性氧物種驅動腎上腺素氧化為 adrenochrome（「ROS --generates--> Adrenochrome」，conf 0.9）——這是使 Mitohormesis（需要 ROS）耦合兒茶酚胺氧化損傷模組的化學橋樑。

context.en-US: RSK phosphorylates APAF-1 at Ser268, causing inhibition in prostate cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: RSK 在 Ser268 磷酸化 APAF-1，在攝護腺癌細胞中造成抑制。

context.en-US: The combined layer carries the single typed edge 'sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism', which pulls the virus into the CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging attribute space; severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion confirmed in 2020–21 literature (Heer et al., JBC 2020) — a mechanistic corridor the triples layer still lacks.
context.zh-TW: combined 層攜帶單一類型邊「sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism」，把病毒拉入 CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging 屬性空間；重症 COVID-19 驅動的 CD38-NADase 介導 NAD+ 耗竭已由 2020–21 文獻證實（Heer et al., JBC 2020），是 triples 層仍缺乏的機制走廊。

context.en-US: The immune system clears oncogene-induced senescent cells in benign lesions; surveillance failure accelerates tumorigenesis. p16/p21 double-knockout raises cancer rates, evidencing that senescence in benign/premalignant lesions is tumor-suppressive and that retaining it is beneficial.
context.zh-TW: 免疫系統清除良性病灶中的致癌基因誘發衰老細胞；監測失敗加速腫瘤發生。p16/p21 雙重基因敲除提高癌症率，證明良性／癌前病灶中的衰老具腫瘤抑制性，且保留它是有益的。

context.en-US: SHP1 (PTPN6) removes inhibitory phosphate groups from Caspase-8 at Tyr380/397/465, restoring the cell's sensitivity to death ligands TRAIL and FasL.
context.zh-TW: SHP1（PTPN6）移除 Caspase-8 在 Tyr380/397/465 的抑制性磷酸基團，恢復細胞對死亡配體 TRAIL 與 FasL 的敏感性。

context.en-US: Graph node-analysis: SIRT1 depends on a single bridge (NF-κB) to reach Adrenochrome, a single point of failure, whereas SIRT3 has two independent routes. By flow metrics (PPR #63, lowest effective resistance 0.094) SIRT1 is nevertheless the closest sirtuin to Adrenochrome.
context.zh-TW: 圖譜節點分析：SIRT1 依賴單一橋樑（NF-κB）到達 Adrenochrome，為單點失效；而 SIRT3 有兩條獨立路徑。然而依流量指標（PPR #63、最低有效電阻 0.094）SIRT1 仍是距 Adrenochrome 最近的 sirtuin。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is overexpressed in HPV-infected cervical cancer cells and nullifies AIM2 inflammasome-mediated immunity, correlating with poor clinical outcomes. This immunosuppressive action allows cervical cancer cells to evade inflammasome-driven clearance, positioning SIRT1 as an oncogenic factor in HPV-driven cervical cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在 HPV 感染的子宮頸癌細胞中過度表現，並使 AIM2 發炎體介導的免疫失效，與不良臨床結果相關。此免疫抑制作用使子宮頸癌細胞逃避免炎體驅動的清除，將 SIRT1 定位為 HPV 驅動子宮頸癌中的致癌因子。

context.en-US: SIRT1 shows an inverse serum and saliva relationship with Alzheimer's disease, giving it diagnostic potential as a peripheral biomarker. Lower peripheral SIRT1 accompanies AD pathology, while brain SIRT1 reduces amyloid-beta-induced senescence and mitochondrial dysfunction. SIRT6 shows the same inverse serum/saliva relationship with AD, suggesting a shared peripheral readout for the protective sirtuins.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 與阿茲海默症呈現相反的血清與唾液關係，賦予其作為周邊生物標記的診斷潛力。較低的周邊 SIRT1 伴隨 AD 病理，而腦 SIRT1 減少類澱粉-beta 誘發的衰老與粒線體功能障礙。SIRT6 與 AD 呈現相同的血清／唾液反比關係，暗示保護性 sirtuin 共享的周邊讀數。

context.en-US: SIRT1 protects against atherosclerosis through multiple mechanisms: endothelial SIRT1 overexpression activates eNOS, SRT1720 activation ameliorates endothelial dysfunction, and SIRT1 reduces Lox-1-mediated foam cell formation via NF-kB. It also protects vascular smooth muscle cells from DNA damage via NBS1. Collectively SIRT1 is a consistent anti-atherosclerotic factor in the endothelium and vasculature.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過多種機制保護對抗動脈粥樣硬化：內皮 SIRT1 過度表現活化 eNOS、SRT1720 活化改善內皮功能障礙，且 SIRT1 經由 NF-kB 減少 Lox-1 介導的泡沫細胞形成。它亦透過 NBS1 保護血管平滑肌細胞免於 DNA 損傷。整體而言，SIRT1 在內皮與血管中是穩定的抗動脈粥樣硬化因子。

context.en-US: SIRT1 enhances beneficial autophagy in Alzheimer's disease by deacetylating Beclin-1, and in Parkinson's disease it ameliorates LC3-deacetylation-mediated autophagic degradation of alpha-synuclein to improve motor defects. Pro-autophagic SIRT1 action thereby helps clear pathological protein aggregates in neurodegeneration.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 Beclin-1 增強阿茲海默症中的有益自噬，且在帕金森氏症中改善 LC3 去乙醯化介導的 alpha-synuclein 自噬降解以改進運動缺陷。促自噬的 SIRT1 作用因此有助清除神經退化中的病理蛋白聚集體。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is elevated in breast cancer tissue versus adjacent normal tissue and predicts poor prognosis. In triple-negative breast cancer it regulates EMT-associated programming that drives invasion and metastasis, while also repressing ER-alpha-mediated estrogen proliferative responses. It promotes metadherin-driven chemoresistance and causes tamoxifen resistance through MRP2 upregulation via FoxO1 deacetylation, so SIRT1 inhibition augments paclitaxel and doxorubicin cytotoxicity.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在乳癌組織中相較於鄰近正常組織升高，並預測不良預後。在三陰性乳癌中，它調節驅動侵犯與轉移的 EMT 相關編程，同時也抑制 ER-alpha 介導的雌激素增生反應。它促進 metadherin 驅動的化療抗性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化上調 MRP2 造成 tamoxifen 抗性，因此抑制 SIRT1 可增強 paclitaxel 與 doxorubicin 的細胞毒性。

context.en-US: SIRT1 has a dose-dependent dual effect in angiotensin II-induced cardiac hypertrophy: low (2.5x) and moderate (7.5x) overexpression attenuate hypertrophy while high (12.5x) overexpression exacerbates it. Protective mechanisms include reduced apoptosis and promoted autophagy plus PKC-zeta inhibition, whereas the harmful arm operates through Akt/PDK1 membrane localization. SIRT1 therefore protects or harms the heart depending on expression level.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在血管張力素 II 誘發的心臟肥大中具有劑量依賴的雙重效應：低（2.5 倍）與中（7.5 倍）度過度表現減輕肥大，而高（12.5 倍）度過度表現加劇之。保護機制包括減少凋亡、促進自噬以及 PKC-zeta 抑制，而有害臂則透過 Akt/PDK1 膜定位運作。因此 SIRT1 依表現水平保護或傷害心臟。

context.en-US: SIRT1 suppresses Caspase-1 (pyroptosis) via the NRF2/PGC-1alpha axis, and suppresses Caspase-3/Caspase-7 via FOXO4, establishing sirtuins as upstream brakes on both apoptotic and pyroptotic execution; SIRT2 is the exception that promotes apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 經由 NRF2/PGC-1alpha 軸抑制 Caspase-1（細胞焦亡），並經由 FOXO4 抑制 Caspase-3/Caspase-7，使 sirtuins 成為細胞凋亡與焦亡執行的上游煞車；SIRT2 是特例，會促進細胞凋亡。

context.en-US: SIRT1 promotes T-ALL progression by deacetylating CDK2, which drives p27 phosphorylation and degradation, and SIRT1 knockdown sensitizes AML to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. SIRT2 activation by NAMPT reduces proliferation and induces apoptosis in AML blasts via the Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin axis, showing opposing leukemic roles for the two sirtuins.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 CDK2 促進 T-ALL 進展，後者驅動 p27 磷酸化與降解，且 SIRT1 敲低使 AML 對酪胺酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。SIRT2 經由 NAMPT 活化透過 Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin 軸減少增生並誘發 AML 母細胞凋亡，顯示兩個 sirtuin 相反的白血病角色。

context.en-US: SIRT1 and SIRT6 both deacetylate the lipogenic transcription factors ChREBP and SREBP-1c to maintain hepatic lipid homeostasis and oppose fatty liver disease. SIRT1 additionally antagonizes liver fibrosis by blocking hepatic stellate cell activation, while hepatocyte-specific SIRT6 knockout elevates fibrosis and oxidative stress in NASH mice.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 與 SIRT6 皆去乙醯化脂生成轉錄因子 ChREBP 與 SREBP-1c 以維持肝臟脂質穩態並對抗脂肪肝疾病。SIRT1 亦透過阻斷肝星狀細胞活化對抗肝纖維化，而肝細胞專一性 SIRT6 基因敲除在 NASH 小鼠中升高纖維化與氧化壓力。

context.en-US: SIRT1 promotes cisplatin resistance in lung cancer via VEGF-A signaling, whereas SIRT2 upregulation and SIRT3 (via the FoxO3/CDT1 axis) each increase cisplatin sensitivity. SIRT3 also promotes DNA repair and radioresistance through ATM-Chk2. The opposing SIRT1 vs SIRT2/SIRT3 actions define the chemo-resistance balance in NSCLC.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在肺癌中透過 VEGF-A 訊號促進 cisplatin 抗性，而 SIRT2 上調與 SIRT3（經由 FoxO3/CDT1 軸）各自增加 cisplatin 敏感性。SIRT3 亦透過 ATM-Chk2 促進 DNA 修復與放射抗性。相反的 SIRT1 對 SIRT2/SIRT3 作用定義了 NSCLC 中的化療抗性平衡。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is substantially decreased in COPD and emphysema lungs, contributing to disease pathogenesis through loss of anti-inflammatory, anti-apoptotic, and antioxidant effects that involve NF-kB, FoxO3, and p53. Pharmacologic activation with SRT1720 inhibits LPS-induced cytokine release in COPD peripheral blood mononuclear cells, supporting SIRT1 restoration as a therapeutic strategy in COPD.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在 COPD 與肺氣腫肺中大幅減少，經由涉及 NF-kB、FoxO3 與 p53 的抗發炎、抗凋亡與抗氧化效應喪失而促成疾病致病機轉。以 SRT1720 藥理活化可抑制 COPD 周邊血單核細胞中的 LPS 誘發細胞激素釋放，支持將 SIRT1 恢復作為 COPD 的治療策略。

context.en-US: Genetic SIRT1 polymorphisms are associated with coronary artery disease risk, and SIRT1 expression is reduced in CAD patients where its downregulation is linked to acetylated p53 in CAD monocytes. The lncRNA C2dat1 promotes SIRT1 to suppress miR-34a, driving VSMC proliferation and migration in the vessel wall.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 基因多型性與冠狀動脈疾病風險相關，且 SIRT1 表現在 CAD 患者中減少，其下調與 CAD 單核細胞中乙醯化 p53 相關。lncRNA C2dat1 促進 SIRT1 以抑制 miR-34a，驅動血管壁中 VSMC 增生與遷移。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is protective in diabetic kidney disease by deacetylating p53 and activating FoxO3a and Nrf2, and resveratrol promotes resistance to diabetic renal fibrosis via Nrf2. These antioxidant and anti-apoptotic actions defend podocytes and the renal tubulointerstitium against hyperglycemic damage.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病腎臟疾病中具保護性，透過去乙醯化 p53 並活化 FoxO3a 與 Nrf2，且 resveratrol 透過 Nrf2 促進對糖尿病腎纖維化的抗性。這些抗氧化與抗凋亡作用防禦足細胞與腎小管間質免於高血糖損傷。

context.en-US: SIRT1 overexpression prevents capillary cell apoptosis and degenerative capillary formation in diabetic retinopathy, reduces DM-induced retinal inflammation, and improves visual function. In diabetic cardiomyopathy SIRT1 activation inhibits ROS-induced oxidative stress and fibrosis, while SIRT3 regulates fibrosis, inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress in the diabetic myocardium.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 過度表現防止糖尿病視網膜病變中的微血管細胞凋亡與退行性微血管形成，減少 DM 誘發的視網膜發炎，並改善視覺功能。在糖尿病性心肌病中，SIRT1 活化抑制 ROS 誘發的氧化壓力與纖維化，而 SIRT3 調節糖尿病心肌中的纖維化、發炎、凋亡與氧化壓力。

context.en-US: Graph node-analysis: SIRT1→Dopamine is the single most route-rich relationship in the sirtuin×catecholamine set (7 distinct shortest paths via Aging, Parkinson's Disease, Senescence, Tau, Resveratrol) — the dopamine link is indirect and aging/neurodegeneration-contextual, not enzymatic.
context.zh-TW: 圖譜節點分析：SIRT1→Dopamine 是 sirtuin×兒茶酚酚胺組中路徑最豐富的關係（7 條經由 Aging、Parkinson's Disease、Senescence、Tau、Resveratrol 的不同最短路徑）——其多巴胺連結是間接且老化/神經退化脈絡性的，而非酵素性的。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is the principal H3K9 deacetylase (Vaquero et al., 2007). The vault graph lacked a direct SIRT1→H3K9 edge, routing it through 19 three-hop paths; this triple fills that curation gap, consistent with the source review's substrate catalogue.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 是主要的 H3K9 去乙醯酶（Vaquero et al., 2007）。vault 圖譜原本缺少直接的 SIRT1→H3K9 邊，需經 19 條三跳路徑繞行；此三元組填補該策展缺口，與來源回顧的受質目錄一致。

context.en-US: Brain-specific SIRT1 knockout exacerbates Huntington's disease, while SIRT1 overexpression rescues CREB-CRTC1 interaction to restore BDNF transcription. SIRT1 therefore supports neuronal survival and transcriptional resilience in HD. SIRT2 inhibition also achieves neuroprotection in HD models by mimicking the beneficial effects of sterol-biosynthesis manipulation.
context.zh-TW: 腦專一性 SIRT1 基因敲除加劇亨廷頓氏症，而 SIRT1 過度表現透過恢復 CREB-CRTC1 交互作用以重建 BDNF 轉錄來挽救。SIRT1 因此支持 HD 中的神經元存活與轉錄韌性。SIRT2 抑制亦透過模擬固醇生物合成操縱的有益效應，在 HD 模型中達成神經保護。

context.en-US: SIRT1 has a dual role in diabetes mellitus: overexpression improves insulin sensitivity while hepatic SIRT1 knockdown prevents fasting hyperglycemia by increasing hepatic insulin responsiveness. SIRT1 therefore both enhances systemic insulin action and constrains hepatic glucose output. This context-dependence is characteristic of SIRT1's master-regulator role in metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病 mellitus 中具有雙重角色：過度表現改善胰島素敏感性，而肝 SIRT1 敲低透過增加肝臟胰島素反應性防止空腹高血糖。SIRT1 因此既增強全身性胰島素作用，又限制肝臟葡萄糖輸出。此情境依賴性是其作為代謝疾病主控調節因子的特徵。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is reduced in degenerative nucleus pulposus tissues with severity, and inhibits NF-kB transcriptional activity while suppressing c-Fos/c-Jun phosphorylation. SIRT2 reverses IL-1beta action by inhibiting the p53/p21 pathway, SIRT3 maintains nucleus pulposus cell homeostasis, and SIRT6 inhibits inflammatory responses and senescence via NF-kB in IDD.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在退行性髓核組織中隨嚴重程度減少，並抑制 NF-kB 轉錄活性同時抑制 c-Fos/c-Jun 磷酸化。SIRT2 透過抑制 p53/p21 路徑逆轉 IL-1beta 作用，SIRT3 維持髓核細胞穩態，且 SIRT6 在 IDD 中透過 NF-kB 抑制發炎反應與衰老。

context.en-US: SIRT1 suppresses intestinal epithelial ROS accumulation and apoptosis after ischemia-reperfusion, and resveratrol protects through the SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO pathway. SIRT3 alleviates mitochondrial oxidative damage and apoptosis via peroxiredoxin 3 deacetylation, while SIRT6 downregulation by miR-351-5p aggravates intestinal IRI injury.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 抑制缺血—再灌流後的腸上皮 ROS 累積與凋亡，且 resveratrol 透過 SIRT1-NF-kB-iNOS-NO 路徑保護。SIRT3 經由 peroxiredoxin 3 去乙醯化減輕粒線體氧化損傷與凋亡，而 SIRT6 經由 miR-351-5p 下調加劇腸 IRI 損傷。

context.en-US: AlphaFold predicts SIRT1 with a global pLDDT of only 65.0, with 46.6% of residues in very-low-confidence (<50) regions — a mixture of confidently structured catalytic domain and extensive intrinsically disordered N- and C-terminal regions. This disorder complicates structure-based modeling of the STAC-binding N-terminal activation domain and helps explain the difficulty of resolving allosteric activation structurally.
context.zh-TW: AlphaFold 預測 SIRT1 的整體 pLDDT 僅 65.0，其中 46.6% 的殘基位於極低置信度（<50）區域——即確信結構的催化結構域與廣泛的內在無序 N 端、C 端區域混合。這種無序性使基於結構的 STAC 結合 N 端活化結構域建模變得困難，也有助於解釋從結構上解析別構活化的難度。

context.en-US: SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO fibrosis, while SIRT1 represses HIF2alpha. However, SIRT1 downregulation may also inhibit fibroblast activation via EGFR/PDGFR-beta, creating therapeutic ambiguity. The dominant role is renoprotective, opposing tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
