context.en-US: MFN2 tethers endoplasmic reticulum to mitochondria independently of its fusion role, organizing calcium and lipid exchange contacts. This non-fusion function is distinct from MFN1/2 outer-membrane fusion.
context.zh-TW: MFN2 不依賴其融合角色繫留內質網至粒線體，組織鈣與脂質交換接觸。此非融合功能不同於 MFN1/2 外膜融合。

context.en-US: Mdivi-1 is a putative DRP1 fission inhibitor with caveats: off-target L-OPA1 cleavage and OXPHOS effects plus translational failure in pig MI models. The triple carries the file's own caution.
context.zh-TW: Mdivi-1 是推定的 DRP1 分裂抑制劑但附帶注意：脫靶 L-OPA1 切割與 OXPHOS 效應，加上豬 MI 模型轉譯失敗。此 triple 承載檔案自身的警語。

context.en-US: Recombinant IL-6/IL-8 recapitulates trans-well paracrine ACase upregulation in bystander proliferative cells. This grounds the SASP-to-ACase axis in defined cytokines.
context.zh-TW: 重組 IL-6/IL-8 重現 trans-well 旁分泌 ACase 上調。此以明確的細胞激素奠定 SASP 到 ACase 軸的基礎。

context.en-US: Same 2:1 IL-6/IL-8 paracrine experiment as the IL-6 leg; IL-8 co-drives ACase induction and ferroptotic sensitization. Parallel ligand, same evidence class.
context.zh-TW: 與 IL-6 路徑相同的 2:1 IL-6/IL-8 旁分泌實驗；IL-8 共同驅動 ACase 誘發與鐵死亡敏感化。平行配體，相同證據等級。

context.en-US: ARN14974 is a brain-penetrant ACase inhibitor (IC50 79 nM) distinct from ARN14794, which already has a triple. Separate chemistry, separate edge.
context.zh-TW: ARN14974 是可入腦的 ACase 抑制劑（IC50 79 nM），不同於已有 triple 的 ARN14794。不同化學，獨立邊。

context.en-US: ROS signals through JNK/p38 to activate AP-1 in the senescence stress cascade. This stress-input edge precedes AP-1 pioneer opening of SASP enhancers.
context.zh-TW: ROS 經由 JNK/p38 在衰老壓力級聯活化 AP-1。此壓力輸入邊先於 AP-1 先鋒開啟 SASP 增強子。

context.en-US: AP-1 transactivates IL-6 as a core SASP target alongside IL-8 and CXCL5. This grounds the AP-1 pioneer mechanism in a canonical cytokine output.
context.zh-TW: AP-1 轉活化 IL-6 作為核心 SASP 標的，與 IL-8 和 CXCL5 並列。此以典型細胞激素輸出奠定 AP-1 先鋒機制。

context.en-US: Same core-SASP target class as IL-6; AP-1/NF-kB co-regulation drives IL-8 chemokine output. Parallel edge, same evidence class.
context.zh-TW: 與 IL-6 相同的核心 SASP 標的類別；AP-1/NF-κB 共調節驅動 IL-8 趨化因子輸出。平行邊，相同證據等級。

context.en-US: HDAC4 buffers AP-1 activity in young cells and is degraded on senescence entry, licensing AP-1-driven SASP. Loss of the brake explains senescence-specific AP-1 activation.
context.zh-TW: HDAC4 在年輕細胞緩衝 AP-1 活性，並在衰老進入時降解，許可 AP-1 驅動的 SASP。煞車喪失解釋衰老特異的 AP-1 活化。

context.en-US: Cytosolic DNA sensing feeds AP-1 activation downstream; the file's Path Traces asserted the reverse, but Mechanism Summary establishes cGAS-STING as upstream sensor. Corrected direction recorded here.
context.zh-TW: 胞質 DNA 感知在下游供養 AP-1 活化；檔案的 Path Traces 主張相反，但 Mechanism Summary 確立 cGAS-STING 為上游感受器。此記錄修正後的方向。

context.en-US: OIS arrests via the p53/p21 axis; p53 loss is the canonical bypass to malignancy in the OIS-p53-cancer path. Requirement, not mere association.
context.zh-TW: OIS 經由 p53/p21 軸停滯；p53 缺失是 OIS-p53-癌症路徑中典型的惡性繞行。是必要性而非單純關聯。

context.en-US: TSC1/2 loss removes Rheb restraint, causing constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation that drives hamartomas in tuberous sclerosis. Here benign growth itself is the disease.
context.zh-TW: TSC1/2 缺失移除 Rheb 抑制，造成組成性 mTORC1 過度活化，在結節性硬化症驅動錯構瘤。此處良性生長本身即是疾病。

context.en-US: Src-family kinases phosphorylate caspase-8 at Tyr380, blocking maturation upstream of the SHP1 rescue step. This kinase brake precedes phosphatase relief.
context.zh-TW: Src 家族激酶在 Tyr380 磷酸化 caspase-8，在 SHP1 拯救步驟上游阻斷成熟。此激酶煞車先於磷酸酶緩解。

context.en-US: XIAP degradation removes the brake on caspases-3/7/9; the Caspase-3-only edge exists, and this adds the missing Caspase-7 arm. Same IAP control layer.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 降解移除對 caspases-3/7/9 的煞車；Caspase-3 邊已存在，此補上缺失的 Caspase-7 臂。同一 IAP 控制層。

context.en-US: Fisetin binds the hydrophobic groove of Bcl-xL; the file favors Bcl-xL selectivity though only the Bcl-2 edge existed. This fills the preferred target.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 結合 Bcl-xL 的疏水溝；檔案偏好 Bcl-xL 選擇性，但僅存在 Bcl-2 邊。此填補偏好的標的。

context.en-US: Fisetin inhibits PI3K in senescent endothelia (Ji 2025), lowering Akt phosphorylation and Bcl-2/xL levels. This kinase arm underlies part of its senolytic clearance.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 在衰老內皮抑制 PI3K（Ji 2025），降低 Akt 磷酸化與 Bcl-2/xL 水平。此激酶臂構成其 senolytic 清除的一部分。

context.en-US: The Val158Met polymorphism stratifies COMT activity and fisetin response in an inverted-U pattern in Met/Met carriers. Genotype gates catecholamine turnover and worrier-type symptoms.
context.zh-TW: Val158Met 多型性以倒 U 模式分層 COMT 活性與 fisetin 反應。基因型門控兒茶酚胺周轉與憂慮者型症狀。

context.en-US: Exercise-generated ROS bursts drive PGC-1alpha-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis (Ristow reviews). ASCII spelling matches existing triples; post-workout antioxidants blunt this signal.
context.zh-TW: 運動產生的 ROS 爆發驅動 PGC-1alpha 依賴的粒線體生成（Ristow 回顧）。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有 triple；運動後抗氧化劑減弱此訊號。

context.en-US: Exercise induces endogenous SOD/GPx via NRF2; antioxidant supplementation blocks this adaptation (Ristow 2009). NRF2 spelling matches the existing sulfiredoxin triple.
context.zh-TW: 運動經由 NRF2 誘發內生 SOD/GPx；抗氧化補充阻斷此適應（Ristow 2009）。NRF2 拼寫沿用既有的 sulfiredoxin triple。

context.en-US: PGC-1alpha is the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis downstream of exercise, fasting and cold stress. Textbook-level causation.
context.zh-TW: PGC-1alpha 是運動、禁食與冷壓力下游粒線體生成的主調節因子。教科書等級因果。

context.en-US: CRISPR/shRNA screens identify karyopherin-beta-1 as an ivermectin target in ovarian cancer (Kodama 2017), blocking cell cycle with paclitaxel synergy. Importin blockade is distinct from PAK1 degradation.
context.zh-TW: CRISPR/shRNA 篩選確認 karyopherin-beta-1 為 ivermectin 在卵巢癌的標的（Kodama 2017），阻斷細胞週期並與 paclitaxel 協同。Importin 阻斷不同於 PAK1 降解。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits HSP27 phosphorylation (Nappi 2020), enhancing anti-EGFR activity. Chaperone modulation adds a proteostasis arm to its anticancer out-star.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 HSP27 磷酸化（Nappi 2020），增強抗 EGFR 活性。伴侶調節為其抗癌出向之星增添蛋白穩態臂。

context.en-US: PAK1 degradation suppresses downstream Akt signaling toward autophagy and apoptosis. Well-replicated arm of the ivermectin out-star, distinct from direct kinase inhibition.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 降解抑制下游 Akt 訊號朝向自噬與凋亡。ivermectin 出向之星中充分複製的臂，不同於直接激酶抑制。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is the semi-synthetic dihydro derivative of avermectin from Streptomyces avermitilis (Nobel 2015 history). Definitional chemistry fact.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是源自 Streptomyces avermitilis 的 avermectin 半合成二氫衍生物（Nobel 2015 歷史）。定義性化學事實。

context.en-US: Ivermectin directly depolarizes mitochondrial membranes, raising Bax, lowering Bcl-2 and releasing cytochrome c. Distinct from fenbendazole's HK2-VDAC detachment route.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 直接去極化粒線體膜，升高 Bax、降低 Bcl-2 並釋放 cytochrome c。不同於 fenbendazole 的 HK2-VDAC 脫離路徑。

context.en-US: Hexokinase 2 anchors to VDAC to block apoptosome assembly, the canonical anti-apoptotic tether that fenbendazole detaches. Central metabolic-apoptotic junction.
context.zh-TW: Hexokinase 2 錨定 VDAC 以阻斷 apoptosome 組裝，即 fenbendazole 脫離的典型抗凋亡繫留。核心代謝—凋亡交界。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits P-gp plus MRP1/2/3 efflux pumps (Didier & Loor 1996), reversing multidrug resistance broadly. Superset of the existing P-gp-only edge.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 P-gp 及 MRP1/2/3 外排泵（Didier & Loor 1996），廣泛逆轉多重抗藥性。是既有 P-gp 邊的超集。

context.en-US: p53 culls transduced reprogramming-competent cells via p21, apoptosis and senescence, the dominant upstream barrier to iPSC induction. Fenbendazole stabilization of p53 directly opposes rejuvenation.
context.zh-TW: p53 經由 p21、凋亡與衰老淘汰被轉導的重編程能力細胞，是 iPSC 誘發的主要上游屏障。Fenbendazole 穩定 p53 直接對抗回春。

context.en-US: SIRT6 inhibits JAK2/STAT3 inflammatory signaling, a sirtuin counter-regulation node converging on the same inflammaging axis metformin targets. Slash object normalizes to one node.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 抑制 JAK2/STAT3 發炎訊號，是匯聚於 metformin 標靶的相同發炎老化軸的 sirtuin 反調節節點。斜線物件正規化為單一節點。

context.en-US: SARM1 NADase activity executes Wallerian axon degeneration and is a druggable ALS node. NAD+ depletion links SARM1 to the sirtuin-starvation corridor.
context.zh-TW: SARM1 NADase 活性執行 Wallerian 軸突退化，是可藥物化的 ALS 節點。NAD+ 耗竭將 SARM1 連結到 sirtuin 飢餓走廊。

context.en-US: C9orf72 haploinsufficiency plus RNA-foci/DPR toxicity disrupts autophagy and proteostasis in ALS/FTD. The tidy loop ties repeat expansion to clearance failure.
context.zh-TW: C9orf72 單倍劑量不足及 RNA-foci/DPR 毒性在 ALS/FTD 破壞自噬與蛋白穩態。此整齊迴圈將重複擴增與清除失敗連結。

context.en-US: TDP-43-driven mitochondrial rupture releases mtDNA that engages cGAS-STING interferon signaling. This organizes the tau/TDP-43/FTD disease community around innate immunity.
context.zh-TW: TDP-43 驅動的粒線體破裂釋放接合 cGAS-STING 干擾素訊號的 mtDNA。此圍繞先天免疫組織 tau/TDP-43/FTD 疾病群落。

context.en-US: Dopamine autoxidizes via iron/MAO routes to quinones plus 6-OHDA, forming alpha-synuclein adducts. This catecholamine-oxidation chemistry bridges dopamine handling to Parkinson pathology.
context.zh-TW: Dopamine 經由鐵/MAO 路徑自氧化為 quinones 及 6-OHDA，形成 alpha-synuclein 加合物。此兒茶酚胺氧化化學將多巴胺處理連結到帕金森病理。

context.en-US: Microglial nitric oxide plus superoxide forms peroxynitrite that tyrosine-nitrates alpha-synuclein into Lewy-body aggregates. ASCII spelling avoids a node split with the DJ-1 chaperone edge.
context.zh-TW: 微膠細胞 nitric oxide 加超氧形成 peroxynitrite，酪氨酸硝化 alpha-synuclein 為 Lewy 體聚集。ASCII 拼寫避免與 DJ-1 伴侶邊的節點分裂。

context.en-US: Glucocerebrosidase activation (ambroxol chaperone, ASPro-PD Phase 3) clears alpha-synuclein lysosomally. Lysosomal clearance is the therapeutic lever in GBA-Parkinson disease.
context.zh-TW: Glucocerebrosidase 活化（ambroxol 伴侶，ASPro-PD 三期）經溶酶體清除 alpha-synuclein。溶酶體清除是 GBA-帕金森的治療槓桿。

context.en-US: Fasting-driven AMPK activates TFEB for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy, overlapping UPRmt/mitophagy programs. Distinct subject from the existing Intermittent Fasting edges.
context.zh-TW: 禁食驅動的 AMPK 活化 TFEB 以進行溶酶體生成與自噬，與 UPRmt/mitophagy 程序重疊。主詞不同於既有的 Intermittent Fasting 邊。

context.en-US: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
context.zh-TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

context.en-US: Controlled intermittent mild hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1alpha driving EPO, antioxidant and BDNF programs (Li 2024). ASCII spelling matches the existing induces-HIF-1alpha edge.
context.zh-TW: 受控間歇輕度缺氧穩定 HIF-1alpha，驅動 EPO、抗氧化與 BDNF 程序（Li 2024）。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有的 induces-HIF-1alpha 邊。

context.en-US: Exercise-induced muscle damage signals via TNF-alpha/IL-6 to proliferate satellite cells; NSAIDs block the adaptation (Mikkelsen 2009). Acute inflammatory signaling as repair trigger.
context.zh-TW: 運動誘發的肌肉損傷經由 TNF-alpha/IL-6 訊號增生衛星細胞；NSAID 阻斷此適應（Mikkelsen 2009）。急性發炎訊號作為修復觸發。

context.en-US: Neutrophil myeloperoxidase plus ROS oxidizes local epinephrine to adrenochrome. Stronger mechanistic edge than the existing low-confidence Neutrophils-oxidize parent (0.5).
context.zh-TW: 嗜中性球 myeloperoxidase 加 ROS 將局部 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome。比既有低信度 Neutrophils 氧化母邊（0.5）更強的機制邊。

context.en-US: Inflammaging upregulates CD38 on neutrophils and macrophages, starving sirtuins of NAD+. Cellular-resolution leg of the established CD38-consumes-NAD+ triple.
context.zh-TW: 發炎老化在嗜中性球與巨噬細胞上調 CD38，使 sirtuins 缺乏 NAD+。已確立的 CD38 消耗 NAD+ triple 的細胞解析度分支。

context.en-US: NMN restores NAD+ co-substrate availability for sirtuins, distinct from allosteric STAC activation. Standard precursor biology paired with the existing NR-sirtuin edge.
context.zh-TW: NMN 恢復 sirtuins 的 NAD+ 輔受質可及性，不同於別構 STAC 活化。標準前驅物生物學，與既有的 NR-sirtuin 邊配對。

context.en-US: Honokiol activates SIRT3 to increase ATP and reduce ROS/lipid peroxidation in kidney injury models. Supported pharmacology, kept at moderate confidence per file hypothesis framing.
context.zh-TW: Honokiol 活化 SIRT3，在腎損傷模型增加 ATP 並減少 ROS/脂質過氧化。藥理支持，依檔案假設框架維持中等信度。

context.en-US: Severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion (Heer 2020), feeding sirtuin loss and inflammaging. Systemic-viral arm of the NAD+ corridor.
context.zh-TW: 重症 COVID-19 驅動 CD38-NADase 介導的 NAD+ 耗竭（Heer 2020），供養 sirtuin 缺失與發炎老化。NAD+ 走廊的全身病毒臂。

context.en-US: Metformin activates AMPK as first-line nutrient-sensing pharmacology, suppressing SASP in the same longevity space as rapamycin. Canonical mechanism, new subject for the tasks layer.
context.zh-TW: Metformin 活化 AMPK 作為一線營養感測藥理，在與 rapamycin 相同的長壽空間抑制 SASP。典型機制，tasks 層的新主詞。

context.en-US: DJ-1 detoxifies glyoxal to glycolic acid GSH-independently, parallel to methylglyoxal-to-L-lactate conversion. Second substrate leg of the DJ-1 glyoxalase program.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 不依賴 GSH 將 glyoxal 解毒為 glycolic acid，與 methylglyoxal 到 L-lactate 轉換平行。DJ-1 乙二醛酶程序的第二受質分支。

context.en-US: DJ-1 blocks KEAP1 to stabilize Nrf2, the mechanistic basis of the existing DJ-1-Nrf2 edge. Upstream cause recorded as its own triple.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 阻斷 KEAP1 以穩定 Nrf2，是既有 DJ-1-Nrf2 邊的機制基礎。上游原因記錄為獨立 triple。

context.en-US: DJ-1 modulates DRP1-dependent fission in neuroprotection models. Single-path evidence, kept at low-moderate confidence with the file's own caution.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 在神經保護模型調節 DRP1 依賴的分裂。單一路徑證據，依檔案自身的警語維持中低信度。

context.en-US: DJ-1 binds alpha-synuclein intermediates to prevent fibrillization. ASCII spelling consolidated with the peroxynitrite edge to avoid a node split.
context.zh-TW: DJ-1 結合 alpha-synuclein 中間體以防止纖維化。ASCII 拼寫與 peroxynitrite 邊合併以免節點分裂。

context.en-US: Adrenochrome redox cycling consumes glutathione, disabling GLO1/GLO2 dicarbonyl clearance. This couples catecholamine oxidation to glycation defense collapse.
context.zh-TW: Adrenochrome 氧化還原循環消耗 glutathione，使 GLO1/GLO2 二羰基清除失效。此將兒茶酚胺氧化耦合到糖化防禦崩潰。

context.en-US: Sirtuins broadly brake apoptotic execution at the degree-392 hub survival side, complementing the SASP-suppression arm. Family-level summary edge.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuins 在 degree-392 樞紐的存活側廣泛煞停凋亡執行，補充 SASP 抑制臂。家族層級總結邊。

context.en-US: CD38 inhibitor 78c preserves and raises NAD+ with male-biased lifespan effects (Peclat 2022). Pharmacological counterpart to the CD38-consumes-NAD+ disease edge.
context.zh-TW: CD38 inhibitor 78c 保存並提高 NAD+，具雄性偏向的壽命效應（Peclat 2022）。CD38 消耗 NAD+ 疾病邊的藥理對應。

context.en-US: Estradiol prevents injury-induced Bcl-2 downregulation (Dubal 1999 OVX model). The one well-supported sex-dimorphic edge; other hormone claims were rejected as under-evidenced.
context.zh-TW: Estradiol 防止損傷誘發的 Bcl-2 下調（Dubal 1999 OVX 模型）。唯一充分支持的性別二態邊；其他荷爾蒙主張因證據不足被拒。

context.en-US: DRP1-mediated fission severs damaged segments for engulfment but cardiac DRP1-KO shows mitophagy persists without it. Softened from is_required_for per the file's own contradiction.
context.zh-TW: DRP1 介導的分裂切斷受損片段以供包吞，但心臟 DRP1-KO 顯示無它 mitophagy 仍持續。依檔案自身的矛盾從 is_required_for 放軟。

context.en-US: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
context.zh-TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

context.en-US: Head-to-head screening across RSL3, erastin, BSO, and genetic Gpx4 deletion found tocotrienols prevent ferroptosis at roughly tenfold lower concentration than tocopherols (alpha-tocotrienol EC50 0.12 uM vs alpha-tocopherol 2.0 uM), a gap that tracks how deeply each vitamer integrates into the membrane. Because tocotrienols are poorly retained by alpha-TTP and cleared quickly via CYP4F2, their superiority does not translate into longer plasma residence. Practically, this favors splitting tocotrienol-rich and alpha-tocopherol-rich sources across the day rather than combining them in one bolus.
context.zh-TW: 在 RSL3、erastin、BSO 以及 Gpx4 基因刪除的平行測試中，tocotrienol 抑制 ferroptosis 的濃度約比 tocopherol 低十倍（α-tocotrienol EC50 0.12 µM vs α-tocopherol 2.0 µM），此差異與各 vitamer 嵌入膜的深度相關。由於 tocotrienol 受 α-TTP 保留不佳且經 CYP4F2 快速清除，其優勢並未轉化為較長的血漿存留時間。實務上建議將富含 tocotrienol 與富含 α-tocopherol 的來源分散於不同時段攝取，而非併用同一劑量。

context.en-US: Retinol, retinal, and all-trans retinoic acid are direct anti-ferroptotic agents, with potency superior to alpha-tocopherol (retinol EC50 0.4-4.8 uM vs 7.4-36.1 uM). Retinol and retinal work chemically as radical-trapping polyene antioxidants in the membrane, while ATRA additionally acts transcriptionally to raise GPX4, FSP1, GCH1, and ACSL3. Studer et al. showed that suppressing ferroptosis by vitamin A is required for normal neuronal development, so the nutrient is mechanistically load-bearing rather than merely supplementary.
context.zh-TW: Retinol、retinal 與 all-trans retinoic acid 都是直接的抗 ferroptosis 因子，效力優於 alpha-tocopherol（retinol EC50 0.4–4.8 µM vs 7.4–36.1 µM）。Retinol 與 retinal 以 polyene 自由基捕捉劑的方式在膜中化學作用，而 ATRA 另有轉錄層次的作用，可提升 GPX4、FSP1、GCH1 與 ACSL3。Studer 等人（2024）顯示以 vitamin A 抑制 ferroptosis 對正常神經發育是必要的，顯示此營養素具機制上的關鍵性，而非僅屬補充角色。

context.en-US: All-trans retinoic acid suppresses ferroptosis transcriptionally rather than purely chemically, raising GPX4, FSP1, GCH1, and ACSL3 through RAR/RXR nuclear receptor signaling. This is a distinct route from the radical-trapping chemistry of retinol and retinal, meaning retinoic acid can reinforce the enzymatic arm of the antioxidant defense. The same induction of ferroptosis suppression is required for neuronal development, tying retinoid signaling to developmental ferroptosis thresholds.
context.zh-TW: All-trans retinoic acid 抑制 ferroptosis 的機制主要在轉錄層次而非單純化學層次，透過 RAR/RXR 核受體訊號提升 GPX4、FSP1、GCH1 與 ACSL3 表現。這與 retinol/retinal 的自由基捕捉化學路徑不同，意即 retinoic acid 可強化抗氧化防禦的酵素臂。相同的 ferroptosis 抑制誘導對神經發育亦是必要的，將 retinoid 訊號與發育期 ferroptosis 閾值連結起來。

context.en-US: The eight vitamin E vitamers function as chain-breaking antioxidants, donating phenolic hydrogen from the chromanol head group to lipid peroxyl radicals and thereby terminating propagation of the LOO radical chain in membrane phospholipids. This is the exogenous dietary brake on ferroptosis, running parallel to the enzymatic GPX4-glutathione axis rather than replacing it. Because it is a sacrificial scavenger, each vitamin E molecule is finite and must be recycled at the membrane-water interface, a step that requires vitamin C.
context.zh-TW: Vitamin E 的八種 vitamer 扮演鏈終止型抗氧化劑，從 chromanol 頭基提供酚性氫給 lipid peroxyl 自由基，藉此終止膜磷脂上 LOO 自由基鏈的傳播。這是對 ferroptosis 的外源性飲食煞車，與酵素性的 GPX4–glutathione 軸平行作用而非取代它。由於它是消耗性清除劑，每個 vitamin E 分子容量有限，必須在膜–水界面被回收，而此步驟需要 vitamin C。

context.en-US: Beta-carotene, alpha-carotene, and lycopene quench singlet oxygen and related non-radical oxidants, adding a second line of defense alongside radical trapping. Because beta-carotene conversion to retinol is feedback-regulated, food-form carotenoids carry no tolerable upper intake level, unlike preformed retinol which accumulates and becomes pro-oxidant and mitochondrially toxic at excess. This is why red palm oil delivers provitamin A safely at culinary doses while a retinol capsule does not.
context.zh-TW: β-carotene、α-carotene 與 lycopene 可清除 singlet oxygen 及其他非自由基型氧化劑，在自由基捕捉之外提供第二道防線。由於 β-carotene 轉換為 retinol 受到回饋調控，食物型 carotenoid 並無耐受上限（tolerable upper intake level）；相較之下 preformed retinol 會累積，過量時本身即具促氧化與粒線體毒性。這正是 red palm oil 以烹飪劑量提供 provitamin A 仍然安全、而 retinol 膠囊卻不然的原因。

context.en-US: The chemistry ferroptosis runs on is Fe2+-dependent free radical generation via the Fenton reaction, which converts lipid hydroperoxides to alkoxyl radicals that propagate. This means iron status, not antioxidant dose, is the upstream lever: high ferritin or hemochromatosis generates unquenchable radical flux that no membrane antioxidant tier can fully absorb. Clinically this argues for assessing ferritin and CRP before optimizing dietary vitamin intake, since correcting iron overload addresses the reaction itself rather than only its products.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis 所依賴的化學反應是由 Fe2+ 驅動的自由基生成（Fenton reaction），將 lipid hydroperoxide 轉為可傳播的 alkoxyl 自由基。這代表真正的上游槓桿是鐵狀態而非抗氧化劑劑量：ferritin 過高或 hemochromatosis 會產生無法被清除的自由基通量，任何膜抗氧化層級都無法完全吸收。臨床上因此主張在最佳化飲食維生素攝取之前先評估 ferritin 與 CRP，因為處理鐵負荷是處理反應本身，而不只是其產物。

context.en-US: High-dose antioxidant supplements taken near training, sauna, or fasting windows blunt the reactive oxygen species signal that drives mitohormetic adaptation, following the Ristow 2009 finding that vitamin C and E supplementation blocks the health-promoting effects of exercise. The practical rule is to keep supplements at least three to four hours away from hormetic windows while treating food-level intake at meals as unproblematic. A single 400 IU bolus is the specific concern, not the tocopherol in a meal.
context.zh-TW: 在訓練、sauna 或禁食窗口附近服用高劑量抗氧化補充劑，會削弱驅動 mitohormesis 適應的 reactive oxygen species 訊號；這呼應 Ristow 2009 的發現：vitamin C 與 E 補充會阻斷運動的健康促進效果。實務規則是讓補充劑與 hormetic 窗口至少相隔三至四小時，而把隨餐的食物型攝取視為無虞。真正的問題在於單次 400 IU 的高劑量丸劑，而非餐食中的 tocopherol。

context.en-US: ARH3 is the only known serine de-MARylase, a Mg2+-dependent binuclear exo-glycosidase (Asp77/Asp78/Asp314/Asp316, catalytic Glu41) whose main physiological substrate is the serine-MAR polymer written by PARP1/HPF1, rather than classical O-glycosidic PAR. Its narrow cavity docks only a terminal ADP-ribose unit, so it removes residues sequentially from the chain end. Localized roughly 65% cytosol, 25% mitochondrial matrix, and 10% nucleus, it is the only active mitochondrial PAR degrader because PARG55/60 lack exon 5 and are dead proteins.
context.zh-TW: ARH3 是目前唯一已知的 serine de-MARylase，屬 Mg2+ 依賴的雙核 exo-glycosidase（Asp77/Asp78/Asp314/Asp316，催化殘基 Glu41），其主要生理受質是由 PARP1/HPF1 寫入的 serine-MAR 聚合物，而非傳統 O-糖苷鍵 PAR。其狹窄空腔僅能對接末端的 ADP-ribose 單元，因此由鏈端逐個移除殘基。定位約為 65% 細胞質、25% 粒線體基質、10% 細胞核；由於 PARG55/60 缺乏 exon 5 而無活性，ARH3 是唯一具活性的粒線體 PAR 降解酵素。

context.en-US: Short PAR oligomers of fewer than five units are poor substrates for PARG, which prefers long protein-bound chains, so ARH3 activity compensates where PARG cannot act. This substrate-length divide is the rationale for dual PARG/ARH3 inhibition rather than either enzyme alone. It also follows from Arh3-/- phenotypes: hydrogen peroxide triggers nuclear PAR at 10 minutes, cytoplasmic PAR at 30 minutes, then AIF release and caspase-independent death, indicating PAR accumulation is the brake on parthanatos.
context.zh-TW: 短於五個單元的 PAR 寡聚物是 PARG 的不良受質（PARG 偏好長的蛋白結合鏈），因此在 PARG 無法作用之處由 ARH3 活性加以補償。這種受質長度的分工，正是「同時抑制 PARG 與 ARH3」而非單一酵素的依據。Arh3-/- 表型也支持此點：hydrogen peroxide 於 10 分鐘引發核內 PAR、30 分鐘轉為細胞質 PAR，隨後出現 AIF 釋放與 caspase 依賴性以外的死亡，顯示 PAR 累積正是 parthanatos 的煞車。

context.en-US: Poly-ADP-ribose binds AIF through a dedicated binding motif at Arg588/Lys589/Arg592 that is distinct from AIF's DNA-binding site, which is the best-proven of the four models for PAR-induced AIF release. A PAR-binding-dead AIF mutant retains full oxidase, FAD, and DNA-binding activity yet is never released, never translocates to the nucleus, and produces no death. Approximately 30% of AIF sits on the cytosolic face of the outer membrane and this pool releases fast as uncleaved 62 kDa, explaining why AIF can precede cytochrome c.
context.zh-TW: Poly-ADP-ribose 透過 AIF 上專屬的結合位點（Arg588/Lys589/Arg592）與 AIF 結合，此位點與 AIF 的 DNA 結合位點不同；這是四個「PAR 誘導 AIF 釋放」模型中證據最扎实者。PAR 結合缺陷型的 AIF 突變體仍保有完整的 oxidase、FAD 與 DNA 結合活性，卻完全不被釋放、不轉位至細胞核、也不造成死亡。約 30% 的 AIF 位於外膜的細胞質側，此池以未切割的 62 kDa 形式快速釋放，解釋了為何 AIF 可先於 cytochrome c 出現。

context.en-US: AIF release is the defining executor step of parthanatos, with PAR driving AIF nuclear translocation alongside MIF nuclease activity and NAD+/ATP depletion. The PAR-binding-dead AIF mutant, which cannot be released, abolishes death entirely, establishing AIF as required rather than merely associated. The requirement is not universal: AIF-independent parthanatos has been reported in retina and macrophages, so cell-type context determines whether AIF is on or off the critical path.
context.zh-TW: AIF 釋放是 parthanatos 的定義性執行步驟，由 PAR 驅動 AIF 核轉位，並伴隨 MIF 核酸酶活性與 NAD+/ATP 耗竭。無法被釋放的 PAR 結合缺陷型 AIF 突變體會完全消除死亡，確立 AIF 為必要條件而非僅有關聯。此必要性並非普遍：在 retina 與 macrophage 中已有 AIF 獨立的 parthanatos 報告，因此細胞類型脈絡決定 AIF 是否位於關鍵路徑上。

context.en-US: In the calpain-cleavage model of AIF release, calcium entry through TRPM2 activates calpain I, which cleaves the 62 kDa AIF to a 57 kDa truncated form that detaches from the inner mitochondrial membrane; calpeptin and cyclosporin A block this step. Bid/Bax alone releases cytochrome c but not AIF, so the two release routes are separable. The model is contested: canonical MNNG/NMDA parthanatos releases uncleaved 62 kDa AIF and calpastatin knockout fails to block it.
context.zh-TW: 在 AIF 釋放的 calpain 切割模型中，經由 TRPM2 進入的鈣離子活化 calpain I，將 62 kDa 的 AIF 切割為脫離粒線體內膜的 57 kDa 截短型；calpeptin 與 cyclosporin A 可阻斷此步驟。Bid/Bax 單獨可釋放 cytochrome c 但不釋放 AIF，顯示兩條釋放途徑可分離。此模型仍有爭議：典型的 MNNG/NMDA parthanatos 釋放的是未切割的 62 kDa AIF，且 calpastatin 剔除無法阻斷之。

context.en-US: Calpain-dependent cleavage of AIF is proposed only for the inner-membrane AIF pool, generating a 57 kDa truncated AIF that no longer anchors to the inner membrane and can exit. The route requires a second hit beyond PAR binding and is model-dependent rather than a general feature of parthanatos. Evidence against it includes the release of uncleaved 62 kDa AIF in canonical MNNG and NMDA paradigms, so whether calpain cleavage is required remains unresolved.
context.zh-TW: Calpain 依賴性的 AIF 切割僅被提出適用於粒線體內膜的 AIF 池，產生不再錨定於內膜、可外出的 57 kDa 截短型 AIF。此途徑需要 PAR 結合之外的第二個打擊，且屬模型依賴而非 parthanatos 的一般特徵。反對證據包括在典型 MNNG 與 NMDA 範式中釋放的是未切割的 62 kDa AIF，因此 calpain 切割是否為必要步驟仍未定論。

context.en-US: Berberine lowers HbA1c in type 2 diabetes with effect sizes comparable to metformin: the Yin 2008 trial of 36 newly diagnosed patients saw HbA1c fall from 9.5% to 7.5% on berberine, matching metformin 500 mg three times daily over three months. A 46-RCT meta-analysis pooled HbA1c -0.73%, fasting glucose -0.86 mmol/L, HOMA-IR -0.71, and LDL-C -0.86 mmol/L. Human trials rarely measure AMPK directly, so the mechanistic chain is preclinical-strong but clinically inferred.
context.zh-TW: Berberine 在 type 2 diabetes 中降低 HbA1c 的效力與 metformin 相當：Yin 2008 研究收錄 36 名新診斷患者，berberine 組 HbA1c 由 9.5% 降至 7.5%，與 metformin 500 mg 每日三次、為期三個月相呼應。整合 46 项 RCT 的 meta-analysis 顯示 HbA1c −0.73%、空腹血糖 −0.86 mmol/L、HOMA-IR −0.71、LDL-C −0.86 mmol/L。人體試驗極少直接測量 AMPK，因此其機制鏈在臨床前證據強、臨床上屬推論。

context.en-US: With only 1-5% systemic bioavailability, berberine reaches very high intraluminal concentrations, where it enriches Akkermansia muciniphila, Bifidobacterium species, and SCFA-producing Lactobacillus species while inhibiting intestinal alpha-glucosidases. The PREMOTE randomized trial linked HbA1c reduction directly to these microbiota shifts in humans. This means conventional berberine acts mainly through the gut, whereas enhanced formulations (dihydroberberine, phospholipid complex, BUDCA/UDCA salt) are designed to reach systemic AMPK action instead.
context.zh-TW: 由於全身生體可用率僅 1–5%，berberine 在腸腔內可達極高濃度，藉此富集 Akkermansia muciniphila、Bifidobacterium 屬與產生 SCFA 的 Lactobacillus 屬，並抑制腸道 alpha-glucosidase。PREMOTE 隨機試驗在人類中將 HbA1c 下降直接連結到這些菌群的改變。這意味著一般型 berberine 主要經腸道作用，而增強型製劑（dihydroberberine、磷脂複合物、BUDCA/UDCA 鹽）則是設計來達到全身性的 AMPK 作用。

context.en-US: Berberine dampens inflammation by inhibiting NF-κB and downregulating TNF-alpha and IL-6, which counters the metabolic endotoxemia that drives insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes. This anti-inflammatory arm is mechanistically separate from its AMPK and microbiome routes and shares a common node with spermidine and urolithin A, all of which converge on dampening inflammasome tone. The axis is preclinical and anti-inflammatory rather than anti-apoptotic, so it complements rather than competes with the glycemic effect.
context.zh-TW: Berberine 藉由抑制 NF-κB 與下調 TNF-alpha、IL-6 來抑制發炎，對抗驅動 type 2 diabetes 胰島素阻抗的代謝性內毒素血症。此抗發炎路徑在機制上與其 AMPK 及腸道菌群路徑相互獨立，但與 spermidine、urolithin A 共享共同節點，三者皆收斂於降低 inflammasome 張力。此軸屬臨床前證據，且為抗發炎而非抗凋亡，與其降血糖效果互補而非競爭。

context.en-US: Berberine improves insulin sensitivity largely through an insulin-signaling-independent route: IRS-1 and Akt phosphorylation are unchanged, while glucose uptake proceeds via AMPK-p38 MAPK. In the Yin 2008 add-on arm, HOMA-IR fell 44.7%. This dissociation is the clinically interesting part, because the compound acts downstream of the insulin receptor rather than competing with it, which is why it remains effective in insulin-resistant states.
context.zh-TW: Berberine 改善胰島素敏感度主要透過一條不依賴胰島素訊號的路徑：IRS-1 與 Akt 的磷酸化並未改變，葡萄糖攝取則經由 AMPK–p38 MAPK 進行。在 Yin 2008 的加藥組中，HOMA-IR 下降 44.7%。這種解離在臨床上最為關鍵，因為該化合物作用於胰島素受體下游而非與之競爭，這也是它在胰島素阻抗狀態下仍有效的理由。

context.en-US: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4, CYP2D6, and P-glycoprotein, which creates pharmacokinetic interaction risk with co-administered compounds including fisetin and statins. The vault's practical mitigation is temporal separation, dosing berberine in the morning and fisetin in the evening. Beyond dosing, berberine is the structurally preferred metabolic and anti-inflammatory alternative for slow COMT (Val158Met) individuals, since it is a non-catecholic isoquinoline alkaloid and does not engage the COMT substrate-inhibitor problem.
context.zh-TW: Berberine 抑制 CYP3A4、CYP2D6 與 P-glycoprotein，因此與包括 fisetin 與 statin 在內的共用意圖藥物存在藥動學交互作用風險。Vault 的實務緩解方式是時間分隔：berberine 早上、fisetin 晚上服用。除劑量安排外，對 slow COMT（Val158Met）個體而言，berberine 是結構上更偏好的代謝與抗發炎替代物，因為它屬非兒茶酚 isoquinoline 生物鹼，不會涉及 COMT 的受質—抑制劑問題。

context.en-US: Spermidine acts as a caloric-restriction mimetic largely through inhibition of the acetyltransferase EP300, which shifts the deacetylation balance and drives deacetylation-dependent autophagy. This is a distinct entry point from mTOR suppression and makes spermidine a general rather than selective autophagy inducer. It is also a non-redundant lever in the four-compound food framework, where spermidine supplies bulk autophagy while urolithin A supplies targeted mitochondrial quality control.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 主要透過抑制 acetyltransferase EP300 發揮 caloric-restriction mimetic 的作用，藉此改變去乙醯化平衡並驅動去乙醯化依賴的 autophagy。這是一條與 mTOR 抑制不同的入口，使 spermidine 成為廣泛型而非選擇性的 autophagy 誘導劑。在四化合物食物框架中它也是不可替代的槓桿：spermidine 提供整體性的 autophagy，而 urolithin A 提供針對性的粒線體品質管制。

context.en-US: Spermidine is the required substrate for hypusination of eIF5A, the post-translational modification that licenses eIF5A as a translation elongation factor. The downstream consequence is activation of TFEB and Atg3-dependent autophagy together with mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation. Because hypusination is essentially irreversible on the eIF5A molecule and must be re-worn each cycle, spermidine availability directly gates the rate of this translation machinery.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 是 eIF5A 進行 hypusination 所需的受質，而此轉譯後修飾使 eIF5A 得以作為轉譯延長因子運作。其下游結果是啟動 TFEB 與 Atg3 依賴的 autophagy，並伴隨粒線體脂肪酸氧化。由於 hypusination 在 eIF5A 分子上近乎不可逆，每個循環都必須重新「磨損」重建，因此 spermidine 的可得性直接決定這套轉譯機制的運作速率。

context.en-US: Fasting-mediated autophagy depends on spermidine availability, so the two interventions are not additive but conditional on one another. This reframes spermidine supplementation from an optional geroprotector to a permissive factor for the fasting response, particularly in older tissue where polyamine pools are depleted. It also explains why spermidine food doses correlate with reduced all-cause mortality in the Kiechl 2018 prospective cohort while the mechanistic link runs through hypusination rather than direct antioxidant activity.
context.zh-TW: 禁食所誘發的 autophagy 依賴 spermidine 的可得性，因此兩者並非加成關係，而是互為條件。這把 spermidine 補充從選用的 geroprotector 重新定位為禁食反應的允許因子（permissive factor），在多胺池已耗竭的高齡組織尤其如此。這也解釋了為何 spermidine 的食物劑量與 Kiechl 2018 前瞻性世代研究中較低的全因死亡率相關，而其機制連結是經由 hypusination 而非直接抗氧化活性。

context.en-US: Urolithin A is a selective mitophagy inducer, acting on the PINK1/Parkin axis with phospho-Parkin Ser65, UBE2N/R2 recruitment, and a Parkin-ubiquitin-proteasome signature detectable in human muscle biopsies at 500 mg daily. At 1000 mg it additionally raises OXPHOS and the mtDNA/DNA ratio. Unlike spermidine's bulk autophagy, this is targeted mitochondrial quality control, and it has the strongest human data of the four compounds for physical function (10-12% leg strength gain over four months).
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 是選擇性的 mitophagy 誘導劑，作用於 PINK1/Parkin 軸，伴隨 phospho-Parkin Ser65、UBE2N/R2 招募，以及在人類肌肉活檢中以每日 500 mg 可偵測到的 Parkin–ubiquitin–proteasome 訊號。在 1000 mg 時另可提升 OXPHOS 與 mtDNA/DNA 比值。與 spermidine 的廣泛 autophagy 不同，此為針對性粒線體品質管制，且在四種化合物中對體能表現（4 個月腿部肌力提升 10–12%）具有最強的人體數據。

context.en-US: Fisetin kills senescent cells by inhibiting PI3K/AKT and Bcl-2/Bcl-xL, which removes the anti-apoptotic brake and drives senescent cells into apoptosis. The effect is hit-and-run rather than chronic, so intermittent dosing outperforms continuous dosing, and the 2025 Murray study extended this to reducing muscle senescence and improving physical function. Because its bioavailability is poor, fisetin requires hybrid-hydrogel or nano formulation to achieve the exposures seen in vitro.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 藉由抑制 PI3K/AKT 與 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 殺死衰老細胞，移除抗凋亡煞車並將衰老細胞推入 apoptosis。此效應屬「hit-and-run」而非慢性作用，因此間歇性給藥優於連續給藥；2025 年 Murray 的研究更將此延伸至減少肌肉衰老並改善體能。由於生物可用度低，fisetin 需透過 hybrid-hydrogel 或奈米製劑才能達到體外實驗所見的暴露濃度。

context.en-US: Urolithin A dampens inflammaging by lowering cGAS-STING and NLRP3 inflammatory signaling alongside its mitophagy induction, with a 2025 RCT showing reduced age-related immune decline. Because mitophagy removes the mitochondrial ROS and mtDNA that feed cGAS-STING and NLRP3, the anti-inflammatory effect is mechanistically downstream of its primary axis rather than independent. Metabolic response is metabotype-dependent: only ellagitannin producers benefit from precursors such as pomegranate and walnuts, while direct urolithin A bypasses the gate.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 藉由降低 cGAS-STING 與 NLRP3 發炎訊號來抑制 inflammaging，並伴隨其 mitophagy 誘導作用；2025 年一項 RCT 顯示年齡相關的免疫衰退減輕。由於 mitophagy 會清除驅動 cGAS-STING 與 NLRP3 的粒線體 ROS 與 mtDNA，此抗發炎效果在機制上位於其主要軸的下游，而非獨立作用。代謝反應具 metabotype 依賴性：僅 ellagitannin 生產者能由 pomegranate、walnut 等前驅物獲益，直接給予 urolithin A 則可繞過此關卡。

context.en-US: Sirtuins consume NAD+ stoichiometrically, producing nicotinamide and 2'-O-acyl-ADP-ribose, so their activity is gated directly by the cellular NAD+/NADH balance. This is the mechanistic basis for sirtuin responsiveness to caloric restriction and to NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR, and it distinguishes them from kinases, which consume ATP. Because the same brake weakens as NAD+ declines with age, sirtuin restraint on cell death erodes over the lifespan, contributing to excessive death in aging.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuins 以化學計量方式消耗 NAD+，產生 nicotinamide 與 2'-O-acyl-ADP-ribose，因此其活性直接受細胞內 NAD+/NADH 平衡調控。這是 sirtuin 對 caloric restriction 與 NAD+ 前驅物（NMN、NR）產生反應的機制基礎，也使它與消耗 ATP 的 kinase 有所區別。由於同一煞車機制會隨 NAD+ 老化下降而減弱，sirtuin 對細胞死亡的制約會在生命歷程中逐步流失，促成老化時的過度細胞死亡。

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO4 as part of restraining pro-apoptotic transcription, alongside its deacetylation of p53 which lowers Bax expression. This is one half of a shared-node conflict: Akt phosphorylates FOXO to drive nuclear exclusion, while SIRT1 deacetylates it to shift output toward stress-resistance and autophagy. The same deacetylation-dependent restraint is what weakens as NAD+ falls with age, since SIRT1 activity is NAD+-coupled.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 對 FOXO4 的去乙醯化是抑制促凋亡轉錄的一部分，與其對 p53 的去乙醯化（降低 Bax 表現）並列。這是共享節點衝突的一半：Akt 磷酸化 FOXO 使其被排除於細胞核之外，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化它使輸出轉向抗逆境與 autophagy。正是這種去乙醯化依賴的制約機制，會隨 NAD+ 老化下降而減弱，因為 SIRT1 活性與 NAD+ 耦聯。

context.en-US: SIRT1 restrains NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and Caspase-1 maturation via XBP1s and via NRF2/PGC-1alpha, extending its brake beyond the apoptotic arm into the inflammatory caspase-1 axis. Because the restraint is NAD+-coupled, it decays with age along with the sirtuin activity that sustains it. Context exceptions exist, however: cytoplasmic SIRT1 is pro-death, so location rather than abundance determines whether the brake or the accelerator dominates.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過 XBP1s 以及 NRF2/PGC-1alpha 抑制 NLRP3 inflammasome 的組裝與 Caspase-1 的成熟，將其煞車作用由凋亡臂延伸到發炎性 caspase-1 軸。由於此制約與 NAD+ 耦聯，它會隨 sirtuin 活性一起在老化中衰退。惟存在情境例外：細胞質中的 SIRT1 為促死亡，因此決定煞車或油門的是定位而非量體。

context.en-US: Akt phosphorylates XIAP at Ser87, stabilizing the inhibitor of apoptosis proteins and thereby raising the caspase-3/-7/-9 activation threshold. This is a second-order brake: it does not block a caspase directly but prevents XIAP degradation, letting XIAP continue neutralizing executioner caspases. In cancer this becomes an oncogenic lock, since co-opted Akt plus XIAP welds the death system shut and is why XIAP antagonists like LCL161 are being tested in TNBC.
context.zh-TW: Akt 在 Ser87 磷酸化 XIAP，穩定這個 apoptosis inhibitor，因而提高 caspase-3/-7/-9 的活化閾值。這是二階煞車：它不直接阻斷 caspase，而是防止 XIAP 被降解，讓 XIAP 持續中和 executioner caspase。在癌症中此機制成為致癌的鎖定：被劫持的 Akt 加上 XIAP 將死亡系統焊死，這也是 XIAP antagonist（如 LCL161）在 TNBC 中被測試的原因。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 cleaves PKCδ into a constitutively active fragment, creating feed-forward amplification of the death program. Once the executioner caspase is running, this converts a normally transient kinase signal into a self-sustaining one. It is the mirror image of PKCδ's own role, where PKCδ enhances Caspase-3 activity upstream of cleavage. The pairing shows how caspase output can recruit upstream signaling into a positive feedback loop rather than terminating in a single linear event.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 將 PKCδ 切割成持續具活性的片段，形成死亡程式的饋送放大。一旦 executioner caspase 開始運作，這會把原本短暫的 kinase 訊號轉為自我維持的訊號。這與 PKCδ 自身的角色恰好互為鏡像：在切割之前，PKCδ 會增強 Caspase-3 活性。此配對說明 caspase 的輸出能把上游訊號納入正回饋迴路，而非終止於單一線性事件。

context.en-US: The sirtuin-caspase interaction is bidirectional: Caspase-3 and Caspase-9 cleave SIRT1 at DEPDVP (residues 704-709), causing nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization, TRIM28-mediated degradation, and gain of pro-apoptotic function. This removes the very brake that had been suppressing the death program and repurposes it, locking in commitment once caspases engage. Because the mark is proteolytic it is irreversible, converting the system's normally reversible regulation into one-way execution.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuin–caspase 交互作用是雙向的：Caspase-3 與 Caspase-9 在 DEPDVP（殘基 704–709）切割 SIRT1，造成由細胞核向細胞質的轉位、TRIM28 介導的降解，並獲得促凋亡功能。這等於移除了原本抑制死亡程式的煞車本身並加以重配，在 caspase 啟動後鎖定承諾。由於此標記為蛋白水解性、不可逆，系統原本可逆的調控因此轉為單向執行。

context.en-US: Resveratrol belongs to the sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) that allosterically activate SIRT1 by binding a substrate-dependent site in the regulatory domain, which lowers the Michaelis constant for the NAD+-dependent reaction. Because the effect depends on substrate context rather than raising catalytic rate directly, STAC activity is not equivalent to increasing cellular NAD+. This is why sirtuin activation pharmacology and NAD+ precursor supplementation are complementary rather than interchangeable strategies.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 屬於 sirtuin-activating compounds（STACs），可透過結合調控區中的受質依賴性位點別構活化 SIRT1，降低 NAD+ 依賴反應的 Michaelis 常數。由於此效應取決於受質脈絡而非直接提升催化速率，STAC 活性並不等同於增加細胞內 NAD+。這也是 sirtuin 活化藥理學與 NAD+ 前驅物補充互補而非可互換的原因。

context.en-US: SIRT6 is a context exception to the general sirtuin survival bias, acting pro-apoptotically in tumors via p53 and p73 rather than restraining them. This inverts the usual expectation from the family and is part of why blanket statements about sirtuins as survival promoters fail. It also has a therapeutic corollary: SIRT1 inhibition is useful in many tumors precisely because it re-releases Caspase-2 and Caspase-3, and SIRT6 sits on the same pro-death side of that balance in tumor tissue.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 是 sirtuin 家族整體存活偏向的例外情境，在腫瘤中經由 p53 與 p73 發揮促凋亡作用，而非制約凋亡。這顛倒了該家族的一般預期，也是「sirtuin 即存活促進者」這類概括說法失效的原因之一。其治療推論是：SIRT1 抑制在許多腫瘤中之所以有用，正是因為它重新釋放了 Caspase-2 與 Caspase-3；而在腫瘤組織中，SIRT6 位於同一平衡的促死亡側。

context.en-US: Mixed lineage kinase MLKL executes necroptosis by forming plasma-membrane pores and driving K+ efflux, and that potassium loss is itself a second inflammasome trigger. The efflux activates NLRP3, which routes the cell into pyroptosis as well as lytic necroptotic death. This is why necroptosis and pyroptosis are not parallel independent outcomes but a cascade, and why caspase-3 and caspase-7 cleaving GSDMD to terminate pyroptosis acts as the system's self-brake.
context.zh-TW: 混合譜系激酶 MLKL 藉由在細胞膜上成孔並驅動 K+ 外流來執行 necroptosis，而此鉀離子流失本身即為第二個 inflammasome 觸發訊號。K+ 外流活化 NLRP3，將細胞同時導入 pyroptosis 與溶解型 necroptotic 死亡。這正是 necroptosis 與 pyroptosis 並非平行獨立結果、而是一條級聯反應的原因，也說明 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 切割 GSDMD 以終止 pyroptosis 為何構成本系統的自我煞車。

context.en-US: Severe DNA damage that does not hyperactivate PARP-1 routes to intrinsic apoptosis through a p53-driven program, with p53 inducing PUMA and BAX, causing mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, then Caspase-9 and Caspase-3 activation. The decision between this route and parthanatos is set by whether PARP-1 is hyperactivated enough to produce sustained PAR and NAD+/ATP collapse. In adult stroke and neonatal hypoxia-ischemia models this branch is female-favored, with Q-VD-OPh protecting females only.
context.zh-TW: 未達 PARP-1 過度活化程度的嚴重 DNA 損傷，會經由 p53 驅動的程式導向 intrinsic apoptosis：p53 誘導 PUMA 與 BAX，造成粒線體外膜通透化，繼而活化 Caspase-9 與 Caspase-3。此路徑與 parthanatos 之間的選擇，取決於 PARP-1 是否過度活化到能產生持續 PAR 與 NAD+/ATP 崩潰。在成人中風與新生兒缺氧缺血模型中，此分支偏向雌性，Q-VD-OPh 僅保護雌性。

context.en-US: ACSL4 esterifies polyunsaturated fatty acids into phospholipids, supplying the exact lipid substrate that iron-dependent lipid peroxidation attacks, and its upregulation is what makes a cell ferroptosis-permissive. Alongside ALOX15 it defines the susceptibility gate, whereas p53 restrains ferroptosis by repressing SLC7A11 and the cystine supply. The diagnostic signature is lipid-ROS with iron, shrunken mitochondria, and no caspase activation, rescued by ferrostatin-1, liproxstatin-1, or DFO.
context.zh-TW: ACSL4 將 polyunsaturated fatty acid 酯化為磷脂，供應鐵依賴性 lipid peroxidation 所攻擊的確切脂質受質；其上調正是使細胞易於發生 ferroptosis 的原因。它與 ALOX15 共同界定易感性關卡，而 p53 則藉由抑制 SLC7A11 與 cystine 供應來約束 ferroptosis。診斷特徵為伴隨鐵的 lipid-ROS、縮小態粒線體且無 caspase 活化，並可由 ferrostatin-1、liproxstatin-1 或 DFO 挽救。

context.en-US: Severe ischemia collapses ATP so completely that the cell bypasses all regulated executors and dies by accidental necrosis with oncosis: Na+/K+ ATPase failure, calcium overload, mPTP opening, and rupture. This bypass is sex-neutral, unlike every regulated modality downstream, which makes the absence of ATP the first branch point in any stress-to-modality decision tree. Restoring ATP or chelating calcium rescues this category only if applied early, before the point of no return.
context.zh-TW: 嚴重 ischemia 使 ATP 完全崩解，細胞因此繞過所有受調控的執行者，以 accidental necrosis 伴隨 oncosis 死亡：Na+/K+ ATPase 失效、鈣離子過載、mPTP 開啟與細胞膜破裂。此繞路徑與性別無關，與其下游所有受調控的 modality 都不同，因此 ATP 是否保留即成為任何「壓力到死法」決策樹的第一個分支點。恢復 ATP 或螯合鈣離子僅在早期、無回頭點之前應用才能挽救此類死亡。

context.en-US: Reperfusion injury combines a ROS burst with mtDNA release and calcium overload, and the resulting death is mixed rather than assignable to one executor, so PANoptosis is the default assumption. The confirmatory test is PANoptosome assembly (ASC, Caspase-8, and RIPK3 colocalization) rather than any single marker, because blocking one arm fails to stop the process. In the flowchart, TAK1 loss additionally drives RIPK1 kinase death independently of Caspase-8, which is the canonical route into this composite modality.
context.zh-TW: 再灌流傷害同時結合 ROS 爆發、mtDNA 釋放與鈣離子過載，其後的死亡是混合型而無法歸給單一執行者，因此以 PANoptosis 為預設假設。確認測試是 PANoptosome 的組裝（ASC、Caspase-8 與 RIPK3 共定位），而非任何單一標記，因為阻斷單一臂無法終止此過程。在流程圖中，TAK1 喪失亦可獨立於 Caspase-8 驅動 RIPK1 kinase death，這是進入此複合 modality 的典型路徑。

context.en-US: TAK1 normally restrains the RIPK1 arm, and its loss converts RIPK1 into a kinase-dead-but-signal-competent complex that drives necroptotic signaling independently of Caspase-8 status. This is distinct from the Caspase-8-blocked route, which requires both Caspase-8 inhibition and the presence of RIPK1/3/MLKL. Because no established sex bias has been reported for PANoptosis, it should be treated as an open experimental variable rather than stratified by sex.
context.zh-TW: TAK1 正常情況下約束 RIPK1 臂；其喪失會把 RIPK1 轉為 kinase-dead 卻仍具訊號能力的複合體，並獨立於 Caspase-8 狀態驅動 necroptosis 訊號。這與 Caspase-8 被阻斷的路徑不同，後者需要 Caspase-8 抑制加上 RIPK1/3/MLKL 的存在。由於 PANoptosis 尚無已確立的性別偏向，應將其視為開放的實驗變數而非依性別分層。

context.en-US: The NCCD 2018 taxonomy replaced the apoptosis-versus-necrosis dichotomy with regulated cell death (RCD) versus accidental cell death (ACD), organizing roughly 15 named subroutines by mechanism rather than morphology. RCD is genetically encoded, signal-transduction dependent, and pharmacologically modulable; accidental necrosis is instantaneous, biophysical, and has no dedicated molecular machinery or rescue route. Regulation, lysis, inflammation, and immunogenicity then become four orthogonal axes, so controlled does not imply silent and inflammatory does not imply uncontrolled.
context.zh-TW: NCCD 2018 分類法以 regulated cell death（RCD）與 accidental cell death（ACD）的區分取代了 apoptosis 對 necrosis 的二分法，改以機制而非形態來組織約 15 個具名次級程序。RCD 由基因編碼、依賴訊息傳遞且可被藥理調控；accidental necrosis 則是瞬時、生物物理性的，沒有專屬分子機制或挽救途徑。之後調控性、溶解性、發炎性與免疫原性成為四個正交軸，因此「受控」不必然意味「靜默」，「發炎」也不必然意味「不受控」。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is a regulated, lytic, inflammatory subroutine within the RCD family, executed by inflammasome-driven Caspase-1 activating Gasdermin D and E to form membrane pores with IL-1beta and IL-18 release. Its default immune read is immunostimulatory and it is infection-gated rather than a homeostatic mechanism. That it is genetically encoded and signal-dependent places it on the same side of the regulation axis as apoptosis, while its lysis and DAMP release place it on the opposite pole from apoptosis along the membrane axis.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 是 RCD 家族中受調控、溶解型且具發炎性的次級程序，由 inflammasome 驅動的 Caspase-1 活化 Gasdermin D 與 E 形成膜孔，並釋放 IL-1beta 與 IL-18。其預設免疫讀值為免疫刺激型，且受感染閘控而非屬恆定機制。正因其由基因編碼且依賴訊號，它在調控軸上與 apoptosis 站同側；但其細胞溶解與 DAMP 釋放使其在膜軸上與 apoptosis 處於相反極。

context.en-US: Eryptosis is the calcium-dependent regulated death of mature erythrocytes, involving calpain/scramblase activation, phosphatidylserine exposure, and loss of CD47-SIRPalpha, cleared silently by splenic red-pulp macrophages. It is morphologically apoptosis-like but caspase-independent, which is why it must be excluded from apoptosis counts. Since erythrocyte production and clearance runs near 200 billion cells per day, eryptosis rather than apoptosis dominates raw whole-body turnover of roughly 330 billion cells per day.
context.zh-TW: Eryptosis 是成熟紅血球的鈣離子依賴性受調控死亡，涉及 calpain/scramblase 活化、phosphatidylserine 暴露與 CD47–SIRPalpha 喪失，並由脾臟紅髓巨噬細胞無聲清除。它在形態上類似 apoptosis 卻不依賴 caspase，因此必須從 apoptosis 計數中排除。由於紅血球的生成與清除約達每日 2000 億個細胞，因此在每日約 3300 億個細胞的整體更新中，主導者是 eryptosis 而非 apoptosis。

context.en-US: PANoptosis simultaneously engages apoptosis, pyroptosis, and necroptosis machinery through PANoptosome complexes assembled on ZBP1, AIM2, RIPK1, NLRP12, or NLRP3 sensors. Crucially it persists when individual pathway molecules are deleted, which is why it is now argued to be a distinct pathway rather than simple crosstalk. This persistence also destroys any attempt to assign a per-modality percentage, since a single death event activates three modalities at once.
context.zh-TW: PANoptosis 透過組裝於 ZBP1、AIM2、RIPK1、NLRP12 或 NLRP3 感測器上的 PANoptosome 複合體，同時啟動 apoptosis、pyroptosis 與 necroptosis 的機制。關鍵在於，當個別路徑分子被刪除時它依然持續存在，因此如今論證它是獨立路徑而非單純的交互作用。這種持續性也使任何「按 modality 分配百分比」的嘗試失效，因為單一死亡事件會同時啟動三種 modality。

context.en-US: A defining feature of PANoptosis is concurrent inflammasome and Caspase-1 activation alongside the apoptotic and necroptotic arms, producing lytic, inflammatory, immunostimulatory death. Because single-pathway blockade fails, therapeutic strategies aimed at PANoptosis must be upstream (ZBP1, TAK1, or RIPK1) or combinatorial. It is gated by infection and cytokine-storm contexts rather than by homeostatic turnover, and no established quantitative share has been assigned to it.
context.zh-TW: PANoptosis 的定義特徵是在凋亡臂與 necroptosis 臂之外，並行活化 inflammasome 與 Caspase-1，產生溶解型、發炎性、免疫刺激性的死亡。由於單一路徑阻斷無效，針對 PANoptosis 的治療策略必須作用於上游（ZBP1、TAK1 或 RIPK1）或採組合方式。它受感染與細胞因子風暴情境閘控，而非恆定更新，且尚未被賦予任何已確立的量化占比。

context.en-US: Lytic, uncontrolled tumor necrosis supports metastasis, because DAMP-driven sterile inflammation in the tumor microenvironment promotes survival, angiogenesis, and outgrowth of surviving malignant cells. This makes the blanket rule that necrosis is always harmful to the host incomplete, since it is even potentially therapeutic when localized within a tumor. It also explains the therapeutic double edge of inducing necroptosis, pyroptosis, or ferroptosis to kill apoptosis-resistant cells while generating antitumor immunity.
context.zh-TW: 溶解型、不受控的腫瘤壞死可支持 metastasis，因為腫瘤微環境中由 DAMP 驅動的無菌性發炎會促進存活、血管生成與殘存惡性細胞的增生。這使「壞死對宿主一律有害」的概括規則並不完整，因為當壞死局限於腫瘤內時，它甚至可能具治療價值。這也解釋了誘導 necroptosis、pyroptosis 或 ferroptosis 以殺死凋亡抗性細胞並同時產生抗腫瘤免疫的治療雙刃劑性質。

context.en-US: Amelparib (JPI-289, Jeil Pharmaceutical) is a water-soluble PARP-1 inhibitor with IC50 of about 18.5 nM against PARP-1 activity and 10.7 nM against cellular PAR. It is neuroprotective in rat OGD and tMCAO/pMCAO and produced roughly 49% infarct reduction in monkey tMCAO versus 21% for MP-124. It is the only parthanatos-targeting stroke program in existence, having run a Ph1 in healthy male volunteers and a Ph2a (NCT03062397) without sex stratification.
context.zh-TW: Amelparib（JPI-289，Jeil Pharmaceutical）是水溶性 PARP-1 抑制劑，對 PARP-1 活性的 IC50 約 18.5 nM，對細胞內 PAR 為 10.7 nM。它在大鼠 OGD 與 tMCAO/pMCAO 模型中具神經保護作用，在猴 tMCAO 中使梗死體積減少約 49%（MP-124 為 21%）。它是現存唯一以 parthanatos 為標的的中風計畫，曾在健康男性志願者進行 Ph1，Ph2a（NCT03062397）則未進行性別分層。

context.en-US: The JPI-289/amelparib program is the only clinical program designed against parthanatos, and it was built on male-typical biology yet enrolled without sex stratification, so the male-selective preclinical evidence was never used to design it. The massive clinical success of PARP inhibitors comes from HRD/synthetic lethality in oncology, not from parthanatos in the brain. As of September 2026 no sex-stratified cell-death neuroprotection trial exists, making this the most under-exploited aperture in modality-first therapeutics.
context.zh-TW: JPI-289／amelparib 計畫是唯一針對 parthanatos 設計的臨床計畫，且建立於雄性典型的生物學之上，入組時卻未進行性別分層，因此雄性選擇性的臨床前證據從未被用來設計它。PARP 抑制劑的龐大臨床成功來自腫瘤領域的 HRD／synthetic lethality，而非腦部的 parthanatos。截至 2026 年 9 月，仍不存在性別分層的細胞死亡神經保護試驗，使這成為 modality-first 治療學中最被低估的切入口。

context.en-US: ERbeta agonism rather than ERalpha restrains NLRP3 activation and downstream pyroptosis in females, and ERbeta deficiency drives macrophage pyroptosis. This places the sex difference in pyroptosis at the priming step rather than the executor step, which is why estradiol rescues females from inflammatory death without changing GSDMD scores. It also matters for trial design: female-arm stroke strategy should be ERbeta-targeted rather than chronic estrogen replacement, since the WEST and WHI chronic estradiol trials failed or worsened stroke outcomes.
context.zh-TW: 在雌性中， restrain NLRP3 活化與下游 pyroptosis 的是 ERbeta 而非 ERalpha 的激动作用，而 ERbeta 缺乏會驅動 macrophage pyroptosis。這把 pyroptosis 的性別差異定位在 priming 步驟而非 executor 步驟，因此 estradiol 可在不改變 GSDMD 分數的情況下挽救雌性免於發炎性死亡。此點也影響試驗設計：雌性組的中風策略應針對 ERbeta，而非以慢性雌激素補充替代，因為 WEST 與 WHI 的慢性 estradiol 試驗失敗或使中風結果惡化。

context.en-US: 17beta-estradiol neuroprotection after cerebral ischemia is female-specific and requires PARP-1 activity, meaning the hormone's protective effect is lost when PARP-1 is deleted. This makes estrogen an inhibitor of the parthanatos arm rather than an independent neuroprotectant, and it creates a direct conflict with PARP inhibition in women: PARP-1 loss worsens female injury by shunting the cell to caspase-dependent apoptosis. The mirror finding is that PARP-1 deletion or PARP inhibition reduces infarct in males only.
context.zh-TW: 腦缺血後 17β-estradiol 的神經保護作用為雌性專屬且需要 PARP-1 活性，也就是說當 PARP-1 被剔除時，此激素的保護效果即喪失。這使 estrogen 成為 parthanatos 臂的抑制者，而非獨立的神經保護劑，並在女性身上與 PARP 抑制形成直接衝突：PARP-1 喪失會將細胞轉向 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis 而惡化雌性損傷。與之鏡像的發現是，PARP-1 剔除或 PARP 抑制僅在雄性減少梗死。

context.en-US: BH3 mimetics such as venetoclax and navitoclax inhibit BCL-2, MCL-1, and BCL-XL to neutralize the anti-apoptotic brake and trigger apoptosis. Venetoclax is approved, MCL-1/BCL-XL programs remain in trials, and IAP antagonists such as LCL161 are being tested in TNBC stratified by TNF-alpha-related gene signature. This is the clearest case of effector-side drug design: building against a modality's machinery, which is common practice, as distinct from measuring which pathway dominates in a given patient.
context.zh-TW: BH3 mimetics（如 venetoclax 與 navitoclax）抑制 BCL-2、MCL-1 與 BCL-XL，以中和抗凋亡煞車並誘發 apoptosis。Venetoclax 已獲核准，MCL-1/BCL-XL 計畫仍在試驗階段，IAP antagonist（如 LCL161）則在 TNBC 中以 TNF-alpha 相關基因簽章分層進行測試。這是 effector-side 藥物設計最清楚的案例：針對某 modality 的機制建造分子，屬常見做法，與測量特定患者身上哪條路徑佔主導的 patient-side 選擇不同。

context.en-US: GSDME is the cleanest modality-switch gene: when its promoter is hypermethylated and silenced, chemotherapy kills by apoptosis, but when expressed, Caspase-3 cleaves GSDME and the resulting GSDME-N forms pyroptotic pores, converting the same drug into immunogenic lytic death. Decitabine can re-express GSDME to switch the modality, and GSDME methylation is proposed as a chemo-response biomarker. The corollary is a safety axis: high GSDME in normal tissue explains much of chemotherapy toxicity.
context.zh-TW: GSDME 是最乾淨的 modality-switch 基因：當其啟動子被高甲基化而沉默時，化療以 apoptosis 殺死細胞；但當其表現時，Caspase-3 切割 GSDME，產生的 GSDME-N 形成 pyroptosis 孔洞，將同一藥物轉為具免疫原性的溶解型死亡。Decitabine 可重新表現 GSDME 以切換 modality，而 GSDME 甲基化則被提出作為化療反應的生物標記。其推論是一條安全軸：正常組織中較高的 GSDME 解释了多數化療毒性。

context.en-US: Caspases cleave PARP1, disabling its catalytic function and thereby preventing PAR accumulation and parthanatos. This makes damage dose a switch between the silent controlled quadrant and the lytic regulated quadrant: mild damage lets PARP1 hyperactivate and drive parthanatos, while stronger or faster damage activates caspases that cut PARP1 and reroute cells to apoptosis. It is a built-in brake that prevents the cell from committing to the slower, more inflammatory death program when a fast one is available.
context.zh-TW: Caspase 會切割 PARP1，使其催化功能失效，從而阻止 PAR 累積與 parthanatos。這使損傷劑量成為靜默受控象限與溶解型受調控象限之間的開關：輕度損傷讓 PARP1 過度活化並驅動 parthanatos，而更強或更快的損傷則活化 caspase 以切割 PARP1，將細胞改導向 apoptosis。這是一道內建煞車，避免細胞在有較快路徑可用時仍承諾於較慢、發炎性更高的死亡程式。

context.en-US: Estrogen holds females in the controlled, non-inflammatory quadrant through several parallel brakes: ERbeta restrains NLRP3 priming via PELP1, ERalpha-HDAC3 restrains STING, and estradiol raises SIRT1/SIRT3 which in turn support SOD2 and Bcl-2. Menopause releases all three simultaneously, shifting cells toward the inflammatory and lytic quadrants. This is the quadrant-shifter mechanism, and it explains why the same death pathway is tolerated before menopause and pathological after.
context.zh-TW: Estrogen 透過數條平行煞車把雌性維持在受控、非發炎的象限：ERbeta 經 PELP1 約束 NLRP3 priming、ERalpha-HDAC3 約束 STING，而 estradiol 提升 SIRT1/SIRT3，後者再支持 SOD2 與 Bcl-2。Menopause 同時釋放這三道煞車，把細胞推向發炎與溶解型象限。這就是象限轉移機制，也解釋了同一條死亡路徑為何在 menopause 之前可被耐受、之後卻具病理性。

context.en-US: Estradiol raises SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity, which supports SOD2, IDH2, and the broader sirtuin brake on p53, FOXO, and cytochrome c, thereby sustaining the controlled non-inflammatory quadrant at rest. Because sirtuins are NAD+-coupled, this estrogenic support sits upstream of the NAD+ pool that also has to serve PARP1, making the two systems competing for the same cofactor. Menopause therefore removes both the hormonal and, indirectly, the NAD+-mediated restraint at the same time.
context.zh-TW: Estradiol 提升 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 活性，進而支持 SOD2、IDH2 以及 sirtuin 對 p53、FOXO 與 cytochrome c 的整體煞車作用，使細胞在靜息時維持在受控的非發炎象限。由於 sirtuin 與 NAD+ 耦聯，這種雌激素支持位於 NAD+ 池的上游，而該池同時還得供應 PARP1，使兩套系統爭奪同一輔因子。因此 menopause 同時移除荷爾蒙性與間接的 NAD+ 介導制約。

context.en-US: Necroptosis and ferroptosis are linked by a shared ROS, cysteine, and HSP90 hub, and MLKL execution depletes PUFA-containing membrane phospholipids that ferroptosis requires, thereby halting ferroptosis. This is why the two modalities inhibit each other at execution: a cell committing to necroptosis loses the lipid substrate for lipid peroxidation death. The counter-regulator is ACSL4, whose overexpression restores PUFA-phospholipid supply and resists MLKL, defining a membrane-lipid gate between the two.
context.zh-TW: Necroptosis 與 ferroptosis 透過共享的 ROS、cysteine 與 HSP90 中樞相連，而 MLKL 的執行會耗盡 ferroptosis 所需的含 PUFA 膜磷脂，因而使 ferroptosis 停止。這解釋了這兩種 modality 在執行層面互相抑制：承諾進行 necroptosis 的細胞會失去進行 lipid peroxidation 死亡所需的脂質受質。對抗調節者為 ACSL4，其過量表現可恢復 PUFA 磷脂供應並抵抗 MLKL，從而在兩者之間界定出一道膜脂質關卡。

context.en-US: ACSL4 overexpression resists MLKL-mediated necroptosis by maintaining the PUFA-phospholipid pool that MLKL execution depletes. This makes ACSL4 a determinant of which of the two lytic modalities a cell actually dies by, independent of its better-known role as the ferroptosis substrate enzyme. The interaction is a membrane-lipid gate: whichever process controls PUFA-phospholipid availability controls the balance between necroptosis and ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: ACSL4 的過量表現可抵抗 MLKL 所介導的 necroptosis，因為它維持了 MLKL 執行時會耗盡的 PUFA 磷脂池。這使 ACSL4 成為決定細胞實際死於哪一種溶解型 modality 的因子，獨立於它較為人知的 ferroptosis 受質酵素角色。此交互作用構成一道膜脂質關卡：哪一個過程掌控 PUFA 磷脂的可得性，哪一個就掌控 necroptosis 與 ferroptosis 之間的平衡。

context.en-US: PARP1 and SIRT1 draw on the same cellular NAD+ pool, so chronic PARP activation suppresses SIRT1 deacetylation of PGC-1alpha, FOXO, and p53. This competition means sustained DNA-damage signaling weakens the sirtuin brake on apoptosis, a self-reinforcing loop in which PAR-driven NAD+ depletion further disinhibits cell death. It also implies therapeutic synergy for the combined CD38-plus-PARP inhibition approach, since blocking both consumers restores NAD+ availability to the sirtuins.
context.zh-TW: PARP1 與 SIRT1 爭用同一細胞內 NAD+ 池，因此慢性的 PARP 活化會抑制 SIRT1 對 PGC-1alpha、FOXO 與 p53 的去乙醯化。此競爭意味著持續的 DNA 損傷訊號會削弱 sirtuin 對 apoptosis 的煞車，形成一種自我強化的迴路：PAR 驅動的 NAD+ 耗竭進一步解除細胞死亡的抑制。它也支持 CD38 與 PARP 雙重抑制的治療協同，因為阻斷兩個消耗者即可把 NAD+ 可得性還給 sirtuin。

context.en-US: Secondary necrosis is what apoptosis becomes when efferocytosis fails: apoptotic cells and bodies that are not cleared lose membrane integrity, spill HMGB1, ATP, and DNA, and engage the same TLR, RAGE, and NLRP3 machinery as primary necrosis. This is the critical bridge between the controlled non-inflammatory and the inflammatory lytic quadrants. It also explains why late in-vitro apoptosis assays read as inflammatory, making Annexin V+/PI- versus PI+ gating necessary to distinguish the two.
context.zh-TW: Secondary necrosis 是 apoptosis 在 efferocytosis 失敗後所變成的結果：未被清除的凋亡細胞與 apoptotic body 失去膜完整性，釋漏 HMGB1、ATP 與 DNA，啟動與初級壞死相同的 TLR、RAGE 與 NLRP3 機制。這是受控非發炎象限與發炎性溶解象限之間的關鍵橋樑。它也解釋了為何晚期的體外 apoptosis 測試會讀為發炎性，使得必須以 Annexin V+/PI− 與 PI+ 的分門來區分兩者。

context.en-US: Cell fate after DNA damage is set by p53 dynamics rather than by damage load alone. Pulsed p53 signalling selectively activates arrest and repair genes such as CDKN1A and permits recovery, whereas sustained p53 drives terminal programs including apoptosis; CDKN1A induction occurs at lower p53 thresholds than BAX. This temporal refinement explains why the same insult can yield arrest, senescence, or death.
context.zh-TW: DNA 損傷後細胞的命運由 p53 的動態而非損傷負載本身決定。脈衝式 p53 訊號選擇性活化 CDKN1A 等阻滯與修復基因並允許細胞恢復，而持續性 p53 則啟動包括凋亡在內的終末程序；CDKN1A 的誘導閾值低於 BAX。這項時間動態上的修正，說明為何同一種傷害可以分別導致細胞停滯、衰老或死亡。

context.en-US: BAX is activated in senescent fibroblasts under both irradiation-induced and oncogene-induced senescence, where BAX/BAK macropores release mitochondrial DNA into the cytosol without committing the cell to death. Sublethal engagement of the death machinery by low-dose BH3 mimetics is itself sufficient to induce senescence, showing that minority MOMP is an active state rather than a failed apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 在輻射誘導與致癌基因誘導的衰老纖維母細胞中，BAX 被活化，BAX/BAK 大孔洞會將粒線體 DNA 釋放至細胞質，卻未將細胞推向死亡。以低劑量 BH3 擬似物亞致死性地動用此死亡機制，本身即足以誘發衰老，顯示 minority MOMP 是一種主動狀態，而非凋亡的失敗。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization at a sublethal level releases mitochondrial DNA into the cytosol, which activates the cGAS-STING pathway and produces the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. Inhibiting BAX with BAI1 blocks both mitochondrial DNA release and SASP output, and MOMP inhibition reduced inflammation and improved healthspan in aged mice, confirming the axis in vivo.
context.zh-TW: 亞致死程度的外膜通透化會將粒線體 DNA 釋放至細胞質，啟動 cGAS-STING 訊息路徑並產生細胞衰老相關分泌表型。以 BAI1 抑制 BAX 可同時阻斷粒線體 DNA 釋放與 SASP 輸出；而抑制 MOMP 能在老年小鼠中降低發炎並改善健康壽命，於體內證實此軸線。

context.en-US: During apoptosis the same BAX/BAK macropores that release mitochondrial DNA in senescent cells are accompanied by active caspases that silence the inflammatory response. Senescent cells lack that caspase suppression, so an identical pore event becomes a chronic inflammatory engine driving the SASP rather than remaining immunologically quiet.
context.zh-TW: 在凋亡過程中，與衰老細胞釋放粒線體 DNA 相同的 BAX/BAK 大孔洞事件，伴隨活性 caspase 抑制發炎反應。衰老細胞缺乏這種 caspase 抑制，因此相同的孔洞事件反而成為驅動 SASP 的慢性發炎引擎，而不會保持免疫學上的沉默。

context.en-US: Senescent cells actively maintain an anti-apoptotic state rather than merely carrying intact but unused death machinery. They up-regulate Bcl-2, Bcl-w and Bcl-xL, add HSP90, ephrins, PI3Kdelta and PAI-2 to the survival network, and throttle p53 through Mdm2 and FOXO4 sequestration. Senescence is therefore the deferred death of cells that survived the executioner.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞是主動維持抗凋亡狀態，而非僅僅保有完整卻未啟用的死亡機制。它們上調 Bcl-2、Bcl-w 與 Bcl-xL，並將 HSP90、ephrin、PI3Kdelta 與 PAI-2 納入存活網絡，同時透過 Mdm2 與 FOXO4 的隔離來抑制 p53。因此，衰老可被視為度過執行者之後的延遲性死亡。

context.en-US: Senescent and drug-tolerant persister cells are intrinsically ferroptosis-sensitive, making ferroptosis the paradoxical lethal vulnerability of an otherwise apoptosis-resistant state. Senescence-linked PUFA remodeling through Acid Ceramidase and ACSL4 creates this vulnerability along an axis that is independent of GPX4, GSH and iron, and SASP-driven IL-6 and IL-8 transmit it as a paracrine phenotype to bystander cells.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞與藥物耐受持續細胞（persister）天生對鐵死亡敏感，使鐵死亡成為這個原本具凋亡抗性的狀態之致命弱點。衰老相關的 PUFA 重塑（經由 Acid Ceramidase 與 ACSL4）在獨立於 GPX4、GSH 與鐵的軸線上造就此弱點，而由 SASP 驅動的 IL-6 與 IL-8 則以旁分泌方式將此表型傳遞給旁觀細胞。

context.en-US: Only a small fraction of doxorubicin-treated breast cancer cells escape apoptosis, and those survivors are senescent, which makes therapy-induced senescence by construction a cell-death evasion state. Senescent tumor cells can re-enter the cell cycle through p16/p21 loss, Cdk1 upregulation, autophagy and polyploidy, and they are cross-resistant to many drugs while in that state.
context.zh-TW: 接受 doxorubicin 處理的乳癌細胞中，只有極少部分逃過凋亡，而倖存者皆為衰老細胞，因此治療誘導的衰老在建構上就是一種細胞死亡逃避狀態。衰老腫瘤細胞可藉由 p16/p21 喪失、Cdk1 上調、自噬與多倍體化而重新進入細胞週期，並在該狀態下對多種藥物產生交叉抗藥性。

context.en-US: Autophagy is a functional effector of the drug-tolerant senescent state rather than a bystander: senescent tumor cells re-enter the cell cycle partly through autophagy and are cross-resistant to the majority of screened agents. Interfering with autophagy diverts these persister cells into ferroptosis and delays relapse, which is why senolytics are used as a second punch after therapy-induced senescence.
context.zh-TW: 自噬是藥物耐受性衰老狀態的實際效應者，而非旁觀者：衰老腫瘤細胞部分透過自噬重新進入細胞週期，並對多數受篩藥物產生交叉抗藥性。干擾自噬會把這些持續存活細胞轉向鐵死亡並延緩復發，因此治療誘導衰老之後常以 senolytics 作為第二擊。

context.en-US: The COMT rs4680 Val158Met genotype acts as a pharmacogenetic gate on Vitamin E supplementation. In two re-analysed randomized trials, Met/Met slow COMT carriers showed about a 12% reduction in invasive cancer (HR 0.88) while Val/Val fast COMT carriers showed an 18% increase (HR 1.18), with heterozygotes null; the harm arm covers roughly one in four people.
context.zh-TW: COMT rs4680 的 Val158Met 基因型如同 Vitamin E 補充的藥遺傳學閘門。在兩項重新分析的隨機試驗中，Met/Met 慢型 COMT 帶因者的侵襲性癌症風險約降低 12%（HR 0.88），而 Val/Val 快型 COMT 帶因者則增加 18%（HR 1.18），異型合子則無效應；有害族群約占人口的四分之一。

context.en-US: COMT activity determines whether Vitamin E is inert or pro-apoptotic. Vitamin E alone is inert at 3-10 ug/mL in HCT116 colorectal cells, whereas COMT knockdown combined with vitamin E enhances apoptosis dose-dependently through p53 activation, BCL-2 family dysregulation and IAP downregulation, recapitulating the direction of benefit seen in Met/Met slow COMT carriers.
context.zh-TW: COMT 活性決定 Vitamin E 是惰性還是促凋亡。在 HCT116 結腸癌細胞中，3-10 ug/mL 的 vitamin E 單獨作用為惰性；而 COMT 敲低合併 vitamin E 則以劑量依賴方式經由 p53 活化、BCL-2 家族失衡與 IAP 下調增強凋亡，重現 Met/Met 慢型 COMT 帶因者所見的效益方向。

context.en-US: Val158Met is a supplement-response modifier rather than a baseline cancer risk gene. A meta-analysis of 99 case-control studies found no association between Val158Met alone and overall cancer, even though the same genotype strongly modifies the effect of Vitamin E supplementation. This dissociation means carrier status carries no prognostic information outside a supplement context.
context.zh-TW: Val158Met 是補充劑反應的修飾因子，而非基礎癌症風險基因。整合 99 項病例對照研究的中位分析顯示，Val158Met 本身與整體癌症並無關聯，儘管同一基因型能強烈修飾 Vitamin E 補充的效果。這種分離意味著在非補充劑情境下，帶因狀態不提供任何預後資訊。

context.en-US: The COMT genotype signal is not vitamin-E-specific. In the companion Women's Health Study analysis, COMT also modified the cardiovascular effect of low-dose aspirin, and a COMT by beta-carotene interaction was noted in ATBC. COMT therefore emerges as a general gate on supplement and drug response rather than a vitamin E peculiarity.
context.zh-TW: COMT 基因型的訊號並非 Vitamin E 專屬。在配套的 Women's Health Study 分析中，COMT 同樣修飾了低劑量 aspirin 的心血管效果，ATBC 中也觀察到 COMT 與 beta-carotene 的交互作用。因此 COMT 浮現為補充劑與藥物反應的普遍閘門，而非 Vitamin E 特有的現象。

context.en-US: COMT detoxifies catechol substrates, including reactive catechol estrogen quinones and catechol carcinogens, which is one mechanistic candidate for its role as a response gate. COMT haploinsufficiency at 22q11.2 carries a cancer predisposition, and competition from catechol-bearing dietary polyphenols such as Quercetin and Fisetin means fast COMT clears these faster, potentially reshaping the whole catechol/antioxidant milieu.
context.zh-TW: COMT 負責解毒兒茶酚類基質，包括反應性的兒茶酚雌激素醌與兒茶酚致癌物，這是它作為反應閘門的機制候選之一。22q11.2 區段的 COMT 單倍體不足帶有癌症易感傾向；而來自 Quercetin、Fisetin 等含兒茶酚膳食多酚的競爭意味著快型 COMT 清除它們得更快，可能重塑整體的兒茶酚／抗氧化 milieu。

context.en-US: Hormesis is the named form of a biphasic dose-response in which low doses stimulate and high doses inhibit, tracing to the Arndt-Schulz law of 1887 and the coined Greek term for excitation in 1943. Because the same curve shape is described in a dozen other fields under different names, restricting a search to the word hormesis misses most of the relevant literature.
context.zh-TW: Hormesis 是一種具名的雙相劑量反應形式：低劑量刺激、高劑量抑制，其源流可回溯至 1887 年的 Arndt-Schulz 法則，以及 1943 年創造的希臘文「興奮」一詞。由於同一條曲線形狀在十多個其他領域以不同名稱描述，僅以 hormesis 一詞檢索會遺漏大部分相關文獻。

context.en-US: Trained immunity is the immunology field's name for hormesis: mild microbial exposure reprograms monocytes epigenetically so that later innate responses are enhanced, a durable counterpart to the repeated bout effect in exercise physiology. Because the phenomenon is never named hormetic in these fields, cross-disciplinary searches built on the toxicology term alone retrieve almost none of it.
context.zh-TW: Trained immunity 是免疫學界對 hormesis 的命名：輕微微生物暴露以表觀遺傳方式重編程單核細胞，使後續先天反應增強，是運動生理學中 repeated bout effect 的持久對應物。由於該現象在這些領域從未被稱為 hormetic，僅以毒理學術語建構的跨領域檢索幾乎無法取回這些文獻。

context.en-US: Low-dose ionizing radiation is the radiation-biology instance of hormesis, where sub-threshold exposure upregulates DNA repair enzymes and produces resistance to higher doses, the adaptive response first described in 1988. The interpretation is politically contested because it conflicts with the linear no-threshold model, so the field deliberately avoids the word hormesis.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量游離輻射是輻射生物學中的 hormesis 實例：次閾值暴露會上調 DNA 修復酵素並產生對更高劑量的抗性，即 1988 年首次描述的適應反應。此一詮釋具政治爭議性，因為它與線性無閾值模型衝突，所以該領域刻意避開 hormesis 一詞。

context.en-US: Caloric restriction and its relatives, dietary restriction and intermittent fasting, are the endocrinology field's entry point to the same hormetic dose-response, with the glucose-to-ketone switch acting as the signal. Shared quantitative features across domains, such as a 30-60% maximum stimulatory response over a 5-100-fold dose range, would be invisible without a vocabulary that unifies the field-specific names.
context.zh-TW: Caloric restriction 及其相關的 dietary restriction 與 intermittent fasting，是內分泌學領域通往同一 hormetic 劑量反應的入口，其中葡萄糖到酮體的轉換即為訊號。在缺乏統一各領域專屬名稱的詞彙橋之前，跨領域共有的量化特徵（如 5-100 倍劑量範圍內 30-60% 的最大刺激反應）依然是不可見的。

context.en-US: Eustress, introduced by Selye in 1975 and elaborated in Yerkes-Dodson inverted-U and stress inoculation frameworks, is the psychology field's name for hormesis. Because these literatures describe a graded beneficial dose range for arousal without ever invoking hormetic terminology, a keyword search on hormesis retrieves essentially none of the behavioural evidence.
context.zh-TW: Eustress 由 Selye 於 1975 年提出，並在 Yerkes-Dodson 倒 U 型與 stress inoculation 框架中加以闡述，是心理學界對 hormesis 的命名。由於這些文獻描述的是喚 arousal 的分級有益劑量範圍，卻從未引用 hormetic 術語，以 hormesis 為關鍵字檢索基本上取不到任何行為科學證據。

context.en-US: The upper bound of the hormetic window, defined as the no-observed-adverse-effect level, is not merely the onset of toxicity but the execution boundary at which regulated cell death is triggered. Above this dose the same adaptive machinery that produced resistance at low dose tips into programmed execution, which is why the two literatures keep colliding.
context.zh-TW: Hormetic window 的上界（定義為無可觀察不良效應濃度）不只是毒性的起點，更是啟動 regulated cell death 的執行邊界。超過此劑量時，低劑量下產生抗性的同一套適應機制會翻轉為程式性執行，這也是 hormesis 與細胞死亡文獻一再交會的原因。

context.en-US: Preconditioning is the experimental proof that the regulated cell death threshold is itself hormetically tunable. Brief sublethal ischemia raises the threshold for later lethal ischemic insult, prior low-dose HOCl or tert-butylhydroquinone shifts the viability curve to the right while preserving its biphasic shape, and caloric restriction and exercise do the same through AMPK, SIRT1, PGC-1alpha and NRF2.
context.zh-TW: Preconditioning 是 regulated cell death 閾值本身可被 hormetic 調節的實驗證明。短暫的亞致死性缺血會提高之後致命性缺血傷害的閾值；先前的低劑量 HOCl 或 tert-butylhydroquinone 會在保留雙相曲線形狀的同時把存活曲線右移；caloric restriction 與運動則透過 AMPK、SIRT1、PGC-1alpha 與 NRF2 達成同樣效果。

context.en-US: Accidental cell death lies outside the hormetic frame because it is instantaneous, passive and biophysical, with no sensor, no signal and no checkpoint to adapt. Its dose-response is monotonic, so no preconditioning can make a cell physically resistant to catastrophic trauma. Only the stressors that cause it are hormetic at sublethal doses.
context.zh-TW: Accidental cell death 位於 hormesis 框架之外，因為它是瞬時、被動且生物物理性的，沒有感測器、沒有訊號、也沒有可供適應的檢查點。它的劑量反應是單調的，因此沒有任何 preconditioning 能讓細胞在物理上抵抗災難性創傷。只有造成它的 stressor 在亞致死劑量下才是 hormetic 的。

context.en-US: NRF2 with ARE is the Tier I program of the hierarchical oxidative-stress model formalised for hormesis, occupying the low-dose adaptive zone with antioxidant and phase II enzyme induction and glutathione restoration. Tier II adds NF-kB-driven inflammation and cell-cycle arrest, and Tier III executes apoptosis and necrosis, so the tiers are the same control network at increasing saturation.
context.zh-TW: NRF2 搭配 ARE 是分層氧化壓力模型中的第一層程式，並在為 hormesis 形式化後佔據低劑量適應區，伴隨抗氧化與第二相酵素誘導以及 glutathione 的恢復。第二層加入 NF-κB 驅動的發炎與細胞週期阻滯，第三層則執行凋亡與壞死，因此各層其實是同一控制網絡在飽和度遞增下的表現。

context.en-US: In the tiered stress-response model, NF-κB occupies the intermediate stressed tier whose program feeds directly into the caspase, RIPK and GPX4 checkpoints that execute death once the NOAEL is exceeded. This is the molecular bridge between hormesis and cell-death biology: the same transcription factor that primes survival at moderate dose participates in execution context at high dose.
context.zh-TW: 在分層壓力反應模型中，NF-κB 位於中間的受壓層，其程式在超過 NOAEL 後直接餵入執行死亡的 caspase、RIPK 與 GPX4 檢查點。這是 hormesis 與細胞死亡生物學之間的分子橋樑：同一個轉錄因子在中等劑量下為存活預備，在高劑量下卻參與執行情境。

context.en-US: Autophagy is the cleanest example of a pathway that is protective at the adaptive dose and lethal if overdriven. Mild autophagy clears damaged mitochondria and lowers the ROS that would otherwise commit the cell to regulated cell death, and part of preconditioning's benefit is autophagy-dependent; excessive autophagy instead becomes autophagic cell death.
context.zh-TW: 自噬是「在適應劑量下具保護性、過度驅動時則致命」最清楚的例子。溫和的自噬清除受損粒線體並降低原本會把細胞推向 regulated cell death 的 ROS，而 preconditioning 的部分效益依賴自噬；過度的自噬則反過來成為自噬性細胞死亡。

context.en-US: Once the hormetic window is exceeded, regulated cell death executes apoptosis first, and regulated necrotic modalities such as necroptosis, pyroptosis and ferroptosis follow when apoptosis is blocked. The sequence is why caspase inhibition can convert a controlled response into a lytic, more inflammatory one, and it is where the RCD tier ends and the unregulated ACD tier begins.
context.zh-TW: 一旦超出 hormetic window，regulated cell death 先執行凋亡；當凋亡被阻斷時，necroptosis、pyroptosis 與 ferroptosis 等受調控的壞死型態才隨之而來。這個順序解釋了為何 caspase 抑制會把受控反應轉為溶解性、發炎性更強的反應，也正是 RCD 層結束、失控的 ACD 層開始之處。

context.en-US: Heat-shock preconditioning acts through the HSF1-driven HSP70 response, where a sublethal thermal pulse raises proteostasis capacity and resistance to a later lethal stress. The same mild pulse can drive HSP70 to a striking share of total protein, which is the energetic-cost and overcompensation basis proposed for hormesis generally.
context.zh-TW: 熱休克 preconditioning 透過 HSF1 驅動的 HSP70 反應作用，一次亞致死的熱脈衝提升蛋白穩定性能力並增強對之後致命壓力的抗性。相同的溫和脈衝甚至可讓 HSP70 佔總蛋白相當高的比例，這正是文獻為 hormesis 提出的能量成本與過度補償基礎。

context.en-US: Exercise-generated ROS act as the signalling trigger for mitochondrial biogenesis through the AMPK-PGC-1alpha axis, with SOD, catalase and GPx induction as effectors. This is the domain's strongest hormetic case, which is why co-supplementing antioxidants around workouts blunts the mROS to AMPK to PGC-1alpha cascade that the adaptation depends on.
context.zh-TW: 運動產生的 ROS 會透過 AMPK-PGC-1alpha 軸作為粒線體生物發生的訊號觸發，並以 SOD、catalase 與 GPx 的誘導作為效應者。這是該領域最強的 hormetic 案例，也因此在運動前後補充抗氧化劑會削弱適應所依賴的 mROS -> AMPK -> PGC-1alpha 級聯。

context.en-US: Brief low-oxygen pulses are the sensor-driven core of intermittent hypoxia hormesis, with HIF-1alpha acting alongside AMPK and SIRT1 to raise EPO, VEGF and BDNF. Five-minute hypoxia and normoxia cycles over 60-120 minutes, repeated three to five times weekly for two to four weeks, is the operational dose; chronic severe hypoxia is the maladaptive extreme.
context.zh-TW: 短暫的低氧脈衝是間歇性低氧 hormesis 的感測核心，HIF-1alpha 與 AMPK、SIRT1 共同作用以提升 EPO、VEGF 與 BDNF。每週三至五次、每次 60-120 分鐘的 5 分鐘低氧／常氧循環、持續二至四週，是操作劑量；而慢性嚴重低氧則是不適應的極端。

context.en-US: Xenohormesis describes how mild plant toxins act as hormetins: they switch on the cell's own antioxidant defences through NRF2, with HSF1, AMPK and SIRT1 as co-sensors and SOD, catalase, GPx, HO-1 and phase II detox as effectors. The framing is the opposite of the antioxidant one, since the goal is induction rather than scavenging.
context.zh-TW: Xenohormesis 描述的是溫和植物毒素如何作為 hormetin：它們透過 NRF2 啟動細胞自身的抗氧化防禦，並以 HSF1、AMPK 與 SIRT1 為共同感測器，以 SOD、catalase、GPx、HO-1 與第二相解毒作為效應者。此一框架與抗氧化劑框架正好相反，因為目標是誘導而非清除。

context.en-US: Low-dose ionizing radiation hormesis runs through ATM and p53 as sensors, with BRCA1 and GADD45 as effectors of DNA repair and NRF2/ARE enzymes alongside CD69-positive T cells. The same sensor module that mediates adaptive protection at low dose mediates damage accumulation at high dose, which is the whole point of a biphasic curve.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量游離輻射的 hormesis 透過 ATM 與 p53 作為感測器運作，並以 BRCA1 與 GADD45 作為 DNA 修復的效應者，NRF2/ARE 酵素與 CD69 陽性 T 細胞並列其中。同一組感測模組在低劑量下媒介適應性保護，在高劑量下卻媒介損傷累積，這正是雙相曲線的核心意涵。

context.en-US: Fermentable fibre and live fermented foods are the gut-colonisation hormetic input, with the microbiome generating short-chain fatty acids such as butyrate that drive autophagy and barrier integrity. Toll-like receptor signalling and the vagal gut-brain axis are the sensors, and Tregs, barrier integrity and BDNF are the effectors; broad-spectrum antibiotics and chronic proton pump inhibitors are the anti-hormetic extremes.
context.zh-TW: 可發酵纖維與活發酵食品是腸道定殖的 hormetic 輸入，腸道菌群產生 butyrate 等短鏈脂肪酸，進而驅動自噬與屏障完整性。Toll-like receptor 訊號與迷走神經腸腦軸是感測器，Tregs、屏障完整性與 BDNF 則是效應者；而廣效抗生素與長期質子幫浦抑制劑則是反 hormetic 的極端。

context.en-US: Ascorbate is the water-phase reductant that regenerates the alpha-tocopheroxyl radical at the membrane-water interface, which is why one tocopherol molecule can trap many peroxyl radicals before it is lost. Vitamin E is therefore catalytic rather than stoichiometric, and its functional reserve is set by the ascorbate, glutathione and NADPH pool rather than by tocopherol concentration.
context.zh-TW: Ascorbate 是水相還原劑，在膜－水介面上將 alpha-tocopheroxyl 自由基再生，因此單一 tocopherol 分子在被消耗前可捕捉許多過氧自由基。Vitamin E 因此是催化性而非化學計量性的，其功能儲備由 ascorbate、glutathione 與 NADPH 的儲備決定，而非由 tocopherol 濃度決定。

context.en-US: GPX4 is the only enzyme that reduces phospholipid hydroperoxides inside the membrane, using its catalytic selenocysteine and two glutathione to convert LOOH to the inert lipid alcohol before the chain branches. Substituting cysteine for selenocysteine costs about 100-fold activity, and dietary Selenium loss removes the catalytic residue entirely, which is why selenium deficiency sensitizes tissue to ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: GPX4 是唯一能在膜內還原磷脂質過氧化物的酵素，利用其催化的 selenocysteine 與兩個 glutathione 將 LOOH 轉為惰性的脂質醇，在鏈式反應分支之前完成。將 selenocysteine 換成 cysteine 會使活性下降約 100 倍，而飲食中 Selenium 流失則完全移除催化殘基，這也是 selenium 缺乏會讓組織易感鐵死亡的原因。

context.en-US: Ferroptosis sensitivity is set less by antioxidant capacity than by how much polyunsaturated fatty acid is esterified into membrane phospholipids. ACSL4 charges arachidonate and adrenate to acyl-CoA and LPCAT3 inserts them at the sn-2 position of phosphatidylethanolamines, and those oxidized PE species are the lethal substrates. Neuronal membranes, enriched in DHA, are consequently the most oxidation-fragile tissue in the body.
context.zh-TW: 鐵死亡的易感性與其說取決於抗氧化能力，不如取決於有多少 polyunsaturated fatty acid 被酯化進膜磷脂中。ACSL4 將 arachidonate 與 adrenate 接到 acyl-CoA 上，LPCAT3 再將它們插入 phosphatidylethanolamine 的 sn-2 位，而這些被氧化的 PE 物種正是致命基質。因此富含 DHA 的神經膜是人體中最易受氧化破壞的組織。

context.en-US: At low flux, 4-HNE is a signalling molecule rather than damage: it modifies KEAP1 and releases NRF2 to induce phase II detoxification enzymes, glutathione synthesis and the cystine antiporter, a hormetic adaptive response. At high flux the same bifunctional electrophile overwhelms clearance and adducts proteins irreversibly, so the concentration threshold separates adaptation from injury.
context.zh-TW: 在低通量下，4-HNE 是訊號分子而非損傷來源：它修飾 KEAP1，釋放 NRF2 以誘導第二相解毒酵素、glutathione 合成與胱胺酸反向運輸體，形成 hormetic 的適應反應。在高通量下，同一個雙功能親電體會壓過清除能力並不可逆地與蛋白質成加合物，因此濃度閾值正是區分適應與傷害的分界。

context.en-US: Reactive Oxygen Species in mitochondria convert the fission GTPase from a housekeeping enzyme into a stress-driven cutter by oxidizing the redox-sensitive Cys644 of DRP1. Sulfenylated DRP1 has higher GTPase activity and fragments the network, and the resulting ROS feed forward to oxidize more DRP1, a self-reinforcing loop that MitoTEMPO and mito-catalase interrupt.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體中的 Reactive Oxygen Species 藉由氧化 DRP1 上對氧化還原敏感的 Cys644，把這個分裂 GTPase 由家務性酵素轉為壓力驅動的切割者。被 sulfenyl 化的 DRP1 GTPase 活性升高並使網絡碎裂，而產生的 ROS 又回饋氧化更多 DRP1，形成自我強化的迴路，可由 MitoTEMPO 與 mito-catalase 打断。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin normally resides in the inner mitochondrial membrane but is externalized to the outer membrane under apoptosis, mitophagy and other stress, where it licenses the punctiform hyperfragmentation needed for autophagosome engulfment. Unbound outer-membrane cardiolipin is converted to phosphatidic acid instead, which hyperactivates Mfn1/2 and can produce hyperfusion, so the same lipid cuts or fuses depending on where it sits.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 正常位於粒線體內膜，但在凋亡、mitophagy 與其他壓力下會外翻至外膜，並在那裡許可自噬體吞噬所需的點狀過度碎裂。未結合的外膜 cardiolipin 則會被轉為 phosphatidic acid，後者過度活化 Mfn1/2 並可能造成過度融合，因此同一種脂質依其位置決定是切割還是融合。

context.en-US: About 90% of the mitochondrial Vitamin E pool resides in the outer membrane, the exact leaflet where DRP1 assembles and where cardiolipin externalization is read.
